programme.title: 300: Rise of an Empire
programme.desc: Ruler of the Persian empire and self-proclaimed god Xerxes continues his campaign to crush the emerging Greek nation, forcing a general from the democratic city state of Athens to lead his navy into battle against Xerxes' vast armada. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Sullivan Stapleton, Eva Green and Lena Headey

programme.title: Justice League
programme.desc: Fantasy action adventure starring Gal Gadot and Ben Affleck. With an ancient demonic threat looming, Bruce Wayne, aka Batman, enlists the help of Diana Prince (Wonder Woman) to form a new superhero team. After adding Aquaman, Cyborg and The Flash to its ranks, the league faces its first challenge: resurrecting Superman.

programme.title: Green Lantern

The pair decide to combine forces to exact their revenge.

programme.title: The Fix

programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Jeff Goldblum and Julianne Moore. Elsewhere in the capital, crimelord Brick Top demands that Irish boxer Mickey One Punch take a dive in an unlicensed fight. When Brick Top joins the hunt for the missing gem, mayhem ensues.

programme.title: Little Fockers
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Ben Stiller and Robert De Niro. Greg Focker and his wife Pam are now the proud parents of twins, but their respective families are still interfering in their lives.

programme.desc: Black comedy drama starring Colin Farrell, Christopher Walken, Sam Rockwell and Woody Harrelson. Struggling screenwriter Marty finds inspiration for his next script in the dog-napping operation run by his nefarious best friend Billy and his partner Hans. But the target of their next sting is going to put everyone's lives in danger.

programme.desc: Historical satire starring Steve Buscemi and Simon Russell Beale. In the immediate aftermath of Joseph Stalin's death in 1953, his cabinet jockey for position in the hope of becoming the next Soviet leader. As they argue over everything from funeral arrangements to the fate of the dictator's offspring, the divided government struggles to maintain order.

programme.title: We're the Millers
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jennifer Aniston and Jason Sudeikis. In order to repay a debt to his drug supplier, small-time pot dealer David Clark agrees to smuggle a shipment of marijuana across the Mexican border. However, to carry out the deception, David recruits a stripper and two teenagers to pose as his family.

In an attempt to get rid of him from his job as one of their attendants, the governors of the National Gallery send Mr Bean to America to represent them at the unveiling of the Grierson Gallery's new purchase. Needless to say disaster is never far away.

After a rocky start in this new land, he finds his luck changing when he meets a wealthy industrialist who wants László to build an ambitious community project. However, for the tormented László and his wife, Erzsébet, this commission proves both blessing and curse.

programme.title: Valentine's Day
programme.desc: Romantic comedy featuring an ensemble cast including Anne Hathaway, Jessica Alba and Julia Roberts. The love life of a florist working on Valentine's Day is sent into a tailspin after he proposes to his girlfriend. Meanwhile, his best friend thinks she has met the man of her dreams, little realising he is already married. Will love lend a hand and save the day?

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Remake of the John Wayne western from the Coen brothers, starring Jeff Bridges and Matt Damon. When farmer Frank Ross is murdered by a hired hand, his teenage daughter Mattie decides to take the matter in hand and find a man with "true grit" to bring the killer to justice. Mattie's search leads her to "Rooster" Cogburn, a hard-drinking, one-eyed US marshal with a fearsome reputation.

programme.desc: Urban drama starring Larry Fishburne, Ice Cube and Cuba Gooding Jr. South Central Los Angeles, 1984: young Tre's mother decides it would be in his best interest to live with his estranged but disciplined dad. Seven years on, he has managed to steer clear of the drugs and the violence but, as the teenage gang wars begin to invade his neighbourhood, it becomes almost impossible for him and his friends to avoid trouble.

programme.title: Regretting You
programme.desc: A mother and daughter grapple with what's left after a devastating accident reveals a shocking betrayal and forces them to rediscover themselves. Romantic comedy drama, starring Allison Williams, Mckenna Grace and Dave Franco

programme.desc: New York bachelor David is due to drive to his friend's wedding, but a wheel clamp on his vehicle derails those plans. He acquires a new drive from the mysterious Car Rental Company managed by two nameless agents, who are oddly familiar with his dating history. At the wedding, David meets fellow singleton Sarah and squanders an opportunity to dance with her. On the way home, the rental car's GPS asks him if he would like to embark on a big bold beautiful journey. When David agrees, the virtual assistant guides him to Sarah and they follow a winding route between physical doors that open into episodes from their respective pasts. Romantic drama, starring Colin Farrell and Margot Robbie

Enter hotshot lawyer Billy Flynn, whose clients include double murderess Velma Kelly, and Roxie begins to realise that there's no such thing as bad publicity.

Shattered by the news that his parents are divorcing, 16-year-old Frank runs away to New York. For six years he lives a life of fraud, cashing over $2 million in bad cheques while impersonating an airline pilot, a paediatrician and a lawyer, and always staying one step ahead of tenacious FBI agent Carl Hanratty.

programme.desc: Biographical drama starring Adam Driver and Penélope Cruz. Enzo Ferrari and his wife Laura have equal shares in their car-manufacturing company, but their marriage is in tatters following the death of their son, while the business is in financial peril. With the 1957 Mille Miglia endurance race looming, Enzo seeks victory for Ferrari, whatever the cost.

After his Nazi officer father is given a promotion, young Bruno and his family are moved from Berlin to a remote house in the countryside. With nothing to do and no friends of his own age, Bruno becomes curious about a nearby building known as "the farm" and its oddly clothed inhabitants.

programme.title: Boyz N the Hood

After a young Catholic girl takes her own life, Constantine is approached by her grieving twin sister. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must spring back into action when a Decepticon, secretly planted on the Moon in the 1960s, becomes a clear and present danger. Not only is the technology contained within it potentially devastating to humankind, but Sam is also dealing with relationship problems.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Mark Wahlberg. Four years after the Battle of Chicago, the Autobots are now in hiding from the US government after being deemed a threat to humanity. So when struggling engineer Cade Yeager comes across an old semi truck while looking for parts, he soon finds himself on the radar of government forces and an alien bounty hunter.

programme.desc:
Steve Backshall and his long-suffering crew return for more deadly encounters with animals hoping to earn a place on his hallowed Deadly 60 list.
Steve and the crew head into the beautiful Alaskan wilderness for another deadly adventure. It's the largest state in America, and is home to some of the most impressive predators on Earth. Out at sea, he uses radar technology to track down massive humpback whales, with a unique hunting strategy. Next he braves freezing coastal waters to get a close-up view of the world's furriest mammal. Adapted for the freezing waters, they do look cute, but don't be fooled - they're prolific killers and they have very sharp minds. It was one of four golds that Biles took that year, with the others coming in the Individual all-around, balance beam and floor disciplines

First, Lucy witnesses Henry's doomed courtship with Anne of Cleves, with Henry successfully reneging on their marriage having claimed it had yet to be consummated. Two weeks later, Henry married teenager Catherine Howard, but an act of adultery with a courtier saw the young woman convicted of treason and beheaded. Finally, Lucy explores Henry's relationship with his last wife Katherine Parr, and how she managed to win Henry round despite their greatly differing religious beliefs

programme.desc: Pupstruction builds Dr. Barkley a Feel Better Mobile that helps pets who need it. When Roxy wants a demolition party for her birthday, the Pups make her dream a reality.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: It's Bingo's turn to bring the Bob Bilby puppet home from Kindy and record their weekend together. Bob's previous adventures have all been very exciting, so Bingo is keen to make their time just as memorable. But when Bingo and Bluey spend most of their day showing Bob cartoons and playing games on the tablet, it doesn't look like Bob's having much fun. Bingo feels like she's let him down and gets upset. But Bluey realises that as long as they do exciting things, Bob will too. Banding together, the family put their screens away and head outdoors to show Bob what having fun is all about.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Bingo stops playing Bluey's spy game in the park, their device to control the grown-ups stops working properly! Bluey now sees how important Bingo is and needs to win her back!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Forced to wait five minutes in front of a restaurant for their takeaway order, Bluey and Bingo become restless for entertainment. They are pushing the very limits of Dad's patience.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Dad sets up a cloth swing in the yard, the girls can finally play 'Butterflies' - taking turns in the makeshift cocoon before hatching into beautiful butterflies. It's shaping up to be a fun afternoon, until the girl's bossy neighbour Judo takes charge. Wanting to play with Bluey by herself, Judo convinces Bluey to play a new game instead; running away from Bingo. Now poor Bingo's heartbroken at being abandoned. With her little sister's happiness on the line Bluey needs to find a way to make it better, reaching out to both Judo and Bingo as they all find a way to be kinder friends.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Dad works from home, he likes to sit on a giant yoga ball that the kids cannot resist playing with. When he's not looking they steal his ball and push it down the stairs. Dad starts horsing around too, bouncing them on the ball and throwing them onto the bed, but as the kids get more and more excited and want to play bigger and bolder games, Dad forgets that Bingo is not as agile as her big sister and accidentally knocks her over with the yoga ball. With help from Mum, Bingo learns to use her big girl bark so she can let Dad know when she's hit her physical limit and a game's going too far.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: At school, Bluey and her friends throw themselves into various games. Strolling the room, teacher Calypso gently nudges the kids into each other's orbit, and soon make-believe mother Indy is moving into Rusty's new house while waitressing at Bluey's fish and chip shop! Everything's going like clockwork, until an extra-large delivery causes Indy to almost step on Honey's gnome village! Thankfully, Calypso is ten steps ahead, dispatching the Terriers to defend the village and save the day. Balance is restored. Only Pretzel remains, but his new game of catching fish gives Calypso an idea.

programme.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse+
programme.desc: When the Clubhouse is busy, Minnie can't use the kitchen or Anywhere Areas. Mickey surprises her with her own pink Clubhouse, thanks to Von Drake's invention.

programme.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse+
programme.desc: Daisy loses her voice before a frog show. Her pals gather lemon, honey, and tea to make a warm drink that soothes her throat and helps her get her voice back.

programme.title: Superkitties: Su-Purr Charged
programme.desc: The Kitties face their fears and enter the Super Spooky House. When the Pumpkin Ball is stolen, it's up to the SuperKitties to get it back in time for the Halloween Party.

programme.title: Midnight Run
programme.desc: Comedy thriller starring Robert De Niro and Charles Grodin. Bounty hunter Jack Walsh is just the man to bring embezzler Jonathan "The Duke" Mardukas to justice. Down on his luck, the $100,000 fee is just what Jack needs right now. The only problem is that Mardukas cheated the Mafia out of a cool $15 million, and they want their money back. Can Jack beat the FBI and an unscrupulous rival to his quarry?

programme.title: Censor
programme.desc: After viewing a strangely familiar video, Enid, a film censor, sets out to solve the mystery of her sister's disappearance. Horror thriller, starring Niamh Algar, Michael Smiley and Nicholas Burns

programme.title: They Rode West
programme.desc: Western starring Robert Francis and Donna Reed. The new medical officer at a remote fort comes in for criticism when he provides treatment to the local native American tribe.

programme.title: Sign of the Pagan
programme.desc: Enthusiastic historical drama set in 450AD. Jack Palance stars as Attila the Hun, who vows to conquer the mighty Roman Empire. However, centurion Jeff Chandler discovers the pagan ruler's plot and makes it his mission to stop him. Directed by Douglas Sirk, and co-starring Ludmilla Tcherina, Rita Gam and Jeff Morrow

programme.title: The Violent Men
programme.desc: Western starring Glenn Ford, Barbara Stanwyck and Edward G Robinson. Pacifist rancher John Parrish finds it impossible to control his anger at the ruthless antics of land baron Lew Wilkison, and realises that the only way he can stop Wilkison is to resort to violence.

programme.title: The Nevadan
programme.desc: In order to locate a vast stash of stolen gold, a US Marshal orchestrates the escape of a stagecoach robber, but ends up getting caught in his dealings with a greedy rancher. Western, starring Randolph Scott, Dorothy Malone and Forrest Tucker

programme.title: The Martian
programme.desc: Science-fiction drama based on the novel by Andy Weir, starring Matt Damon. After a manned mission to Mars is hit by a ferocious storm, Mark Watney is left behind when his fellow crew members make their escape. Using scientific knowledge, ingenuity and drawing on seemingly inexhaustible levels of resolve, Mark must find a way to survive long enough to be rescued.

programme.title: The World's End
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. Five old school friends reunite for an epic pub crawl in their home town and unwittingly become mankind's only hope for survival.

programme.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
programme.desc: Science-fiction action thriller starring Linda Hamilton and Arnold Schwarzenegger. In 1998, with the apocalypse apparently averted following the events of Terminator 2: Judgment Day, humanity's saviour John Connor is targeted for assassination by a time-travelling T-800 cyborg. John's mother, Sarah, is once again thrust into the battle for Earth's future as a new artificial intelligence gains sentience.

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programme.desc: Sean Lock is joined by Andrew Flintoff to battle guest captain Bill Bailey and team-mate Roisin Conaty as Jimmy Carr hosts another edition of the game show mash-up. Susie Dent is ably assisted by Rob Beckett in the Dictionary Corner, while Rachel Riley deals with the numbers and letters

programme.title: Taskmaster
programme.desc: Greg Davies welcomes five new contestants as David Baddiel, Ed Gamble, Jo Brand, Katy Wix and Rose Matafeo begin another chaotic series of bizarre tasks. Eggplants, popsicles and dramatic entrances all become unexpectedly important as the comedians desperately try to impress the Taskmaster. Meanwhile, Alex Horne carefully observes every triumph and disaster from the sidelines.

programme.title: Celebrity Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: YouTube star and internet sensation Bethany Mota goes undercover to meet up-and-coming social media hopefuls who are trying to break through. Disguised as an ordinary girl with a punk rock style who dreams of starting her own channel, Bethany meets a world champion beat-boxer, a pair of comical twin pranksters and an inspiring hip hop dance teacher. In the end, Bethany reveals her true identity in a surprising way and helps make their dreams come true

programme.title: Celebrity Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: American football and baseball star Deion Sanders goes undercover to meet inspiring sports coaches and deserving fans. Disguised as a businessman who hopes to start a youth football programme, Deion meets two coaches who work with inner-city kids and a remarkable fan with a really surprising story. In the end, Deion reveals his true identity to reward their generosity and help turn their dreams into reality

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Roxi and Glen are the first couple to play host in Southampton, where things get off to a bad start as all the others are dreading their cauliflower puree starter. On the second evening, Russell and Lisa's pork dish and salmon main get raised eyebrows from their guests, although the food is not the only problem as animosity is brewing between two of the women. Tennis fans John and Suzy bring the week to a close - can they serve up an ace menu and walk away with the prize?

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: In east Lancashire, newly engaged Andrew and Sue offer a menu of classic tried and tested dishes. Joining them are laid back Ben and Ruth, and drama lovers Helen and Victoria. Day two sees Ben and prankster Ruth host. Although their breakfast theme intrigues their guests, will it be dinner party standard? Finally, it's the turn of drama teacher Helen, and saleswoman by day, singer by night, Victoria, to show the competition how it's really done

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Essex groom Gary plans an aquatic wedding 200 miles from home. But Lauren hopes for a home counties service. Will Gary's underwater dream sink without a trace?

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: While Sofia dreams of a boho beach blessing, Craig is planning an Oktoberfest wedding featuring short leather trousers. Will Sofia call time on their nuptials?

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: The Dotsons return. Dave tries to get his motors runnin', Darrell stumbles over a curious collection and Rene finally goes nuts.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Costa Mesa offers Rene a bit of unexpected "high" tech; while Darrell goes on a cross-cultural haberdashery journey.

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Dippin' Dots is an American brand that sells cryogenically frozen beads of ice-cream. Recently, it enjoyed its busiest summer, scooping 146 billion dots and making an annual revenue of $300million. But, before that, in 2012, the company was on the brink of bankruptcy, until owner and CEO Scott Fischer turned its fortunes around. Here, he infiltrates his workforce to find out if his expanding empire has the manpower to cope. As his alter ego Brad, a man looking for a new career, he goes undercover, meeting a factory production operator, a warehouse supervisor, a sales supervisor and a server

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Stacy Anderson, the brand president of global business Anytime Fitness, poses as a potential franchise owner to make sure all companies using the name are offering the same experience. She meets a gym manager, a personal trainer and a franchise owner to see if they company is fighting fit

programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos
programme.desc: Alfonso Ribeiro presents light-hearted entertainment and family-friendly laughs, as viewers' home video clips capture funny, surprising and memorable moments

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Indio, California proves to be extremely interesting for Dave. Brandi and Jarrod find the ultimate stash, while Mary's locker misfires.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Ivy angles his way into some vintage outdoor accessories; Dave ends up in an unexpected audit; while Emily's departure ruins one buyer's day.

programme.title: Below Deck
programme.desc: Following a difficult charter and an awful lot of infighting, the crew spends two days off at a lavish villa. Captain Kerry's hoping some R&R will get his crew back feeling happy and harmonious. Alas, chef Anthony's bitterness from last charter season boils over, Solene and Rainbeau's frustrations with each other come to a head, and Damo violates the bro code

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay visits Mojito, a Cuban cafe in Brooklyn, New York. The restaurant was the shared dream of two newlyweds who have separated since its opening, and whose constant public quarrelling is distracting staff and driving customers away

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay visits PJ's Steakhouse in Queens, New York, to provide his expert advice to the owners. They decided to turn a successful bar into a high-end restaurant, but without any previous experience in managing a business they found themselves seriously in debt. With an over-confident chef and a partner propping up the bar, co-owner Madalyn faces a few difficult decisions

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Phil struggles to accept the news when Luke announces he no longer wants to be a magician, and Jay is having trouble getting to sleep thanks to Gloria's loud snoring. Mitch and Cam swap duties, with Mitch staying at home with Lily, and Cam setting off for his first day as the new music teacher at Luke and Manny's school

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: The friends pitch in for a yard sale to help raise money for the school but problems arise when Manny comes across an old trunk containing a secret of Gloria's. Phil finds himself in a bit of a pickle, feeling pressured to sell and buy something, while Alex's new boyfriend is subjected to Claire's thorough interrogation. Will she approve of him or will it turn out that she preferred Dylan?

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Jay can't believe his luck when he gets out of a shopping trip - until he receives a visit from ex-wife Dede, the last person he was expecting to see on his doorstep. Knowing how much trouble she can cause, he is keen to get rid of her as soon as possible - especially as she is yet to find out about Gloria's pregnancy. Meanwhile, Phil and Claire need Mitch's legal help when Haley is arrested for under-age drinking. American comedy, starring Ed O'Neill, with a guest appearance from Shelley Long

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer wins $1million on the lottery, but keeps it a secret from his family, fearing Marge's reaction if she finds out about it. He and Bart set about spending the money, and buy front-row tickets to a Coldplay concert. With the guest voice of Chris Martin

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: A romantic evening at the ice-rink leads to Homer and Marge heading for the Winter Olympics to play for a curling team, while Lisa becomes hopelessly addicted to collecting sporting memorabilia and Bart befriends Canada's equivalent of Milhouse

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: When Miss Hoover asks her students to research their family history, Lisa is distressed to discover that most of her forebears seem to have been crooks and deadbeats. Then she finds an old diary in the attic that was written by her ancestor, Eliza Simpson, and describes a remarkable 19th-century adventure

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Mrs Krabappel writes to Bart's parents about his bad behaviour when he fails to hand in his homework. After a conference with Principal Skinner, Homer insists on punishing his son, but Marge is more sympathetic, inspiring a scheming Bart to start pitting them against each other

programme.title: Hollyoaks
programme.desc: Jenson's past is quickly catching up to him, and Theresa finds herself in the middle of a dangerous mess. Elsewhere, Abigail continues to abuse her position of power

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: When Peralta notices Holt is in a bad mood, he teams up with the captain's husband Kevin to find out what has gone wrong. Boyle tries to get a confession out of an elderly bank-robbery suspect (played by Happy Days creator Garry Marshall), who pretends to be frail and adorable whenever Santiago and Diaz are around

programme.title: First Dates
programme.desc: A 71-year-old beekeeper is looking for a man with a naughty side to his nature, and a 21-year-old is reluctant to venture from his house, which has dented his chances of romance. Other visitors to the restaurant include a charity shop manager who has his wedding all mapped out and a Welsh hairdresser who, after a string of failed relationships, spends the evening meeting a part-time model

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: In the first half of a two-part rescue mission at Lyla's Family Restaurant, in the Ohio suburb of Cuyahoga Falls, owner Waleed's American dream has turned into a full-blown Nightmare. The dining room is dated, the overwhelming menu has more than 200 items, and the team are at breaking point, with frequent shouting matches between the staff. But owner Waleed is still firmly in denial. Gordon faces one of his biggest challenges yet to try and rescue this restaurant

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: The sofa-critics watch The Crown, I'm a Celebrity… Get Me Out Of Here!, You Won't Believe This, Down to Earth with Zac Efron, This Morning with Marie Kondo, The Hidden Lives of Pets, and ITV News and the World Cup

programme.title: Dating Naked USA
programme.desc: Diane is a vivacious blonde looking for the man of her dreams, and Keegan is a muscular jock looking for the right girl

programme.title: Midnight Run
programme.desc: Comedy thriller starring Robert De Niro and Charles Grodin. Bounty hunter Jack Walsh is just the man to bring embezzler Jonathan "The Duke" Mardukas to justice. Down on his luck, the $100,000 fee is just what Jack needs right now. The only problem is that Mardukas cheated the Mafia out of a cool $15 million, and they want their money back. Can Jack beat the FBI and an unscrupulous rival to his quarry?

programme.title: Censor
programme.desc: After viewing a strangely familiar video, Enid, a film censor, sets out to solve the mystery of her sister's disappearance. Horror thriller, starring Niamh Algar, Michael Smiley and Nicholas Burns

programme.title: They Rode West
programme.desc: Western starring Robert Francis and Donna Reed. The new medical officer at a remote fort comes in for criticism when he provides treatment to the local native American tribe.

programme.title: Sign of the Pagan
programme.desc: Enthusiastic historical drama set in 450AD. Jack Palance stars as Attila the Hun, who vows to conquer the mighty Roman Empire. However, centurion Jeff Chandler discovers the pagan ruler's plot and makes it his mission to stop him. Directed by Douglas Sirk, and co-starring Ludmilla Tcherina, Rita Gam and Jeff Morrow

programme.title: The Violent Men
programme.desc: Western starring Glenn Ford, Barbara Stanwyck and Edward G Robinson. Pacifist rancher John Parrish finds it impossible to control his anger at the ruthless antics of land baron Lew Wilkison, and realises that the only way he can stop Wilkison is to resort to violence.

programme.title: The Nevadan
programme.desc: In order to locate a vast stash of stolen gold, a US Marshal orchestrates the escape of a stagecoach robber, but ends up getting caught in his dealings with a greedy rancher. Western, starring Randolph Scott, Dorothy Malone and Forrest Tucker

programme.title: The Martian
programme.desc: Science-fiction drama based on the novel by Andy Weir, starring Matt Damon. After a manned mission to Mars is hit by a ferocious storm, Mark Watney is left behind when his fellow crew members make their escape. Using scientific knowledge, ingenuity and drawing on seemingly inexhaustible levels of resolve, Mark must find a way to survive long enough to be rescued.

programme.title: The World's End
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. Five old school friends reunite for an epic pub crawl in their home town and unwittingly become mankind's only hope for survival.

programme.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
programme.desc: Science-fiction action thriller starring Linda Hamilton and Arnold Schwarzenegger. In 1998, with the apocalypse apparently averted following the events of Terminator 2: Judgment Day, humanity's saviour John Connor is targeted for assassination by a time-travelling T-800 cyborg. John's mother, Sarah, is once again thrust into the battle for Earth's future as a new artificial intelligence gains sentience.

programme.title: Would I Lie to You? at Christmas

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo ventures on a rail journey through Germany, guided by Bradshaw's Continental Railway Guide published in 1936. Starting in the vibrant city of Berlin, Michael visits the Museum of Modern Art in Berlin's Kreuzberg, where he sees how a leading artist of the era, George Grosz, warned of the rise of fascism in a haunting self-portrait. In the Schöneberg district of the capital, Michael researches the decadent night scene of the 1920s, and looks at how cabaret culture is being revived today. When he reaches Weimar, Michael investigates the beginnings of Bauhaus design and visits the movement's first building, before travelling onto Stuttgart, where he takes a ride in a high-performance Porsche to the manufacturer's Stuttgart headquarters

He also finds out how the dictator took on the Mafia and asks whether it is true that under Mussolini, the trains ran on time

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo travels by train through Austria and the Czech Republic, beginning in the northern Austrian city of Linz, where Adolf Hitler lived as a young boy. From here, Michael travels onto Prague Central Station, where he meets 87-year-old Zuzana Maresova, who, as a seven-year-old girl climbed aboard a train to travel to safety in London with hundreds of other Jewish children. Eventually crossing the Czech border into Slovakia, Michael reaches his final destination, one of Europe's youngest capital cities, Bratislava

programme.desc: The continuing story of the diehards committed to hunt down thousands of Nazi war criminals, some of whom were living in plain sight. The documentary also tells the story of Josef Mengele - who performed gruesome experiments on Auschwitz inmates - and the son so appalled by his father's actions he considered turning him in

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce presents a second visit to the Black Country Living Museum, where items brought in include a surrealist painting, a collection of jewels and one of the rarest guns featured on the show. Plus, Hilary Kay explores local motor racing history with a visit to the Sunbeam Motor Car Company

programme.title: Russia with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: The concluding leg of the adventurer's epic journey begins in Crimea, which is part of neighbouring Ukraine but was annexed by Russia in 2014. Simon meets the eccentric and fearless owner of a safari park who likes to get up close and personal with his pride of lions, then comes across a small hospital where he meets an inspirational doctor trying to protect his clinic from closure. Arriving in Moscow he meets a woman who was arrested for protesting against her flat being demolished, and finally arrives in St Petersburg, where he joins fighters at a martial arts club

programme.title: Guy Martin: Proper Jobs

programme.title: Saving Lives at Sea
programme.desc: In Castletownbere, Donagh faces a baptism of fire on his first shout, as the crew rescue a fisherman who's suffered a suspected stroke. On the Somerset coast, the crew are called out to a Mayday from a houseboat that is sinking fast. In Newquay, a surfer has been caught out by the stormy seas and is struggling to get back to shore

programme.title: Bangers & Cash
programme.desc: Jack has his eye on a Peugeot 205 GTI that could be one of the finest examples in the country. Plus, Derek collects a pair of sporty 60s Triumphs.

programme.title: Bangers & Cash
programme.desc: Derek picks up some very special working vehicles. Charlie feels the pull of a gargantuan Hummer and Paul extracts a vintage tractor from a Yorkshire barn.

programme.title: Kites

The Friendship Between Veeru And Rajeshwar Turns Bitter And They Become Enemies. They Choose To Confront Their Enmity Only Years Later When Their Respective Grandchildren Fall In Love With Each Other.

Musical drama, starring Mahima Chaudhry and Shahrukh Khan

programme.desc: Amy's brother Peter turns to Ray for advice on talking to women, while Debra decides to help out by throwing a party and inviting all her single friends

programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.
First into the workshop is Margaret Brier from Yorkshire. She's hoping electronics wizard Mark Stuckey can bring an old homemade gramophone back to life. Now little more than a box of bits, the gramophone was built by Margaret's grandfather Harry Bates in the late 1800s. Harry was ahead of his time, a natural-born engineer with a talent for fixing anything, known in Yorkshire as a 'knackler'. Mark calls in help from the Repair Shop's very own 'jack of all trades', Dom Chinea, to remake the missing papier-mâché horn. Meanwhile, Mark works on reviving the flagging gramophone motor. Together the duo restore the voice of this silent gramophone and get it playing once more.
The next visitor to the barn is 19-year-old Charlotte Hughes, also from Yorkshire. She's hoping ceramics expert Kirsten Ramsay can help her atone for an accident that left her mother's piggy bank smashed and shattered into pieces. A well-intentioned attempt to mend it has left unsightly cracks and a gaping hole in piggy's cheek. Along the way he's also lost his cork and trotters. Charlotte is desperate to make it up to her mum, Liz, who was understandably upset when she discovered this important memento from childhood was broken. Ceramics restorer Kirsten Ramsey has her work cut out to undo the old repairs and stabilise the cracks. Working her magic to perfect the piggy bank in time for Liz and Charlotte to return to collect it.
Finally, Jay Blades and Brenton West welcome Teresa Oates, and her partner, Ron, to the barn. Theresa wants silversmith Brenton to restore an antique to help someone very dear to her. The couple have brought in a Prussian helmet, the 19th-century German ceremonial helmet is a family heirloom. Teresa's dad, Edward, was a D-Day veteran and soldier during the Allied occupation. He brought the tarnished memento home when he returned from service and Teresa and Ron are hoping that by restoring the helmet they may help Edward (who is suffering from dementia) refresh his memory. Leather expert Suzie Fletcher steps in to create a new skull and chin strap, while Brenton works to revitalize the rusting and tarnished helmet, achieving a stunning transformation.

programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.
First at the barn is Andy Crook from Cornwall. His hopes for restoring a very special inheritance rests on musical instrument expert Pete Woods. The rather tarnished tuba belonged to his late father, Frank. Both he and Andy played in various brass bands over the years and shared a real love for performing. Andy discovered the tuba in his mother's loft after decades of believing it was long gone. He dreams of being able to play his beloved dad's instrument. However, the tuba has been rendered mute from damage caused over 30 years ago - a crucial valve is missing, and a leaking joint makes this fix a tricky one for Pete.
Horologist Steve Fletcher's skills are really put the test when Kamal from Cheshire arrives with her family's mantel clock. Her Sikh parents came from India just after the second world war and, although it was a struggle for them to settle in Yorkshire, they made a happy life and Kamal is hugely proud of them. The clock was the beating heart of their household. She clearly remembers the sweet chime and she yearns to hear it once again. After years of being stored in the basement of her childhood home and only recently unearthed, the metal encased clock is in a bad way, but Steve rolls up his sleeves and brings it back to life.
And silversmith Brenton West is intrigued by an Asian curiosity brought in by Tracy Lavery and her daughter Zoe. The bronze pot is in the form of a lion dog with a hinged head and is thought to have been designed for burning incense. It joined Tracey's family when her grandfather brought it back from his worldly travels and has been passed from mother to daughter ever since. It's been used as a money pot mainly and has captivated each family member. However, at the ripe old age of at least one hundred, he is desperate for an over haul - his tail has detached, his hinge is broken and he's cracked in places but fortunately he's in safe hands with Brenton.

Using cutting-edge techniques, they extract its venom, which could hold the key to saving millions of lives.

programme.title: Pole to Pole with Will Smith
programme.desc: Will, Bryan and Carla join local Waorani elder Penti Baihua in the Amazon, in search of the world's biggest snake: the giant green anaconda. They carefully remove just one scale from the 17-foot snake's skin. Will's fear turns into relief, then joy. The single scale can reveal the health of the entire ecosystem - crucial for the future of both wildlife and the Waorani.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: When blizzards bring chaos to Norway's roads, Thord and his A-Team battle to save a jack-knifed truck. Bjoern is in trouble when a driver with no snow-skills causes gridlock - and can't pay up. In the far north, Jo Roger returns from injury to face a fifty-seven ton mega-truck that threatens to tip over.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: After the death of her mother, Motshidi is starving and alone. In a terrifying reunion with her father, she has everything to lose. But in an uncharacteristic act of charity, Blue Eyes takes pity, giving Motshodi a new lease of life. A violent traitor rises in the rotten ranks, challenging the selfish princess and bringing an end to Mmamotse's rule. The Makulu Pack make one last stand as the battle for supremacy begins, but with the hyenas gone, it's up to Sega to lead the Matahta Pride to victory.

programme.title: When Sharks Attack and Why
programme.desc: Beginning in 2010, a single beach in Bali was the site of seven shark attacks - the first ever recorded along the islands coast

programme.title: Immortal Egypt with Joann Fletcher
programme.desc: Joann explores the peak of ancient Egyptian civilisation by looking at the Colossi of Memnon, two massive stone statues depicting Pharaoh Amenhotep III, and examining the lives of the workers and artisans involved in the building of the Valley of the Kings. This golden age was threatened by the growing power of Karnak's priests, and Joann reveals how Tutankhamen's early death was a chance for Egypt to start afresh and rewrite history, but was undermined by decades of state-sanctioned looting of the tombs

programme.title: Weathered: Earth's Extremes
programme.desc: Maiya May explores heat in Portland, Oregon, and Medellín, Colombia, a city that is leading the revolution against sweltering city temperatures before visiting the hottest city in the US, Phoenix, Arizona

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: A chance for viewers to purchase goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: A chance for viewers to purchase goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: Weathered: Earth's Extremes
programme.desc: Maiya May learns about the severe impacts of droughts and floods on agriculture and the alarming depletion of groundwater reserves. Despite these challenges, Maiya finds hope in innovative agricultural practices

programme.title: The Mughal Empire
programme.desc: Shah Jahan’s reign ushered in the golden age of Mughal architecture. During this time the splendour of the Mughal court reached its peak, as exemplified by the many grand buildings erected during his reign

programme.title: Caligula's Hidden Legacy
programme.desc: Part two of two. Two gigantic ships built by Caligula have fuelled legends for two millennia. This film reveals the story of these floating palaces, where imperial power, archaeological mysteries, and an obsessive quest for grandeur converge

programme.title: Immortal Egypt with Joann Fletcher
programme.desc: The historian reveals hows Egypt's enemies exploited a country weakened by internal strife, travelling south to Sudan to examine the story of the forgotten Nubian kings, who ruled Egypt from their southern homeland for a century, even building their own pyramids to bury their monarchs. She then explores how the next group of invaders the Saites took the tradition of mummification to new extremes by preserving millions of animals, before Alexander the Great came to Egypt's rescue and founded the greatest city on Earth

programme.title: The War Cabinet
programme.desc: Part one of two. The key players behind Trump's use of the military. From clashes with allies, to taking out foreign leaders, to waging war in the Middle East, examining the inner circle of advisers and officials trying to project US power

programme.title: Reporting Scotland: News at Seven
programme.desc: Reports from BBC newsrooms across the country with analysis and discussion on the big stories of the day

programme.title: Grand Tours of Scotland's Rivers
programme.desc: Paul Murton explores the River Annan in Dumfries and Galloway, following it from where it rises above the Devil's Beef Tub, all the way to the Solway Firth. On the way he samples some dubious-smelling 'healthy' spa water, discovers the explosive devil's porridge and follows in the footsteps of Robert Burns by taking a dunk in the briny close to where the river meets the sea. He then turns his attention to the Esk, which rises in the Portland Hills just south of Edinburgh

programme.title: Jules and Greg's Wild Swim
programme.desc: Julie Wilson Nimmo and Greg Hemphill head to the lochs of the Highlands, meeting up for a swim with the Loch Insh Dippers, led by long-distance swimmer and author Alice Goodridge. After an overnight stop in an off-grid log cabin, the couple join the Wild Highlanders swimming group at Loch Ness

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: Dougie Vipond heads west to the Morvern peninsula in Lochaber to find out how the Ardtornish Estate is balancing farming and stalking with nature restoration. Anne Lundon is on a shoot in Glenshee with a portrait photographer using Scotland's landscape as her backdrop, while Leanna Fernandez is near Kingussie to encounter misunderstood bloodsucking creatures that are being saved from extinction. Plus, Rosie Morton visits a dairy farm near Peterhead that diversified and created new markets for its milk

programme.title: City Lights: Pure Dead Brilliant
programme.desc: A celebration of the comedy that captured the spirit of 1980s Scotland, starring Gerard Kelly as a Glasgow bank clerk with dreams of being a best-selling author. The show's creator Bob Black and cast members Elaine C Smith, Jonathan Watson and Dave Anderson reveal their favourite moments and give behind-the-scenes insights, with bittersweet memories of co-stars Kelly and Andy Gray. With contributions from Gayle Telfer Stevens, Jordan Young, Sanjeev Kohli, Damian Barr, Johnny McKnight Kirsty Wark and Paul English

programme.title: City Lights
programme.desc: Chancer is about to come to a high point in his life as he leaves jail to meet his nouveau riche friend. Comedy, starring Gerard Kelly and Andy Gray

programme.title: Scot Squad
programme.desc: The Chief is keen to make amends for a slip of the tongue and keeps digging deeper as his extended apology lasts for ever. The traffic cops make a big noise to salute the key workers, while the rural officers handle a massive marrow bust-up at the horticultural show. Comedy, starring Jack Docherty, Grado and Karen Bartke

programme.title: Scotcast
programme.desc: Discussion on Scotland's biggest news stories, with analysis from journalists, commentators and guests

programme.title: Scotland Stands Up 2025
programme.desc: Stuart Mitchell hosts a night of comedy at the Church Hill Theatre in Edinburgh. Scotland-based American Krystal Evans finds the funny in the differences and similarities in world views and family values, while rising star Ayo Adenekan wrestles with his identity and reveals his ambitions to become a truly unique Scottish superhero. Jay Lafferty vividly describes the challenges she faces as she gets older, while the headliner is Burnistoun's Robert Florence, making a rare stand-up appearance

programme.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
programme.desc: Dr Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship with consequences that could change the world as he knows it. Horror sequel, starring Ralph Fiennes, Jack O'Connell and Alfie Williams

programme.title: The Moment
programme.desc: A fictionalised version of pop star Charli XCX navigates the complexities of fame and industry pressure while preparing for her arena tour debut. Mockumentary, starring Charli XCX, Rosanna Arquette and Kate Berlant

programme.title: Racewalkers
programme.desc: A failing racewalking coach joins forces with a former baseball pro who shows natural talent for the sport as they challenge the sport's top competitor. Comedy, directed by and starring Kevin Claydon and Phil Moniz

programme.title: Kiss of the Spider Woman
programme.desc: Political prisoner Valentín shares a cell with Molina, convicted for public indecency, where an unlikely bond forms between the pair as the latter recounts a glamorous Hollywood movie. Adaptation of the stage musical, based on the novel by Manuel Puig, starring Diego Luna, Jennifer Lopez and Tonatiuh

programme.title: The Deb
programme.desc: A young farmer hopes a debutante ball will transform her life. Her city cousin arrives after being expelled from school and scoffs at the traditions. As they search for dates, the teenagers challenge each other's assumptions. Comedy musical, starring Natalie Abbott, Charlotte MacInnes, and Rebel Wilson, who also directed

programme.title: Better Man
programme.desc: Biographical drama charting the meteoric rise, dramatic fall and remarkable resurgence of British pop icon, Robbie Williams

programme.title: Cold Storage
programme.desc: When a lethal contagious fungus escapes a secret lab, two young employees, joined by a grizzled bioterror operative, must survive the wildest night shift ever. Director Jonny Campbell's comedy thriller, starring Joe Keery, Georgina Campbell, Liam Neeson and Lesley Manville

programme.title: Racewalkers

programme.title: Better Man
programme.desc: Biographical drama charting the meteoric rise, dramatic fall and remarkable resurgence of British pop icon, Robbie Williams

programme.title: Scream 7
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott-Evans, one of the survivors of the original Ghostface killers, has built a new life in the quiet town of Pine Grove, far from Woodsboro, with her 17-year-old daughter Tatum. A lethal new stalker emerges with a diabolical plan that involves targeting Tatum and everyone that Sidney loves. Horror sequel, starring Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox and Isabel May

programme.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
programme.desc: Dr Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship with consequences that could change the world as he knows it. Horror sequel, starring Ralph Fiennes, Jack O'Connell and Alfie Williams

programme.title: The Bad Guys 2
programme.desc: Struggling to adjust to their newly minted lives as Good Guys, the Bad Guys are offered one last job by a group of all-female criminals. Animated sequel, featuring the voices of Sam Rockwell, Marc Maron and Craig Robinson

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: A half-human canine is sworn to protect and serve as he faces feline supervillain Petey the Cat. Animated comedy, with the voices of Pete Davidson, Poppy Liu, Lil Rel Howery and Isla Fisher

programme.title: Wallace & Gromit in The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Peter Sallis, Ralph Fiennes and Helena Bonham Carter. As the annual Giant Vegetable Competition approaches, enterprising Wallace and Gromit cash in with their humane pest-control outfit, "Anti-Pesto". But business turns sour when a huge, mysterious beast begins destroying every garden in the area.

programme.title: Smurfs: The Lost Village
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voices of Demi Lovato and Rainn Wilson. Smurfette and friends embark on their biggest ever adventure - travelling beyond the Forbidden Forest in search of other Smurfs.

programme.title: Happy Feet Two
programme.desc: Musical animated adventure sequel featuring the voice of Elijah Wood. Mumble and his son Erik must rescue their friends and family in the aftermath of a natural disaster.

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure. When the secret formula for the addictive Krabby Patty is stolen by pirate Burger Beard, Mr Krabs seconds SpongeBob to head into the live-action world and get it back. But will the dastardly pirate give it up without a fight?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voices of Jack Black, Dustin Hoffman and Angelina Jolie. Ancient China: Po the Panda lives in the Valley of Peace and dreams of becoming a kung fu master despite the fact he is clumsy, overweight and a complete beginner at martial arts. So when he's accidentally chosen to be the legendary Dragon Warrior, he is overjoyed. However, his joy is short-lived as the evil snow leopard Tai Lung has escaped from captivity and is on his way to the Valley to take his revenge on Po's mentor.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda 2
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure sequel with Jack Black as the voice of martial arts master Po. In order to stop the plot of evil peacock Lord Shen, Po must embark on a journey to discover the truth about his childhood.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda 3
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventurel featuring the voices of Jack Black, Angelina Jolie and Dustin Hoffman. Dragon Warrior Po is forced to face his destiny when he discovers his long-lost father and comes up against a villain from the Spirit Realm, who is collecting the chi energy of all the kung fu masters.

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep Movie
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman. Shaun's plan to have a lazy day on Mossy Bottom Farm backfires when a cunning ruse sees the Farmer end up lost in the Big City. Shaun and the flock set off to find him, but to succeed they will have to avoid capture by an eager animal control officer, with nothing but elaborate disguises and quick wits.

programme.title: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman, featuring the voices of Justin Fletcher and John Sparkes. Life at Mossy Bottom Farm takes a surprising turn when an alien crash-lands nearby. The extraterrestrial visitor is friendly enough, but when it transpires that a government agent is on its trail, Shaun the Sheep and friends come up with a plan to help the newcomer get back home.

programme.title: The Wild Thornberrys Movie
programme.desc: Worthy feature-length adaptation of the animated TV series, featuring the voices of Tim Curry, Brenda Blethyn, Marisa Tomei and Rupert Everett. Young Eliza Thornberry has a very special gift - she can converse with animals. But when a trip with her nature documentary-making family to Africa brings her into contact with evil poachers, the youngster has to decide whether she is prepared to give up this wonderful power to save the country's endangered wildlife.

programme.title: The Lego Ninjago Movie
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voices of Jackie Chan, Dave Franco and Justin Theroux as the Lego figures. Teenager Lloyd is secretly part of a team of heroes who protect their city from the evil Lord Garmadon - who happens to be Lloyd's father.

programme.title: How to Train Your Dragon
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Jay Baruchel and Gerard Butler. A teenage Viking boy forms a special bond with a dragon - much to the consternation of the members of his clan who regard the beasts as mortal enemies.

programme.title: How to Train Your Dragon 2
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voices of Jay Baruchel, Gerard Butler and Cate Blanchett. After five years during which time the Vikings and dragons have learned to live together, Hiccup discovers there's a threat to that peaceful status quo that needs to be faced.

programme.title: Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Animated comedy spin-off from Madagascar, featuring the guest voices of John Malkovich and Benedict Cumberbatch. Resourceful penguins Skipper, Kowalski, Private and Rico team up with an undercover organisation to stop a malevolent mollusc from destroying the world.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 3: The Hangman's Daughter
programme.desc: Prequel to the acclaimed horror tale, in which a band of Western outlaws and unfortunate travellers stumble across a remote bar inhabited by suspicious looking characters _ who turn out to be vampires. Marco Leonardi, Michael Parks and Temuera Morrison star

programme.title: Man Finds Tape
programme.desc: After finding mysterious video clips, siblings investigate the strange recordings and uncover a disturbing secret. Horror thriller, starring Kelsey Pribilski and William Magnuson

programme.title: Night Patrol
programme.desc: An LA cop discovers a local task force is hiding a secret that puts the residents of his childhood neighbourhood in danger. Director Ryan Prows' horror thriller, starring Jermaine Fowler and Justin Long

programme.title: Lake Placid
programme.desc: Adventure thriller starring Bill Pullman, Bridget Fonda and Oliver Platt. After a diver is killed while trawling Black Lake in northern Maine, an unusual tooth is pulled from the body. New York palaeontologist Kelly Scott identifies the tooth as coming from a giant crocodile, and joins Sheriff Hank Keough, game warden Jack Wells and mythology expert Hector Cyr in a quest to catch the creature.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Supernatural horror based on Stephen King's novel, starring Jason Clarke, Amy Seimetz and John Lithgow. Shortly after the Creed family move to a new town, their cat is killed in a traffic accident. Neighbour Jud suggests they lay the animal to rest in an ancient woodland burial ground. When the family is rocked by tragedy, though, events take a macabre turn.

programme.title: Rabbit Trap
programme.desc: Married musicians Daphne and Darcy Davenport moved from London to a cottage in Wales to complete their new album. By accident they record a mystical sound never heard before, and gradually disconnect from reality. Writer/director Bryn Chainey's horror, starring Dev Patel and Rosy McEwen

programme.title: Night Patrol
programme.desc: An LA cop discovers a local task force is hiding a secret that puts the residents of his childhood neighbourhood in danger. Director Ryan Prows' horror thriller, starring Jermaine Fowler and Justin Long

programme.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
programme.desc: Horror thriller starring Jennifer Love Hewitt and Sarah Michelle Gellar. When four teenagers are involved in a hit-and-run accident, they panic and dump the body. But several months later, when one of the group receives an anonymous letter from someone who knows details of the crime, it sets off a terrifying chain of events.

programme.title: The Bride!
programme.desc: In 1930s Chicago, maverick scientist Dr Euphronius gives life to a murdered woman, sparking romance, police interest and radical change. Writer/director Maggie Gyllenhaal's horror based on The Bride of Frankenstein, starring Jessie Buckley, Christian Bale and Annette Bening

programme.title: Until Dawn
programme.desc: A year after their friend disappeared, a group find themselves trapped in a time loop, where they are hunted and killed unless they survive until dawn. Video game-inspired horror, starring Ella Rubin, Michael Cimino and Odessa A'zion

programme.title: 28 Years Later
programme.desc: Horror thriller starring Jodie Comer, Aaron Taylor-Johnson and Ralph Fiennes. Nearly three decades after the outbreak of a devastating rage virus, the British Isles remain in quarantine. Married couple Isla and Jamie, along with their young son, are part of a community living in safety on Lindisfarne. However, Isla is seriously ill, and only one person can help: the mysterious Dr Kelson, who lives on the mainland among the infected.

programme.title: Lee Cronin's The Mummy
programme.desc: The young daughter of a journalist disappears into the desert without trace. Eight years later, the broken family is shocked when she is returned to them. Supernatural horror, starring Jack Reynor, Laia Costa, May Calamawy and Natalie Grace

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: In 1838 Germany, Thomas Hutter is sent to the Carpathian mountains to secure the signature of enigmatic nobleman Count Orlok on a property sale in the German city of Wisborg. Thomas leaves his bride Ellen in the care of friend Friedrich Harding and his wife Anna. The young man barely survives the exhausting trip to Europe and stumbles home to find Ellen driven to delirium by a telepathic bond to the Count. Director Robert Eggers' version of the Dracula-inspired horror, starring Bill Skarsgard, Lily-Rose Depp, Nicholas Hoult and Aaron Taylor-Johnson

programme.title: Johnny English Reborn
programme.desc: Comedy adventure starring Rowan Atkinson. When a plot comes to light to assassinate the Chinese premier, hapless operative Johnny English, currently honing his combat skills in a remote region of Tibet, is hurriedly called back to MI7.

programme.title: Johnny English Strikes Again
programme.desc: Spy comedy starring Rowan Atkinson. Bumbling MI7 agent Johnny English has found a new life as a geography teacher. But when a cyber attack exposes Britain's spooks, he is forced to come out of retirement, and enlists his former sidekick Jeremy to help him flush out the hacker responsible.

programme.title: Karate Kid: Legends
programme.desc: Kung fu prodigy Li Fong moves to New York City with his mother and befriends his classmate, Mia. But Connor Day, a local karate champion, provokes Li and publicly humiliates him. Li seeks guidance from his mentor, the kung fu master Mr Han, who reaches out to Daniel LaRusso, convincing the original Karate Kid to teach Li the principles of Miyagi Karate. Drama sequel, starring Jackie Chan, Ben Wang and Ralph Macchio

programme.title: Lemony Snicket's A Series of Unfortunate Events
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy adventure based on the first three titles in the bestselling children's book series, starring Jim Carrey and Meryl Streep. After their parents die in a mysterious fire, three young siblings are entrusted to the care of their distant relative, the evil Count Olaf. An actor and master of disguise, he's prepared to go to any length to swindle them out of their family fortune.

programme.title: Ghostbusters: Afterlife
programme.desc: Supernatural comedy sequel starring Paul Rudd, Carrie Coon, Finn Wolfhard and Mckenna Grace. When penniless mother-of-two Callie moves into her dead father's Oklahoma farm, her 13-year-old daughter, Phoebe, notices unusual activity in the home. As Phoebe uncovers her grandfather's strange legacy, a ghostly menace threatens the nearby town, and a long-dormant entity seeks to free itself.

programme.title: Charlotte's Web
programme.desc: Family fantasy based on the classic book by EB White, starring Dakota Fanning and featuring the voices of Julia Roberts and Steve Buscemi. When little pig Wilbur is threatened with the smokehouse, spider Charlotte promises the farmyard runt he will live to see winter's first snowfall. Using her web-spinning talents, she comes up with an ingenious way to convince the farmer that Wilbur is worth saving.

programme.title: The Borrowers
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring John Goodman and Jim Broadbent. Pod, Homily and their children Peagreen and Arietty are the Borrowers, a family of tiny people living secretly in the house of young Pete. When Pete's Great Aunt Mary dies, no one can find the will and it looks as if the house may fall into the hands of nasty local lawyer, Ocious P Potter, and put the little family in danger.

programme.title: Jack the Giant Slayer
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Nicholas Hoult and Ewan McGregor. Humanity is put on the menu when a farm boy opens the gateway between our world and a fearsome giant race.

programme.title: How to Train Your Dragon
programme.desc: On the isle of Berk, where Vikings and dragons have been enemies for generations, young warrior Hiccup breaks tradition by forming an unlikely bond with Toothless, a feared Night Fury. Live action fantasy adventure, starring Mason Thames, Nico Parker and Gerard Butler

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Part-animated adventure starring Jason Lee as a struggling Los Angeles songwriter whose fortunes change when he accidentally brings home a trio of singing chipmunks called Alvin, Simon and Theodore. Together they achieve worldwide success, but it's not long before they discover that the music industry has a shady side.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
programme.desc: Part-animated adventure starring Justin Long and Jason Lee. Singing sensations Alvin, Simon and Theodore have to put aside their glittering career to face up to the reality of studying. But they and their new musical rivals, The Chipettes, must put their pop prowess to use in order to save the school's music programme by winning a battle of the bands competition.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure starring Jason Lee. High jinks while aboard a cruise liner leads to Alvin and his chipmunk pals being stranded on a remote island. But survival in this jungle paradise proves to be harder than they expected.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
programme.desc: The singing rodents mistakenly come to the conclusion that their human friend Dave intends to get rid of them when he proposes to his girlfriend in Miami. With only three days until Dave pops the question, the trio embark on a desperate road trip across America to sabotage his romantic plans. Family comedy sequel, starring Jason Lee and Kimberly Williams-Paisley

programme.title: The Karate Kid
programme.desc: Martial arts adventure starring Ralph Macchio. When Daniel LaRusso moves from New Jersey to California, he becomes a target for a bullying gang of teenagers. Knowing he must learn how to defend himself, he strikes up a friendship with a wise old Japanese man, who teaches him the secrets of karate. However, his bitterest enemy is also taking martial arts lessons and the scene is set for an explosive confrontation.

programme.title: The Karate Kid Part II
programme.desc: Martial arts adventure sequel starring Ralph Macchio. Following his success in an American karate championship, Daniel LaRusso travels with his teacher to his home island of Okinawa. There he finds himself facing his severest challenge.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Period horror adventure sequel starring Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz. When the young son of Rick O'Connell and his Egyptologist wife find an ancient bracelet that holds power over the armies of the fearsome Scorpion King, it attracts the attention of Meela, reincarnated lover of the resurrected high priest Imhotep, who needs the artefact to help him defeat the Scorpion King and become the ultimate ruler.

programme.title: Mexicali
programme.desc: Former fighter Joe helps run a Mexican farm with his partner, Estrella. After entering underground bouts to support the workers, he is ambushed by a gang and forced to fight for his life. Action thriller, starring Bren Foster and Tania Raymonde

programme.title: First Blood
programme.desc: Action drama starring Sylvester Stallone as drifter and ex-Green Beret John Rambo, who falls foul of the redneck sheriff of Hope, Oregon. Arrested and beaten, Rambo escapes and takes refuge in the local woods, ready to defend himself with deadly skills learnt during the Vietnam War.

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Hailee Steinfeld and John Cena. A troubled teen discovers that her beaten-up Volkswagen Beetle is really a robot in disguise. Together they must protect the Earth from the evil Decepticons while fleeing government agents.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure from director Michael Bay, starring Shia LaBeouf and Megan Fox. Unsuspecting teenager Sam Witwicky holds the key to the survival of the human race when alien enemies the Autobots and the Decepticons arrive on Earth and continue their war.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: Sci-fi action sequel starring Shia LaBeouf and Megan Fox. The ancient history of the Transformers' presence on Earth is revealed as the human race battles the first ever Decepticon, and once again Sam Witwicky is in the thick of the action.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Shia LaBeouf. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must spring back into action when a Decepticon, secretly planted on the Moon in the 1960s, becomes a clear and present danger. Not only is the technology contained within it potentially devastating to humankind, but Sam is also dealing with relationship problems.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Mark Wahlberg. Four years after the Battle of Chicago, the Autobots are now in hiding from the US government after being deemed a threat to humanity. So when struggling engineer Cade Yeager comes across an old semi truck while looking for parts, he soon finds himself on the radar of government forces and an alien bounty hunter.

programme.title: Transformers: The Last Knight
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Mark Wahlberg and Anthony Hopkins. When Optimus Prime returns to what is left of Cybertron, he is brainwashed by seductive leader Quintessa to return to Earth to obtain a mystical staff belonging to Merlin which will bring his home planet back to life.

programme.title: Justice League
programme.desc: Fantasy action adventure starring Gal Gadot and Ben Affleck. With an ancient demonic threat looming, Bruce Wayne, aka Batman, enlists the help of Diana Prince (Wonder Woman) to form a new superhero team. After adding Aquaman, Cyborg and The Flash to its ranks, the league faces its first challenge: resurrecting Superman.

programme.title: 300: Rise of an Empire
programme.desc: Ruler of the Persian empire and self-proclaimed god Xerxes continues his campaign to crush the emerging Greek nation, forcing a general from the democratic city state of Athens to lead his navy into battle against Xerxes' vast armada. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Sullivan Stapleton, Eva Green and Lena Headey

programme.title: Mexicali
programme.desc: Former fighter Joe helps run a Mexican farm with his partner, Estrella. After entering underground bouts to support the workers, he is ambushed by a gang and forced to fight for his life. Action thriller, starring Bren Foster and Tania Raymonde

programme.title: Bean
programme.desc: Comedy starring Rowan Atkinson as the accident-prone Mr Bean. In an attempt to get rid of him from his job as one of their attendants, the governors of the National Gallery send Mr Bean to America to represent them at the unveiling of the Grierson Gallery's new purchase. Needless to say disaster is never far away.

programme.title: Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again
programme.desc: Musical romantic comedy sequel starring Lily James, Amanda Seyfried and Jeremy Irvine and featuring the songs of Abba. A now happily married Sophie prepares to reopen her late mother Donna's hotel. Meanwhile flashbacks show a young Donna discovering Greece and falling in love - several times.

Writer/director Wes Anderson's comedy, starring Benicio del Toro, Mia Threapleton and Michael Cera

programme.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
programme.desc: Romantic comedy sequel starring Renée Zellweger, Hugh Grant and Chiwetel Ejiofor. Still mourning the tragic death of her husband, Bridget Jones starts a fresh chapter as a single mum. With the support of some old friends, including old flame Daniel Cleaver, she re-enters the world of dating, while also clashing with her son's dashing but uptight science teacher, Scott Wallaker.

programme.title: The Deb
programme.desc: A young farmer hopes a debutante ball will transform her life. Her city cousin arrives after being expelled from school and scoffs at the traditions. As they search for dates, the teenagers challenge each other's assumptions. Comedy musical, starring Natalie Abbott, Charlotte MacInnes, and Rebel Wilson, who also directed

programme.title: Yesterday
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy starring Himesh Patel and Lily James. Cycling home after a gig, aspiring musician Jack is hit by a bus during a strange power cut. He wakes up to find himself in a world where nobody has heard of the Beatles, so takes advantage of this by passing their songs off as his own. Success soon comes his way, but it threatens to come between him and his manager and best friend, Ellie.

programme.title: Bride Wars
programme.desc: Comedy with Anne Hathaway and Kate Hudson. Best friends Emma and Liv have vowed to marry one day in New York's Plaza Hotel - but when the time comes to plan their respective weddings, a clerical error means they are both booked at the venue on the same day. With neither willing to budge, the pair engage in attempts to sabotage each other's big day.

programme.title: Bridesmaids
programme.desc: Comedy starring Kristen Wiig and Rose Byrne. After Lillian announces her engagement, she asks her lifelong pal Annie to be her maid of honour. However, Annie's life is in a mess, and she finds herself losing control over the bachelorette party to Lillian's seemingly perfect new friend Helen.

programme.title: Grimsby
programme.desc: Spy spoof starring Sacha Baron Cohen and Mark Strong. Nearly 30 years after they were adopted by different families, brothers Norman "Nobby" Butcher and Sebastian meet again. But the reunion proves to be fraught with problems now that one is an international spy and the other has stayed true to his hard-drinking, working-class, football-hooligan roots.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Satirical comedy of suburban paranoia starring Tom Hanks. Ray Peterson's peace of mind is being eroded by the seemingly sinister goings-on next door. Are the mysterious Klopeks really neighbours from hell, doing dastardly deeds at the dead of night? Or are they just quiet people minding their own business? The "good people" of Mayfield Place are determined to discover the hideous truth.

programme.title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
programme.desc: Comedy starring Gene Wilder and Richard Pryor. A bookie is shot and fatally wounded by a mysterious woman while visiting the news-stand of deaf former actor Dave Lyons and his blind assistant Wally. Before dying, the bookie secretes what appears to be a rare coin in the stand's cash box. Dave and Wally are subsequently arrested for murder and embark on a chaotic quest to prove their innocence.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Comedy starring Dudley Moore, Liza Minnelli and John Gielgud. Playboy Arthur Bach spends money like water and drinks like a fish, and will flush his chances of inheritance down the drain unless he marries a respectable heiress. But, for better or for worse, Arthur falls for impoverished Linda Marolla instead.

programme.title: Big Daddy
programme.desc: Comedy starring Adam Sandler. When his latest girlfriend dumps him because she says he is not a responsible adult, 32-year-old Sonny Koufax tries to win her back by adopting the illegitimate five-year-old son of his friend Kevin, who's on a trip to China.

programme.title: Tootsie
programme.desc: A New York actor's difficult reputation has rendered him unemployable. When a TV soap advertises a new female role, he disguises himself as a woman for the audition - and wins the part. But the character proves so popular, he is forced to keep up the pretence indefinitely. Comedy, starring Dustin Hoffman, Jessica Lange and Bill Murray. Directed by Sydney Pollack, who makes a cameo appearance as Hoffman's agent

programme.desc: Comedy starring Steve Martin and Kathleen Turner. Brain surgeon Dr Michael Hfuhruhurr uses his pioneering skills to save beautiful but deadly Dolores Benedict following an accident. The two are soon married, but not happily so, and on a trip to Vienna he falls in love with a disembodied brain.

programme.title: Police Academy
programme.desc: Comedy starring Steve Guttenberg. The new mayor of an American city decides to change the rules to allow anyone to join the police force. The decision proves to be a recipe for unadulterated chaos.

programme.title: Police Academy 2: Their First Assignment
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Steve Guttenberg. Given 30 days to halt the crime wave in his precinct, Captain Pete Lassard recruits six rookie cops from his brother's police academy. But the rookies' ineptitude and an ambitious lieutenant soon put Lassard's job in jeopardy.

programme.title: Police Academy 3: Back in Training
programme.desc: Comedy starring Steve Guttenberg. When cutbacks mean the closure of one of the state's two police academies, both institutions become locked in a desperate battle for survival.

programme.title: The Man with Two Brains
programme.desc: Comedy starring Steve Martin and Kathleen Turner. Brain surgeon Dr Michael Hfuhruhurr uses his pioneering skills to save beautiful but deadly Dolores Benedict following an accident. programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey, Courteney Cox and Sean Young. Eccentric investigator Ace Ventura is hired to discover who is behind the mysterious kidnapping of the Miami Dolphins football team mascot, a dolphin called Snowflake, just a week before the Super Bowl.

programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey. Ace Ventura is traced to a Tibetan monastery by British diplomats, who want him to recover a stolen sacred Great White Bat in order to prevent a tribal war breaking out in Africa.

programme.title: Jaws 3
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Dennis Quaid and Louis Gossett Jr. Sheriff Brody's sons are working at a new marine park, where a captive infant great white shark is being groomed as the centre's latest tourist attraction. However, no one has reckoned on the creature's vengeful mother.

programme.title: King Ivory
programme.desc: Tulsa narcotics cop Layne West is locked in a battle with the city's criminal underworld. When his son becomes addicted to fentanyl, West teams up with his partner Ty and FBI agent Beatty to bring down those responsible. Thriller, starring James Badge Dale and Ben Foster

programme.title: Kill
programme.desc: A train to New Delhi becomes a combat battleground as one spec-ops commando faces off against a terrorist militia to save his girlfriend. Hindi action, starring Lakshya, Raghav Juyal, Tanya Maniktala and Abhishek Chauhan

programme.title: Nightcrawler
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Jake Gyllenhaal, Rene Russo and Riz Ahmed. Los Angeles loner Louis Bloom makes a living hustling, until one night he observes a freelance news photographer taking photos of a horrific car accident. Inspired by this nocturnal, dog-eat-dog world of "nightcrawling", Bloom buys a video camera and spends his evenings in pursuit of accidents, robberies and fire scenes. However, as Bloom's scoops earn ever-more lucrative payment from local news stations, the line between reporting news and becoming part of it becomes dangerously blurred.

programme.title: The Girl on the Train
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestselling novel, starring Emily Blunt and Rebecca Ferguson. Divorce is made all the more painful for Rachel Watson because her morning commute takes her past the home where her ex-husband lives with his new wife. Rachel becomes curious about an attractive couple living close by, and her interest develops into an obsession when the woman is declared missing. Although convinced she may know something about the disappearance, Rachel's strained emotional state and a history of alcohol abuse make her story hard to believe.

programme.title: King Ivory

The gangster's accountant hires a trio of crooks to take his boss's millions, while a rock star with a penchant for faking his own death causes further mayhem by stealing a valuable painting. Guy Ritchie's crime comedy, starring Gerard Butler, Tom Wilkinson and Thandie Newton

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: Spy action thriller, the first sequel to The Bourne Identity, starring Matt Damon. Ex-CIA agent Jason Bourne, still suffering memory loss following an accident, finds his life in danger when he is implicated in the killing of an agent in Berlin.
