programme.desc: Spy action thriller, starring Matt Damon, Julia Stiles and Joan Allen. When an article about a covert CIA operation appears in The Guardian, trained assassin Jason Bourne sets off for London to meet the journalist behind the exposé who may be able to shed light on Bourne's past. But his former employers are also on the trail with instructions to make sure that the meeting never happens.

programme.title: Mr & Mrs Smith
programme.desc: Romantic action comedy starring Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie. Dissatisfied married couple John and Jane Smith live an outwardly respectable existence in suburbia, but they are soon shocked to discover their similar secret - they are both sophisticated professional assassins and their next lethal assignment is to kill one another.

programme.title: Drop
programme.desc: A widowed mother's first date in years takes a chilling turn when she's bombarded with anonymous threatening phone messages during their dinner, leaving her questioning if her charming suitor is behind the harassment. Director Christopher Landon's thriller, starring Meghann Fahy and Brandon Sklenar

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: Political thriller starring Harrison Ford and Willem Dafoe. When Jack Ryan is asked to investigate the murder of a friend of the US President, he finds himself up against not only a Colombian drugs cartel but also corrupt American government officials.

programme.title: Boyz N the Hood
programme.desc: Urban drama starring Larry Fishburne, Ice Cube and Cuba Gooding Jr. South Central Los Angeles, 1984: young Tre's mother decides it would be in his best interest to live with his estranged but disciplined dad. Seven years on, he has managed to steer clear of the drugs and the violence but, as the teenage gang wars begin to invade his neighbourhood, it becomes almost impossible for him and his friends to avoid trouble.

programme.title: A Big Bold Beautiful Journey
programme.desc: New York bachelor David is due to drive to his friend's wedding, but a wheel clamp on his vehicle derails those plans. He acquires a new drive from the mysterious Car Rental Company managed by two nameless agents, who are oddly familiar with his dating history. At the wedding, David meets fellow singleton Sarah and squanders an opportunity to dance with her. On the way home, the rental car's GPS asks him if he would like to embark on a big bold beautiful journey. When David agrees, the virtual assistant guides him to Sarah and they follow a winding route between physical doors that open into episodes from their respective pasts. Romantic drama, starring Colin Farrell and Margot Robbie

programme.title: Empire of the Sun
programme.desc: Second World War drama based on the novel by JG Ballard, starring Christian Bale and John Malkovich. When the Imperial Japanese army marches into Shanghai in December 1941, the privileged life 11-year-old Jim Graham enjoys with his family in the city's International Settlement comes to an end. In the ensuing turmoil, Jim is separated from his parents.

programme.title: Quartet
programme.desc: Comedy drama based on Ronald Harwood's play, directed by Dustin Hoffman and starring Maggie Smith, Tom Courtenay and Billy Connolly. At the Beecham House retirement home for opera singers, the occasion of Verdi's birthday is always marked by a special fundraising concert. But this year the arrival of one particular grande dame throws preparations into chaos as egos clash and old resentments surface.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Musical based on the hit stage show, starring John Travolta and Olivia Newton-John. Unexpectedly reunited with summer love Danny at her new high school, Sandy Olsson can't believe how different he is. Can the new Danny Zuko, the leather-clad, tough-talking leader of the T-birds, really be the boy she met down at the beach? Perhaps Frenchy and Rizzo, both members of the super-cool Pink Ladies gang, can help her develop some street cred to win back his heart.

programme.title: Ferrari
programme.desc: Biographical drama starring Adam Driver and Penélope Cruz. Enzo Ferrari and his wife Laura have equal shares in their car-manufacturing company, but their marriage is in tatters following the death of their son, while the business is in financial peril. With the 1957 Mille Miglia endurance race looming, Enzo seeks victory for Ferrari, whatever the cost.

programme.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
programme.desc: Biographical music drama starring Rami Malek. London, 1970: living with his parents, Farrokh Bulsara dreams of becoming a rock star. So when local group Smile loses its lead singer, he convinces guitarist Brian May and drummer Roger Taylor to give him a shot. With the addition of bassist John Deacon and Bulsara changing his name to Freddie Mercury, the band Queen is born - but the path to world domination is a bumpy one.

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: Musical drama based on the Broadway show, starring Jamie Foxx, Beyoncé Knowles, Eddie Murphy and Oscar winner Jennifer Hudson. Three singers from Detroit known as the Dreamettes are put on the road to success by ruthless manager Curtis Taylor Jr. But his ambition to make the Dreamettes global stars soon takes its toll on the girls.

programme.title: The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Asa Butterfield, Jack Scanlon and David Thewlis. After his Nazi officer father is given a promotion, young Bruno and his family are moved from Berlin to a remote house in the countryside. With nothing to do and no friends of his own age, Bruno becomes curious about a nearby building known as "the farm" and its oddly clothed inhabitants.

programme.title: I, Tonya
programme.desc: Comedy drama based on a true story, starring Margot Robbie and Sebastian Stan. Figure skater Tonya Harding defies her detractors to rise to the top only to suffer an ignominious fall when she becomes embroiled in a plot to attack her rival, Nancy Kerrigan.

programme.title: The Pursuit of Happyness
programme.desc: Drama based on a true story, starring Will Smith and featuring Jaden Smith. After his wife walks out, downtrodden medical salesman Chris Gardner is left to bring up his five-year-old son alone. The situation worsens when the pair are made homeless, but Gardner refuses to be beaten. Gaining a prestigious though unpaid stockbroker internship, he doggedly chases his dream of a better life.

programme.title: Eleanor the Great
programme.desc: After a devastating loss, sharp-witted, defiant 94-year-old Eleanor Morgenstein tells a story that spirals into a dangerous reality. Director Scarlett Johansson's drama, starring June Squibb, Erin Kellyman and Chiwetel Ejiofor

programme.title: Deep Impact
programme.desc: Science-fiction drama starring Robert Duvall, Téa Leoni and Morgan Freeman. A reporter believes that she has discovered a sex scandal in the US government. As it turns out, "Ele" isn't a mistress, but something used to describe an event so cataclysmic that it could destroy the planet.

programme.title: The Last Starfighter
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Lance Guest and Dan O'Herlihy. Alex is a bored teenager who lives with his mother and young brother in a trailer park. The chance for adventure comes when Starfighter, the video game he plays, becomes reality.

programme.title: Logan's Run
programme.desc: Science-fiction thriller starring Michael York and Jenny Agutter. In the 23rd century, people live under vast domes in a world with no disease, hunger or greed. But nobody is allowed to live past 30 without going through a ritual called "renewal", where only a few survive.

programme.title: Bugonia
programme.desc: Satirical thriller starring Emma Stone and Jesse Plemons. Conspiracy theorist Teddy and his impressionable cousin Don kidnap biomedical company CEO Michelle and chain her up in the basement of their rural home. Over the next few days, Teddy proceeds to interrogate and torture Michelle in the hope of forcing a simple confession: that she is an emissary from a hostile extraterrestrial race and can take him to her leader.

programme.title: Assassin's Creed
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Michael Fassbender and Marion Cotillard. An Assassin descendant must explore his genetic memories to end the ancient war between his clan and the Templars. Travelling back in time to 15th-century Spain, he gathers the skills and powers he needs to defeat his enemies in the present day.

programme.title: Riddick
programme.desc: Sci-fi thriller starring Vin Diesel. Abandoned on a derelict planet, outlaw warrior Riddick must fight for survival against vicious alien predators. His only way of escape is to activate a distress beacon left behind by mercenaries.

programme.title: Cold Storage
programme.desc: When a lethal contagious fungus escapes a secret lab, two young employees, joined by a grizzled bioterror operative, must survive the wildest night shift ever. Director Jonny Campbell's comedy thriller, starring Joe Keery, Georgina Campbell, Liam Neeson and Lesley Manville

programme.title: Star Trek
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Chris Pine and Zachary Quinto. Rebellious youth James Kirk is persuaded to join the Starfleet Academy, where he befriends Dr Leonard "Bones" McCoy and clashes with officer Spock. When an evil Romulan arrives from the future, the young crew of the USS Enterprise find themselves in the thick of the action.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 1
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Jennifer Lawrence. Having survived two Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen is taken to the underground District 13. There she meets the rebel leader President Alma Coin who asks the inspirational Katniss to become a spearhead in their push against the might of the Capitol.

programme.title: Deep Impact
programme.desc: Science-fiction drama starring Robert Duvall, Téa Leoni and Morgan Freeman. A reporter believes that she has discovered a sex scandal in the US government. As it turns out, "Ele" isn't a mistress, but something used to describe an event so cataclysmic that it could destroy the planet.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 2
programme.desc: Finale to the action adventure series, starring Jennifer Lawrence. Despite her importance as a figurehead to the rebel cause, Katniss puts her life on the line to join the front lines on an assault on the Capitol. However, President Snow has some nasty surprises waiting for them, while Peeta's brainwashing makes him increasingly unpredictable.

programme.title: Men in Black II
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy sequel starring Will Smith and Tommy Lee Jones. When evil alien queen Serleena threatens Earth's safety, former intergalactic secret agent Kay holds the secret to her destruction. However, Kay is now living a civilian life as a post-office worker and his memory of the past has been erased. Can his former partner Jay persuade him to rejoin the sharp-suited Men in Black and save the world?

programme.title: Men in Black 3
programme.desc: Science-fiction comedy starring Will Smith and Josh Brolin. The fight against aliens is taken to a new dimension when Agent J is forced to travel back to 1969 in an effort to prevent his partner's murder by ruthless fugitive Boris the Animal.

programme.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
programme.desc: Science-fiction action thriller starring Linda Hamilton and Arnold Schwarzenegger. In 1998, with the apocalypse apparently averted following the events of Terminator 2: Judgment Day, humanity's saviour John Connor is targeted for assassination by a time-travelling T-800 cyborg. John's mother, Sarah, is once again thrust into the battle for Earth's future as a new artificial intelligence gains sentience.

programme.title: Alita: Battle Angel

With no memory of her past, Alita determines to find out what she can, while exploring the dark depths of Iron City. But when she's targeted by a vicious band of cyborg serial killers, Alita discovers she is a formidable fighter, a revelation that tips her into a dangerous new world.

programme.title: The Major and the Minor
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Ginger Rogers and Ray Milland. Susan Applegate, a grown woman, poses as a 12-year-old girl to get out of paying a full train fare. When she is taken under the wing of kindly army major Philip Kirby, however, Susan's small lie causes chaos at the local military academy - and romantic trouble for her new guardian.

programme.title: The Rare Breed
programme.desc: Western starring James Stewart and Maureen O'Hara. When Martha Price arrives in America from Britain, she brings with her a young daughter and an animal she hopes will make her fortune: Vindicator, a prize Hereford bull. She finds the Texas ranchers sceptical and Sam Burnett, the saddle tramp hired to deliver the bull to his new home, seems to be neither honest nor reliable.

programme.title: Ride Lonesome
programme.desc: Western starring Randolph Scott. When bounty hunter Ben Brigade seeks to bring a killer to justice, ostensibly to collect the reward, he meets up with two outlaws who have their own reason for wanting to turn in the wanted man.

programme.title: Flamin' Hot
programme.desc: Drama based on a true story, starring Jesse Garcia. In the 1980s, a Mexican-American janitor at snack company Frito-Lay works to develop a recipe that he can pitch to his bosses: a spicy flavouring for Cheetos. But even if the company agrees to make the product, will it sell?

programme.title: Battleship
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Liam Neeson, Taylor Kitsch, Alexander Skarsgård and Rihanna. Three ships, which are part of an international fleet on manoeuvres near Hawaii, are cut off by a force field when alien craft attack. As the fighting intensifies, it soon becomes clear the crews are fighting for the survival of the Earth itself.

programme.title: Rescue Dawn
programme.desc: Action drama based on a true story, starring Christian Bale and Steve Zahn. During the Vietnam War, German-born US bomber pilot Dieter Dengler is on a mission over Laos when he is shot down and captured. But though he is tortured, half-starved and incarcerated in a prison camp deep in the jungle, Dengler is determined to escape.

programme.title: Smile

Therapist Rose Cotter has a traumatising ordeal when one of her patients, who claims to be stalked by an ominous supernatural force, suddenly takes her own life during a session. Rose comes to believe that the patient's suicide has passed on a deadly curse - but is Rose really in danger, or is it all in her head?

programme.title: The Hunter's Prayer
programme.desc: A drug-addled assassin goes rogue, opting to protect rather than take out his latest target. Action thriller, starring Sam Worthington, Odeya Rush and Allen Leech

When enforcement officer John Preston forgets his own dosage, he discovers a rebel group keeping art and literature alive. Under threat from the government, can he help them survive?

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: Buying goods from the comfort of home

Two law officers transport a wanted murderer to prison, only for the fugitive to be kidnapped by a mercenary pilot hoping to claim the reward. The bounty hunter and his hostage flee into the slipstream, a vast canyon carved out by the winds that is home to a mysterious religious cult, with the cops in hot pursuit. But he soon discovers his prisoner isn't what he appears to be. Sci-fi thriller, starring Bill Paxton, Bob Peck and Mark Hamill

programme.title: Monster Hunters

programme.title: Hey You What If?
programme.desc: On the face of it, humans are a bit breakable. We have these hard skeletons that can crack if you have a tumble. But if we were indestructible, like a superhero, then we'd never have to worry about ending up in plaster! So what's the best way? First we try removing the problem - it's our bones that break, so let's get rid of them altogether. Unfortunately, this doesn't work very well. Without our bones we'd basically be blobs and unable to move anywhere. Okay, metal is tough right? How about taking inspiration from knights in armour, and making our skin solid metal? The problem with metal is that if you hit it hard enough it will actually bend. So, your metal skin would soon be covered with dents and you'd end up completely bent out of shape. What we need is something that can take the knocks without changing shape permanently. What we need is something like rubber, something 'elastic.' Elastic materials deform when you hit or stretch them but then they spring back to their original shape. In fact, there are new man-made elastic materials that can stretch up to a 100 times longer! If we were made of elastic, we'd be very hard to break but there would be a down-side. We'd be very, very bouncy and if we weren't careful we'd end up crashing around the house like an oversized rubber ball and breaking everything around us. Of course, we could always make our house elastic too?

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc:
Tha a h-uile duine sa chròileagan ag ionnsachadh mar a dh'fhàsas iad cinn-ughach le biolair an-diugh ach chaneil foighidinn aig Bing. Tha e a' cur cus uisge air agus tha e ri tuiteam às a chèile. Tha aige an uairsin ri tòiseachadh a-rithist.
Everyone at the creche is learning how to grow eggy heads with cress today, but Bing is impatient and over-waters his and it falls apart. He then has to start all over again.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc:
Chaneil duine toilichte aig taigh Sula an-diugh far a bheil pàrtaidh dhèideag a' gabhail àite - oir tha iad a' dol a-mach air a chèile nuair a tha Bullabaloo a' faighinn barrachd cèic na Hopadaidh. Ach, le taic bho Amma, tha iad ag ionnsachadh mar a dhèiligeas iad len cuid fearg.
Nobody is happy at Sula's toy party as a result of Bullabaloo getting more cake than Hoppity. Thankfully, Amma is on hand to teach them how to deal with their anger.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc:
Ann an turas sgoinneil eile, tha Hari a' dol air tòir 'map'. Tha e a' lorg scutair agus frith-rathad fhad's a tha e ga lorg, ach am bi aige air 'map' fhaighinn agus faighinn a-mach dè tha e a' dèanamh?
In another 'aba-doo-be-dee' adventure, Hari goes in search of a map. He comes across a scooter and a pathway as he explores the area, but will he be able to find out what a map looks like and what it does?

programme.title: Cleasan Àtaidh & Tilidh (The Adventures of Abney & Teal)
programme.desc: It is extremely windy. Neep has a wonderful time flying through the air on a whirligig. Abney and Teal go to see Bop who blows a giant bubble for each of them so they can join in. They go higher and higher and higher, which Abney is not too sure about

programme.title: 'S E Iasg a Th'Annam (I'm a Fish)

programme.title: Triuir aig Tri
programme.desc: Della is worried about how to pay the mounting bills at Number 3

programme.title: Seonaidh (Shaun the Sheep)
programme.desc:
Nuair a tha Seonaidh 's an treud a' mothachadh gun do ghoid dà thunnag na plaideachan aca airson dachaigh ùir, chofhurtail a chruthachadh air mullach taigh-chon Bitzer, tha an t-sabaid a' tòiseachadh gus cùisean a chur cheart.
When Shaun and the flock discover that a pair of nesting ducks have stolen their bedding to make a comfy new home on top of Bitzer's kennel, the battle is on to set things straight.

programme.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan (Bottersnikes and Gumbles)
programme.desc: When the Bògaisean have been destructive, the Gumbalan have a plan to avenge them. Sona also still has a trick or two

programme.title: Seòid a' Chidsin - The Kitchen Coves
programme.desc: Roddy cooks up Caribbean chicken with rice and peas and a Hungarian goulash with dumplings, while Uisdean rattles off a five-minute steak dish and a tasty pan-fried hake with mussels

programme.title: Ath-thogail Notre-Dame (Rebuilding Notre-Dame)
programme.desc: In April 2019, a huge fire consumed Notre-Dame's roof, taking down its arrow, piercing its vaults and weakening its walls. A year after the fire, archaeologists and scientists examined the battered stones, unveiling the construction secrets laying behind the highest vaults of Christendom. This programme reveals how they worked with hundreds of craftsmen to restore the French monument to its former glory

programme.title: Aig an Taigh le Abigail
programme.desc:
A very heartwarming and satisfying Miso Cod dish is prepared by Abigail. A perfect light lunch!
Tha Abigail ag ullachadh truinnsear sàsachail is togarrach de Throsg Miso. Lòn aotrom air leth!
In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Secrets and Spies: A Nuclear Game
programme.desc: In 1985, a very tense time, a young Mikhail Gorbachev is instated as the new leader of the Soviet Union. East and West have been publicly stockpiling nuclear weapons for decades, neither side wanting to appear weak. Plus, the spying game threatens the first tentative moves towards peace

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: The actress explores the history, food and culture of Provence, starting in the port city of Marseilles. She shares a spicy 'half-and-half' pizza with local chef and rising star Valentin Ruffali before heading to La Ola to try a delicious blend of French and North African cuisine courtesy of chef Khouloude Ben Thayer. Eva then heads out into the sun-kissed landscape to try the traditional summer vegetable dish of ratatouille and a sun-drenched salad niçoise on the Riviera at the famous Hotel du Cap

programme.title: Time
programme.desc: The possibility of romance and an opportunity at work make Bailey question his choices, and he turns to Marie-Louise in a moment of need. She receives the sign she hss been waiting for, but debates whether she is able to take a risk. Meanwhile, new evidence complicates loyalties between Peter and his friends, driving tensions higher, and James confronts his fears

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Jules Hudson is in Kent with Londoners Rob and Dani, who are hunting for a new family home for them. Their choices include homes old and new, as well as a mystery house that turns things upside down. Away from the search, Jules ventures inside a staggering 51-acre greenhouse filled with tomatoes and peppers

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Family team of four Phil, Helen, Kathy and Nick take on the challenge. One by one, they cross the bridge, stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies. Ross Kemp hosts

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Frances Tophill is tackling jobs in the autumn garden and introduces plants that keep colour and interest going for as long as possible. Jamie Butterworth delves into the fascinating world of shade-loving plants, and Ashley Edwards joins sound artist Jason Singh for an unusual journey through the garden, Plus, A couple have designed a garden around an elaborate miniature railway

programme.title: Politics Live
programme.desc: The latest stories from Westminster and beyond

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc:
Game show presented by Rick Edwards in which players score points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: The Answer Run
programme.desc: Jason Manford hosts the fast-paced quiz show where three couples face a series of 50/50 questions which hurtle down the Answer Run towards them. Across three rounds, the couples build up their cash pots, but only one pair can face the Final Run and earn the opportunity to take home their cash prize

programme.title: The Boss
programme.desc: Susan Calman hosts the quiz in which one contestant is put in control and has to use judgement and tactics to decide which of the other players is best suited to answer

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo heads to Birmingham's Curzon Street for a tour of the HS2 terminus, which is still under construction. He also visits Firmin and Sons, the oldest private manufacturing firm in the UK, which dates back to 1655 and is still making buttons for the royal family and the military

programme.title: The Great House Revival
programme.desc: Carlow man Tommy McDonald's childhood dream of restoring cottages down the lane from his family home comes to life when he and partner Emily Lewis decide to transform the ruinous property into their first home. Hugh Wallace follows their progress, which is far from easy as Tommy, who has no building experience, has decided to tackle the project himself, and starts the build without a project plan

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team visit Victoria Baths in Manchester. Among the finds on display are an art deco cigarette case bought at a car-boot sale, a machine that was designed to cure any illness through electrical impulses, and an ornate pedestal worth a small fortune. First shown in 2007

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Presenter Paul Martin and antiques experts Adam Partridge and Will Axon visit Ickworth House, an Italianate palace near Bury St Edmunds in Suffolk. Among the items valued are a chinoiserie travelling clock found at the back of a wardrobe and a campaign writing box that raises the roof when it goes to auction. Plus, Paul meets the people trying to safeguard the future of the Suffolk Punch horse, which holds a unique place in the history of the county

programme.title: House of Games

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor dishes up all the behind-the-scenes gossip with a panel of Strictly celebrities, and Johannes Radebe swings by for a chat. Plus, costume designer Vicky Gill is back with an exclusive look at what the couples will be wearing at the weekend

programme.title: Gymnastics: World Championships 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage of the men's all-around final, held this year at Rotterdam Ahoy, the Netherlands. Daiki Hashimoto of Japan won his third successive title, and his fifth World Championships gold overall, in this event last year in Jakarta, with China's Zhang Boheng claiming silver and Noe Seifert of Switzerland taking third place

programme.title: Surgeons: At the Edge of Life
programme.desc: At Royal Papworth Hospital, cardiothoracic surgeon Aman Coonar takes on a challenging case. His patient, 30-year-old Dannee, developed a persistent cough early in 2020. She had a rare type of tumour in her bronchus - the airway that leads to the lung. Aman must operate right up against the pulmonary artery - one of the biggest blood vessels in the body - where the slightest damage could cause a torrential bleed

programme.title: Scrum V: The Warm Up

programme.title: Uncanny
programme.desc:
Danny is joined by Julian for what could be one of the scariest and most unsettling cases he's ever investigated. After Julian's family moved into a new house in Crofton near Wakefield in the early 90s, tragedy struck his family on multiple occasions, and a malign presence taking the form of a towering, terrifying shadow man seemed to appear to him and many of his friends.
Danny looks into the cultural history of shadow figures, from Inuit folk history to modern internet phenomena, and asks Ciaran and Evelyn to help him unpack Julian's unsettling account. Could these folkloric tales actually be based on facts?

programme.desc: Sandra reflects on a secret Gerry once shared with her and realises she is in possession of volatile information. Police drama set in Belfast, starring Andi Osho and Richard Dormer

programme.title: Mush-Mush and the Mushables

programme.desc: The Heffernans are given an unwanted anniversary gift by the Palmers, and resort to pretending they have been burgled in a bid to rid themselves of it. American comedy, starring Kevin James, Leah Remini and Jerry Stiller

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Ray is annoyed to discover Marie is plying his brother with gifts of scented candles and massage oils. However, his mood changes when he deduces her real motive - to put Robert in a romantic mood, in the hope he will provide her with grandchildren

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Amy's brother Peter turns to Ray for advice on talking to women, while Debra decides to help out by throwing a party and inviting all her single friends

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: While serving a community service order for speeding, Roz develops a reputation at a retirement home as the 'angel of death' after everyone she takes care of dies. Disturbed by the events, she turns to Frasier for advice. Guest starring James Earl Jones

programme.desc: Frederick visits Seattle and asks Frasier to take part in the radio station softball game, leaving him with only two days to learn to play the sport. Meanwhile, Niles becomes jealous of his nephew, who has developed a crush on Daphne

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Roz auditions for a position as the host of a radio show. After Frasier mentions to his agent Bebe that he would be sad to see his producer go, she tells the station manager that the psychiatrist will quit if Roz is hired. Comedy, guest starring Harriet Sansom Harris

programme.title: The Great House Giveaway
programme.desc: Simon O'Brien presents, as plasterer Stuart and student Reece get paired up to renovate a two-bedroom red brick terrace in Derby. programme.title: Countdown
programme.desc: Colin Murray, Rachel Riley and Susie Dent host, with Mark Radcliffe in Dictionary Corner, as contestants race against the clock to pit their wits against words and numbers

programme.title: A Place in the Sun
programme.desc: Liz and Noel fell in love with Tenerife 15 years ago and have been going back every year since. With 200 miles of stunning coastline, southern Tenerife is an extremely popular part of the island, making it a very attractive place for house-hunters. The pair are after a home from home to escape the British cold and enjoy the Canarian winter sun. Laura Hamilton shows them the best of what their £320,000 budget can buy, from a cosy apartment in Los Cristianos to a Golden-mile gem

programme.desc: In the Dordogne, Lizzy and Pascal's village party planning almost goes awry. And in Italy George is coping with the challenges of breathing new life into a one-euro house

programme.desc: The B&Bers are glamping again on the final visit, at Phil and Jane's site in Derbyshire, where the stag-gering views include real-life deer wandering about the place

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: On the fourth day in and around Norwich, chatty mobile hairdresser Sarah is confident that her menu of family favourites will be a cut above the rest. With an evening full of bedroom surprises, hair-raising ghostly conversations and extravagant singing and dancing, she hopes to have done enough to bag the £1,000 prize

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun: Where Are They Now?

The trio are determined to escape reality with one last night out but as the night spirals, long-buried tensions surface

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As Dad takes Bluey and Bingo on an early morning wagon ride to the park, Bluey can't wait to get to her beloved monkey bars. But her patience is tested when Dad keeps stopping to chat to his friends. Frustrated, Bluey keeps interrupting the grown-ups' conversations. Dad instructs her to be polite but it's not until she observes Bingo playing happily that Bluey sees she can play her own games along the way too. The next time Dad stops to chat near a bus stop, Bluey creates her own bus game with Bingo, roping Dad in to play. No longer in a big rush, Bluey learns to relax and enjoy the journey.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: It's a rainy day, and Bluey has set up a taxi service inside. Her first fare is a stressed-out businessman (Dad) who needs to get to the airport immediately! Bluey assures him there will be no delays, but then immediately picks up passenger number two, a rich lady (Bingo) and her child, Millicent (Floppy). Between the roundabout directions of the SATNAV (Mum), Millicent vomiting all over him and the taxi finally breaking down, Dad decides to head to the airport on foot. He boards the plane in the nick of time, only to discover that the other passenger is the rich lady and the pilot is Bluey!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When mum goes for a walk by herself along the beach, Bluey runs to catch up with her, keen to share a shell she has found. Pretending to be a mermaid who has finally got her legs for the day, she embarks on a precious solo adventure, following Mum's footprints along the shoreline. Along the way she encounters a surfer, some pesky seagulls, a cast of crabs, a washed-up jellyfish and a rather large and nervous pelican. Having experienced what it's like to be on your own for the first time, Bluey reunites with Mum and they listen to the shell, before walking back down the beach together.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Bluey, Bingo and their young friend Missy turn the hammock swing at the playground into a pirate ship, Mum narrates as Dad whips up a wild storm. But it all proves too much for Missy who gets scared and abandons ship. Mum can't persuade Missy to conquer her fears and re-join them, especially when Bluey and Bingo are swallowed by a big blue Daddy whale. But when Missy has an idea to save her friends in the whale's stomach, she digs deep, finds her courage and jumps on board, ready to tickle the beast and free her shipmates. And Dad obliges and spits them all up, ready for more adventures.

programme.title: Bluey

Bluey revels in her victory a little too much, and a sad Bingo quits their game. When Mum tells Bluey, she has to choose between being right or keeping Bingo happy, Bluey finds a third option - teaching Nana how to floss! Under Bluey's instruction, Nana becomes a flossing expert and Bingo is soon back in the game.

programme.title: Bluey

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Gloria refuses to let her heavy pregnancy stop her from throwing Manny a surprise 14th birthday party, so she and Jay team up to make it happen. Meanwhile, Cam becomes jealous while watching Mitchell walk down the playroom aisle with Lily, and Claire hatches a plan to get rid of denim outfitter Kenny from the Dunphy household

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Mr Burns throws a party to celebrate Independence Day, but uses the event to exploit his employees. programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: A film about a sexy tango expert inspires Lisa to take up dancing, but she discovers she is not very good at it. Bart and Milhouse skip summer camp to avoid school bully Nelson and end up hiding in the local shopping centre, making Chief Wiggum believe it is infested with huge rats

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Lisa develops a crush on school bully Nelson, while Homer gets hold of an automatic dialling device used by telemarketing companies and uses it to bombard the people of Springfield with calls asking for money

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine

programme.title: First Dates
programme.desc: Thirty-four-year-old plumber Jamie hasn't had a proper girlfriend for almost 10 years. His date, Leigh, is seeking someone muscley and good with his hands. Shelly is a 57-year-old personal trainer who has been single for seven years. Her date is David, a 61-year-old retired firefighter who's been single for four years. Father-of-two Nathan has had a successful career in sales. His date Lisa seeks someone 'nicer' than the guys she usually dates. Last into the restaurant is 27-year-old steampunk enthusiast Joe. programme.title: Gogglebox

programme.title: Celebrity Undercover Boss USA

programme.title: Celebrity Undercover Boss USA

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: In West Yorkshire, former tour rep Janine and her singing salesman husband Steve begin the competition with a German-themed menu. programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: In Nottinghamshire, Nena and her husband Vish kick off the competition with an Indian feast. Finally it's the turn of Vicki and her husband Paul to try to see off the competition and bag themselves the £1,000 prize

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Lee is the first to admit he's something of a reluctant groom. He's way more interested in partying than planning his wedding to Anna. Will his Vegas stag derail the whole thing?

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride

programme.title: Storage Wars

programme.title: Storage Wars

programme.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
programme.desc: Science-fiction action thriller starring Linda Hamilton and Arnold Schwarzenegger. In 1998, with the apocalypse apparently averted following the events of Terminator 2: Judgment Day, humanity's saviour John Connor is targeted for assassination by a time-travelling T-800 cyborg. John's mother, Sarah, is once again thrust into the battle for Earth's future as a new artificial intelligence gains sentience.

programme.title: Alita: Battle Angel
programme.desc: Science-fiction action adventure starring Rosa Salazar and Christoph Waltz. On a future Earth, Dr Dyson Ido reawakens a dormant cyborg and names her "Alita". With no memory of her past, Alita determines to find out what she can, while exploring the dark depths of Iron City. But when she's targeted by a vicious band of cyborg serial killers, Alita discovers she is a formidable fighter, a revelation that tips her into a dangerous new world.

programme.title: The Major and the Minor
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Ginger Rogers and Ray Milland. Susan Applegate, a grown woman, poses as a 12-year-old girl to get out of paying a full train fare. When she is taken under the wing of kindly army major Philip Kirby, however, Susan's small lie causes chaos at the local military academy - and romantic trouble for her new guardian.

programme.title: The Rare Breed
programme.desc: Western starring James Stewart and Maureen O'Hara. When Martha Price arrives in America from Britain, she brings with her a young daughter and an animal she hopes will make her fortune: Vindicator, a prize Hereford bull. She finds the Texas ranchers sceptical and Sam Burnett, the saddle tramp hired to deliver the bull to his new home, seems to be neither honest nor reliable.

programme.title: Ride Lonesome
programme.desc: Western starring Randolph Scott. When bounty hunter Ben Brigade seeks to bring a killer to justice, ostensibly to collect the reward, he meets up with two outlaws who have their own reason for wanting to turn in the wanted man.

programme.title: Flamin' Hot
programme.desc: Drama based on a true story, starring Jesse Garcia. In the 1980s, a Mexican-American janitor at snack company Frito-Lay works to develop a recipe that he can pitch to his bosses: a spicy flavouring for Cheetos. But even if the company agrees to make the product, will it sell?

programme.title: Battleship
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Liam Neeson, Taylor Kitsch, Alexander Skarsgård and Rihanna. Three ships, which are part of an international fleet on manoeuvres near Hawaii, are cut off by a force field when alien craft attack. As the fighting intensifies, it soon becomes clear the crews are fighting for the survival of the Earth itself.

programme.title: Rescue Dawn
programme.desc: Action drama based on a true story, starring Christian Bale and Steve Zahn. During the Vietnam War, German-born US bomber pilot Dieter Dengler is on a mission over Laos when he is shot down and captured. But though he is tortured, half-starved and incarcerated in a prison camp deep in the jungle, Dengler is determined to escape.

programme.title: Smile
programme.desc: Horror starring Sosie Bacon. Rose comes to believe that the patient's suicide has passed on a deadly curse - but is Rose really in danger, or is it all in her head?

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers Go North

programme.title: Jamie's Air Fryer Meals

Now it's up to Tim Shaw and Fuzz Townshend to get this Dino - which has been rusting in a barn - back to its best. During the process, Tim takes a drive in one of the most beautiful cars in the world, and Fuzz gets his hands on a Ferrari racing engine for the first time

programme.title: Heartland Docs

programme.title: Wonders of the Ocean
programme.desc: The wild Pacific covers one third of our planet. It has the most volcanoes, the biggest earthquakes, deepest trenches, and the most islands on Earth. Found in icy sub-Antarctic waters, tropical coral seas, and still smoking volcanic arcs, there is no such thing as a typical Pacific island. The wildest and most bizarre creatures have evolved to thrive on these unique Islands of Life, often surviving nowhere else on Earth.

programme.title: Wonders of the Ocean
programme.desc: The ocean is full of wonders, but creating them has been a bloody battle for over half a billion years, as evermore complex animals fight for survival. They evolved new ways to hunt, overpower and kill and eat each other. And astonishing adaptations to defend themselves, hide and escape detection. Passing those amazing new abilities on to the next generation can be a bruising battle in itself as males fight each other for the right to mate.

programme.title: Pole to Pole with Will Smith
programme.desc: Will struggles in bone-chilling winds in the South Pole, where temperatures can drop below -100°F. He skis, treks and climbs across giant icefields and cliffs with the support of one of the world's best polar athletes, Richard Parks. In one of the planet's most isolated research stations, scientists take ice cores deep under the surface and make incredible sacrifices to pursue their research.

programme.title: Pole to Pole with Will Smith
programme.desc: Will, a man scared of spiders his whole life, ventures deep into the Ecuadorian Amazon in search of deadly creatures. Joined by professor Bryan Fry and local mountaineer Carla Perez, they abseil 200 feet into a cave network known as the "womb of the Earth," to discover the giant tarantula. Using cutting-edge techniques, they extract its venom, which could hold the key to saving millions of lives.

programme.title: Pole to Pole with Will Smith
programme.desc: Will, Bryan and Carla join local Waorani elder Penti Baihua in the Amazon, in search of the world's biggest snake: the giant green anaconda. They carefully remove just one scale from the 17-foot snake's skin. Will's fear turns into relief, then joy. The single scale can reveal the health of the entire ecosystem - crucial for the future of both wildlife and the Waorani.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: When blizzards bring chaos to Norway's roads, Thord and his A-Team battle to save a jack-knifed truck. Bjoern is in trouble when a driver with no snow-skills causes gridlock - and can't pay up. In the far north, Jo Roger returns from injury to face a fifty-seven ton mega-truck that threatens to tip over.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: After the death of her mother, Motshidi is starving and alone. In a terrifying reunion with her father, she has everything to lose. A violent traitor rises in the rotten ranks, challenging the selfish princess and bringing an end to Mmamotse's rule. programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.
First into the workshop is Margaret Brier from Yorkshire. She's hoping electronics wizard Mark Stuckey can bring an old homemade gramophone back to life. Now little more than a box of bits, the gramophone was built by Margaret's grandfather Harry Bates in the late 1800s. Harry was ahead of his time, a natural-born engineer with a talent for fixing anything, known in Yorkshire as a 'knackler'. Mark calls in help from the Repair Shop's very own 'jack of all trades', Dom Chinea, to remake the missing papier-mâché horn. Meanwhile, Mark works on reviving the flagging gramophone motor. Together the duo restore the voice of this silent gramophone and get it playing once more.
The next visitor to the barn is 19-year-old Charlotte Hughes, also from Yorkshire. She's hoping ceramics expert Kirsten Ramsay can help her atone for an accident that left her mother's piggy bank smashed and shattered into pieces. A well-intentioned attempt to mend it has left unsightly cracks and a gaping hole in piggy's cheek. Along the way he's also lost his cork and trotters. Charlotte is desperate to make it up to her mum, Liz, who was understandably upset when she discovered this important memento from childhood was broken. Ceramics restorer Kirsten Ramsey has her work cut out to undo the old repairs and stabilise the cracks. Working her magic to perfect the piggy bank in time for Liz and Charlotte to return to collect it.
Finally, Jay Blades and Brenton West welcome Teresa Oates, and her partner, Ron, to the barn. Theresa wants silversmith Brenton to restore an antique to help someone very dear to her. The couple have brought in a Prussian helmet, the 19th-century German ceremonial helmet is a family heirloom. Teresa's dad, Edward, was a D-Day veteran and soldier during the Allied occupation. He brought the tarnished memento home when he returned from service and Teresa and Ron are hoping that by restoring the helmet they may help Edward (who is suffering from dementia) refresh his memory. Leather expert Suzie Fletcher steps in to create a new skull and chin strap, while Brenton works to revitalize the rusting and tarnished helmet, achieving a stunning transformation.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.
First at the barn is Andy Crook from Cornwall. His hopes for restoring a very special inheritance rests on musical instrument expert Pete Woods. The rather tarnished tuba belonged to his late father, Frank. Both he and Andy played in various brass bands over the years and shared a real love for performing. Andy discovered the tuba in his mother's loft after decades of believing it was long gone. He dreams of being able to play his beloved dad's instrument. However, the tuba has been rendered mute from damage caused over 30 years ago - a crucial valve is missing, and a leaking joint makes this fix a tricky one for Pete.
Horologist Steve Fletcher's skills are really put the test when Kamal from Cheshire arrives with her family's mantel clock. Her Sikh parents came from India just after the second world war and, although it was a struggle for them to settle in Yorkshire, they made a happy life and Kamal is hugely proud of them. The clock was the beating heart of their household. She clearly remembers the sweet chime and she yearns to hear it once again. After years of being stored in the basement of her childhood home and only recently unearthed, the metal encased clock is in a bad way, but Steve rolls up his sleeves and brings it back to life.
And silversmith Brenton West is intrigued by an Asian curiosity brought in by Tracy Lavery and her daughter Zoe. The bronze pot is in the form of a lion dog with a hinged head and is thought to have been designed for burning incense. It joined Tracey's family when her grandfather brought it back from his worldly travels and has been passed from mother to daughter ever since. It's been used as a money pot mainly and has captivated each family member. However, at the ripe old age of at least one hundred, he is desperate for an over haul - his tail has detached, his hinge is broken and he's cracked in places but fortunately he's in safe hands with Brenton.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.
First through the barn doors is Sue Lock, with her daughter Hannah. They have brought Sue's grandmother's leather midwifery bag. They fear the battered old bag is a hopeless case, but Susie Fletcher believes she can nurse it back to life. Sue's grandmother worked selflessly for decades as a midwife, delivering hundreds of babies during air raids and in the early years for the NHS. She inspired generations of women in her family to seek careers within medicine, and for that Sue and Hannah are very proud.
Next, art conservator Lucia Scalisi has the pleasure meeting Alice Bird from Devon, who has brought in one of her late father's artworks. Robin Rae was a prolific artist and was still painting into his nineties. The piece, which depicts several figures and is entitled The Storyteller, was painted when Robin was just 21 years of age. Alice was gifted the painting when she was a similar age, and it has followed her throughout her life. However, it incurred extensive damage when it was transported to France, much to Alice's despair.
The day's final visitors are mother and daughter Cheryl and Dawn Sandford. They have come to meet jeweller Richard Talman, carrying a precious family keepsake that belonged to Cheryl's beloved nan. The gold brooch holds a picture and a lock of hair from her favourite brother, Billy, whose life was lost serving in the First World War. The brooch is so damaged it can no longer be worn, but Cheryl would love to enjoy it and pass it down to her daughter and granddaughter when the time comes.
