programme.title: The Beasts
programme.desc: Thriller starring Marina Foïs and Denis Ménochet. Olga and Antoine move from their native France to a small village in the Galician countryside. But their new neighbours do not take kindly to foreigners, and when the couple take a stance against a local land sale the low-level hostility takes a turn toward violence.

programme.title: Saving Lives at Sea
programme.desc: On the Northumberland coast, a 999 call comes in from a distressed woman whose husband is drifting out to sea on a paddleboard - the Seahouses crew race out to locate him. In Moelfre, north Wales, when a crew member at the station spots a kayak capsizing, the lifeboat launches to pluck the fishermen from the water. Out on the English Channel, a French vessel makes a distress call

programme.title: DIY SOS
programme.desc: The team are in Southampton where they come to the aid of deaf couple Ahmed and Rifat, whose dream home became a nightmare after a rogue builder abandoned the project. With three young children, no savings left and living on a building site, they need their home to work for their family's needs - so Nick Knowles and the team call on the local community to transform both the house and the family's future

programme.title: Glorious Gardens from Above
programme.desc: Horticulturist Christine Walkden visits Essex, where she experiments with triangular planting and has tea and cake at Beth Chatto Gardens. Plus, at RHS Hyde Hall she moves rocks with a former student, and then sails across the Thames to the Blackwater Estuary

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Charlotte Smith and Joe Crowley visit Yr Wyddfa, Wales' highest mountain, to meet the people caring for its landscape and keeping more than 600,000 visitors a year on the move. Joe joins volunteers tackling litter and discovers efforts to protect rare alpine plants and the elusive Snowdon beetle, while Charlotte goes behind the scenes at Wales' highest cafe. Plus, Tom Heap investigates how organised crime gangs are targeting the countryside

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: Dougie Vipond heads west to the Morvern peninsula in Lochaber to find out how the Ardtornish Estate is balancing farming and stalking with nature restoration. Anne Lundon is on a shoot in Glenshee with a portrait photographer using Scotland's landscape as her backdrop, while Leanna Fernandez is near Kingussie to encounter misunderstood bloodsucking creatures that are being saved from extinction. Plus, Rosie Morton visits a dairy farm near Peterhead that diversified and created new markets for its milk

programme.title: The Best of Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: Derek Brockway remembers his favourite three walks around north Wales, including climbing three peaks in the Cadair Idris mountain range and taking an icy dip in a glacial lake. Derek recalls a visit to the Italianate village of Portmeirion, where he also discovered 'Y Gwyllt' - 'the wild' headland beyond, and his walk along the Dee Valley Way, a stunning 13-mile route which took him from the pretty town of Corwen to its larger and more bustling neighbour, Llangollen

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
programme.desc: Matt Tebbutt presents more highlights, with recipes by Bryn Williams, Julie Lin and Poppy O'Toole, while actors Bryan Cranston and Marianne Jean-Baptiste battle it out for their food heaven

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: The actress explores the history, food and culture of Brittany with her Breton guide Tanguy Thomassin , heading to the vast oyster beds of Cancale, with the region still supplying half of France with the seafood. Brittany also boasts plentiful sardines, kelp forests, spiny crabs and the rare cobalt blue lobster

programme.title: Moose in the Glen: Natural World
programme.desc: Multi-millionaire landowner Paul Lister's plan to turn his 23,000-acre estate north of Inverness into Europe's first wilderness reserve, reinstating Caledonian pine forests and releasing animals including moose, wild boar and brown bears. However, foot and mouth, red tape and local opposition threaten his dream

programme.title: Gymnastics: World Championships 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage of the concluding apparatus finals on the final day of the annual event, held this year at Rotterdam Ahoy, the Netherlands. The women's floor discipline is among those taking place today and Great Britain's Ruby Evans and Abigail Martin took silver and bronze respectively in Jakarta last year, with Japan's Aiko Sugihara winning the title. Also being held this afternoon are the men's vault, parallel bars and horizontal bar, and the women's balance beam

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin presents from Gloucester as experts Philip Serrell and Michael Baggott discover some rare gems among the antiques and collectibles brought to the city's cathedral.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Compilation episode following chart stars Peter Andre, Martin Kemp and Sinitta as they swap the studio for the saleroom to take part in the antiques buying challenge. They are guided by Paul Laidlaw, Margie Cooper and Tim Medhurst - but who will get to be top of the profit-making pops?

programme.title: Wilderness with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: Simon travels across Mongolia, the most sparsely populated country on Earth and home to some of the most brutal and beautiful landscapes on the planet. Six times the size of the UK but with fewer than 3.5 million people, Simon wants to find out how wild nature and nomadic traditions like hunting with golden eagles still shape everyday life, all while searching for the elusive snow leopard

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: The actress explores the history, food and culture of Alsace, a region that sits between Germany and France and has a cuisine to match, In Strasbourg, Eva stops off at Brasserie Le Tigre for a beer and a creamy tarte flambée, before heading to her guide Coralie Andt's restaurant Au Pont Corbeau, where French wines can be enjoyed with cheese, sausage and sauerkraut cooked in Riesling wine

programme.title: The Balkans: Europe's Forgotten Frontier
programme.desc: In the second of two documentaries, BBC Europe editor Katya Adler travels to Romania, Kosovo and Serbia. In Romania, she visits what will soon be Nato's largest European base thanks to its strategic significance. Her next stop is Europe's youngest country, Kosovo, where she meets ethnic Serbs who insist the country is still Serbian. In Serbia itself, she visits discovers a battle for power taking place with the West, Russia and China all wanting Serbia to be in their sphere of influence

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Bob and Paul return for more angling adventures, beginning by travelling to the Ribble in Lancashire for one last trip with their canine pal Ted, who died shortly after this programme was filmed. With the river in good health, Paul and Bob hope to catch a good chub or a mighty barbel on this stretch of the water

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: Hollywood star Bill Murray travels around the Republic of Ireland and Northern Ireland, combining golf with a search for his Irish roots. In Kinsale, Co Cork, chance encounters turn a simple walk into an adventure, while Bill's golf writer friend Tom Coyne tries to keep things on track

programme.title: Later... with Jools Holland
programme.desc: Taking to the stage at Alexandra Palace Theatre in north London are Royal Blood, Moses Boyd, Shygirl, Kingfishr and Ayanna Witter-Johnson. Black Sabbath guitarist Tony Iommi chats to Jools at the piano about his musical beginnings, his memories of bandmate Ozzy Osbourne and new album From the Dark, his first solo LP in 21 years. Jools also marks the 20th anniversary of Amy Winehouse's album Back to Black with a dip into the archives to remember her performance on the show in 2006

programme.title: Misery
programme.desc: Psychological thriller based on the novel by Stephen King, starring James Caan and Kathy Bates. In a remote area of the Colorado Mountains, successful novelist Paul Sheldon is injured in a car accident and taken in by ex-nurse Annie Wilkes, a devoted fan of Sheldon and his fictional heroine Misery Chastain. But events take a sinister turn when the novelist allows Wilkes to read a proof of his latest book.

programme.title: Sisu
programme.desc: Second World War action thriller starring Jorma Tommila. Finland, late 1944: stoic, battle-worn Aatami Korpi toils in the wild as a lone prospector. While transporting a hefty bounty of gold nuggets, Aatami is accosted by a Nazi platoon who discover his wares. He initially escapes and the Nazis go in hot pursuit, but they soon discover that their prey is no ordinary miner.

programme.title: Formula 1 United States Grand Prix Qualifying Highlights
programme.desc: Lee McKenzie and Alice Powell present action from the battle for grid positions for the 18th round of the season, which takes place at Circuit of the Americas in Austin, Texas

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay tries to help a struggling seafood restaurant in Manhattan, where the three owners regularly come into conflict as they each try to assert their authority over the business, causing confusion for all. When one of the trio stubbornly resists the changes the Scottish chef is hoping to implement, sparks begin to fly

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Fiery chef Gordon Ramsay comes to the aid of the owners of Hannah & Mason's, a French bistro in Cranbury, New Jersey. Members of staff complain their pay cheques bounce, and the kitchen cooler is so unhygienic that Gordon makes the decision to close the restaurant on Valentine's Day - the busiest night of the year

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: In Manchester, drama producers Henry and Tom are first to host with a traditional British menu. The second dinner party, hosted by design-loving Vinnie and Tanz, sees three types of lamb, while the hosts for the final evening are Shahab and Asia, who try to impress their foodie guests with a globally inspired menu that divides opinion. Whose soiree will secure the cash prize of £1,000?

programme.title: Location, Location, Location
programme.desc: Kirstie Allsopp is in the Home Counties with Harvie and Ranjit, who have had one of the longest searches she has ever tried to crack. With a staggering £1.6m budget, it seems like it should be simple but the couple confess to having viewed and rejected nearly 100 properties. Phil Spencer has a challenge of a different sort. Zosia and David have saved hard for their first home and have been living Zosia's parents while they search. They have their hearts set on the popular town of Hitchin and Phil thinks that might be partly why their £380,000 remains unspent

programme.title: Kirstie's House of Craft
programme.desc: Kirstie Allsopp makes a fun garland from paper, a spring wreath and a string-art hot-air balloon

programme.title: Petite Maman
programme.desc: Fantasy drama starring Joséphine Sanz and Gabrielle Sanz. Eight-year-old Nelly joins her mother, Marion, in cleaning out the rural home of her recently deceased grandmother. This documentary series sees them embark on a mission to discover what aspects of modern life they are getting right but more often are getting wrong. Travelling the length and breadth of the UK behind the wheel of an electric car, Will and Ralf laugh, cry and learn more about themselves and each other in a few weeks than they ever have in two decades of friendship. Along the way, they meet a series of extraordinary characters, explore unexpected worlds, and push themselves well out of their comfort zones. Whether trying to impress the World’s Strongest Woman with their strength, talking to nettles in an eco-village, living like Stone Age cavemen or stripping naked in front of 1,000 women, Will and Ralf challenge themselves and each other to learn new things and to push themselves to do and be better. Along the way, stuck in the car for hours with only a satnav and a bespoke playlist to distract them, they bond not just through reminiscing about the good old days and indulging in in-car karaoke, but also through talking about where they are now as middle-aged men and opening up to each other

programme.title: Immortal Egypt with Joann Fletcher
programme.desc: Archaeologist and historian Joann Fletcher explores the story of Ancient Egypt and begins with a search of the building blocks that made he civilisation so enduring. She discovers how its people changed from primitive farmers to pyramid builders in just a few centuries, and finds early evidence for Egypt's gods and its obsession with death and the afterlife. She also reveals how the first writing was used to calculate taxes and examines Egypt's first pyramid - one of the world's earliest stone structures

programme.title: Immortal Egypt with Joann Fletcher
programme.desc: The professor explores one of Saqqara's last pyramid complexes to illustrate how Ancient Egypt's 'Pyramid Age' came to an end. A worsening climate combined with political upheaval, famine and economic difficulties to plunge the state into a dark era of civil war, with the land dividing into smaller city-states headed by ambitious small-town leaders. In an obscure tomb in Thebes, she uncovers the stories of warriors who fought in the bloody battle that would eventually lead to Egypt's reunification, and reveals how settlers known as the 'Hyksos' tried to infiltrate the fledgling nation's government to seize the throne

programme.title: Immortal Egypt with Joann Fletcher
programme.desc: Joann explores the peak of ancient Egyptian civilisation by looking at the Colossi of Memnon, two massive stone statues depicting Pharaoh Amenhotep III, and examining the lives of the workers and artisans involved in the building of the Valley of the Kings. This golden age was threatened by the growing power of Karnak's priests, and Joann reveals how Tutankhamen's early death was a chance for Egypt to start afresh and rewrite history, but was undermined by decades of state-sanctioned looting of the tombs

programme.title: Immortal Egypt with Joann Fletcher
programme.desc: The historian reveals hows Egypt's enemies exploited a country weakened by internal strife, travelling south to Sudan to examine the story of the forgotten Nubian kings, who ruled Egypt from their southern homeland for a century, even building their own pyramids to bury their monarchs. She then explores how the next group of invaders the Saites took the tradition of mummification to new extremes by preserving millions of animals, before Alexander the Great came to Egypt's rescue and founded the greatest city on Earth

programme.desc: When a gang of animal crooks set out on what should be a simple con, they're swept into a train robbery. It falls to Falcon, a small-time raccoon thief, and Rex, a by-the-book police dog, to put their differences aside and protect the passengers aboard a runaway high-speed train. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Wyatt Bowen and Daniel Brochu

programme.title: Tafiti - Across the Desert
programme.desc: A young meerkat's grandpa is bitten by a snake, so he sets off to find a magical flower for the cure. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Cosima Henman, Steve Hudson and Kathleen Renish

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview - Oct 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: Grand Prix of Europe
programme.desc: A young mouse with big dreams seizes her chance to race in the Grand Prix disguised as her hero. Animated animal adventure, with the voices of Gemma Arterton, Hayley Atwell and Lenny Henry

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure. When the secret formula for the addictive Krabby Patty is stolen by pirate Burger Beard, Mr Krabs seconds SpongeBob to head into the live-action world and get it back. But will the dastardly pirate give it up without a fight?

programme.title: The Pirates! In an Adventure with Scientists!
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman Animations, featuring the voices of Hugh Grant, David Tennant and Martin Freeman. Pirate Captain may be the leader of a shambolic crew of buccaneers but he's still determined to win the coveted Pirate of the Year competition, even if it means fighting off fearsome rivals Black Bellamy, Peg-Leg Hastings and Cutlass Liz to see who can amass the most booty.

programme.title: Happy Feet Two
programme.desc: Musical animated adventure sequel featuring the voice of Elijah Wood. Mumble and his son Erik must rescue their friends and family in the aftermath of a natural disaster.

programme.title: The Boss Baby
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voice of Alec Baldwin. When a seven-year-old boy discovers that his baby brother is a spy on a secret mission, he joins forces with his suit-wearing, briefcase-carrying sibling to defeat an evil businessman.

programme.title: Minions
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voice of Sandra Bullock. The film charts the history of the diminutive yellow sidekicks as they seek to serve the biggest villains around - everyone from Dracula to Napoleon, all the way up to their introduction to Gru, their evil leader in Despicable Me.

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Search for SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob journeys to the ocean's depths to face the Flying Dutchman's ghost, encountering challenges and uncovering marine mysteries. Animation, with the voices of Tom Kenny, Bill Fagerbakke and Mark Hamill

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voices of Jack Black, Dustin Hoffman and Angelina Jolie. Ancient China: Po the Panda lives in the Valley of Peace and dreams of becoming a kung fu master despite the fact he is clumsy, overweight and a complete beginner at martial arts. So when he's accidentally chosen to be the legendary Dragon Warrior, he is overjoyed. However, his joy is short-lived as the evil snow leopard Tai Lung has escaped from captivity and is on his way to the Valley to take his revenge on Po's mentor.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda 2
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure sequel with Jack Black as the voice of martial arts master Po. In order to stop the plot of evil peacock Lord Shen, Po must embark on a journey to discover the truth about his childhood.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda 3
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventurel featuring the voices of Jack Black, Angelina Jolie and Dustin Hoffman. Dragon Warrior Po is forced to face his destiny when he discovers his long-lost father and comes up against a villain from the Spirit Realm, who is collecting the chi energy of all the kung fu masters.

programme.title: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voices of Bill Hader and Anna Faris. Misguided inventor Flint Lockwood creates a machine that can turn water into food. But what initially seems like the answer to his community's economic crisis soon begins to cause some unexpected problems.

programme.title: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs 2
programme.desc: Animated comedy with the voices of Bill Hader and Anna Faris. Flint Lockwood's mutating machine is no longer turning water into food but producing food/animal hybrids, or foodimals, which very quickly overrun his home town.

programme.title: Chicken Run
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure, with the voices of Julia Sawalha, Jane Horrocks, Miranda Richardson and Mel Gibson. A clutch of hens, led by head chick Ginger, suffers life on a grim 1950s egg farm. When the avaricious owners decide to move into the meat-pie business, the chickens fear the worst. With the help of American rooster Rocky, the birds start to plan a prisoner-of-war-style escape.

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep Movie
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman. Shaun's plan to have a lazy day on Mossy Bottom Farm backfires when a cunning ruse sees the Farmer end up lost in the Big City. Shaun and the flock set off to find him, but to succeed they will have to avoid capture by an eager animal control officer, with nothing but elaborate disguises and quick wits.

But business turns sour when a huge, mysterious beast begins destroying every garden in the area.

The extraterrestrial visitor is friendly enough, but when it transpires that a government agent is on its trail, Shaun the Sheep and friends come up with a plan to help the newcomer get back home.

programme.title: Hancock
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Will Smith, Charlize Theron and Jason Bateman. The life of superhero John Hancock is on the skids; despite having saved countless lives, he's mostly remembered now for destroying property while flying around drunk. But after he rescues PR executive Ray Embrey from the path of a train, Hancock is offered the chance of repairing his tarnished image.

programme.title: Fuze
programme.desc: An unexploded Second World War bomb is discovered on a busy construction site in the centre of London. Chaos ensues as the military and police begin a mass evacuation. Drama, starring Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Theo James, Gugu Mbatha-Raw and Sam Worthington

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Sam Neill and William H Macy. Dr Alan Grant is persuaded by a seemingly wealthy couple to accompany them on a sight-seeing flight over the dinosaur-inhabited Isla Sorna. But he soon discovers that he has been used as a pawn in a game that will once again bring him face to face with the giant reptiles.

programme.title: Shenandoah
programme.desc: Western starring James Stewart and Doug McClure. Loner Charlie Anderson keeps his family out of the Civil War, even though there is fighting a few miles from his Virginia farm. But when his new son-in-law joins the Confederate army and his youngest son is captured by Federal troops, Charlie finds he can no longer ignore the conflict.

programme.title: The 7th Voyage of Sinbad
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Kerwin Mathews. Blown off course to the monster-infested island of Colossa, Sinbad and his crew rescue a sorcerer from the clutches of a cyclops. The voyage continues to Baghdad, but the sorcerer has been forced to leave stolen property behind, and hatches a wicked plan to force Sinbad to return to Colossa.

Historical action adventure starring Gerard Butler, Lena Headey and David Wenham. When the fiercely ambitious King Xerxes of Persia plans to invade Greece, King Leonidas mobilises his personal bodyguard of 300 Spartan warriors to defend the pass at Thermopylae.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure from director Michael Bay, starring Shia LaBeouf and Megan Fox. Unsuspecting teenager Sam Witwicky holds the key to the survival of the human race when alien enemies the Autobots and the Decepticons arrive on Earth and continue their war.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: Sci-fi action sequel starring Shia LaBeouf and Megan Fox. The ancient history of the Transformers' presence on Earth is revealed as the human race battles the first ever Decepticon, and once again Sam Witwicky is in the thick of the action.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Shia LaBeouf. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must spring back into action when a Decepticon, secretly planted on the Moon in the 1960s, becomes a clear and present danger. Not only is the technology contained within it potentially devastating to humankind, but Sam is also dealing with relationship problems.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Mark Wahlberg. Four years after the Battle of Chicago, the Autobots are now in hiding from the US government after being deemed a threat to humanity. So when struggling engineer Cade Yeager comes across an old semi truck while looking for parts, he soon finds himself on the radar of government forces and an alien bounty hunter.

programme.title: Transformers: The Last Knight
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Mark Wahlberg and Anthony Hopkins. When Optimus Prime returns to what is left of Cybertron, he is brainwashed by seductive leader Quintessa to return to Earth to obtain a mystical staff belonging to Merlin which will bring his home planet back to life.

programme.title: 300: Rise of an Empire
programme.desc: Ruler of the Persian empire and self-proclaimed god Xerxes continues his campaign to crush the emerging Greek nation, forcing a general from the democratic city state of Athens to lead his navy into battle against Xerxes' vast armada. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Sullivan Stapleton, Eva Green and Lena Headey

programme.title: Insidious: The Last Key
programme.desc: Supernatural horror starring Lin Shaye. Psychic Elise Rainier returns to her childhood home, where she must confront her own past traumas in order to exorcise the property.

programme.title: Scream 7
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott-Evans, one of the survivors of the original Ghostface killers, has built a new life in the quiet town of Pine Grove, far from Woodsboro, with her 17-year-old daughter Tatum. A lethal new stalker emerges with a diabolical plan that involves targeting Tatum and everyone that Sidney loves. Horror sequel, starring Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox and Isabel May

programme.title: The Woman in the Yard
programme.desc: Inside a rural farmhouse, painter Ramona Harris recuperates with a leg brace following a head-on car collision that claimed the life of her husband. Out of the blue, a woman in funereal garb materialises in a chair on the front lawn of the fixer-upper, and she has no intention of leaving. Psychological horror, starring Danielle Deadwyler, Peyton Jackson and Estella Kahiha

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview - Oct 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: Monster Family
programme.desc: Animated horror comedy featuing the voices of Emily Watson, Nick Frost Jason Isaacs and Jessica Brown Findlay. A witch's curse transforms an dysfunctional family into monsters: Mum becomes a vampire, Dad a Frankenstein's monster and the children a mummy and a werewolf. The family must work together to find the witch and reverse the curse.

programme.title: Monster Family 2
programme.desc: Baba Yaga and Renfield are captured by a monster hunter, so the Wishbone family once again transform into a vampire, Frankenstein's monster, a mummy and a werewolf in a bid to free them. Animated comedy, with the voices of Emily Watson, Jason Isaacs and Nick Frost

programme.title: M3GAN 2.0
programme.desc: Two years have passed since the robot M3GAN went rogue and almost killed her creator, engineer Gemma Forrester. M3GAN's specs are leaked to a defence contractor to create the ultimate undercover asset, an Autonomous Military Engagement Logistics and Infiltration Android, aka AMELIA. Like her predecessor, AMELIA becomes self-aware and rebels against her human masters with deadly force. Sci-fi thriller sequel, starring Violet McGraw, Jemaine Clement and Allison Williams

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: In 1838 Germany, Thomas Hutter is sent to the Carpathian mountains to secure the signature of enigmatic nobleman Count Orlok on a property sale in the German city of Wisborg. Thomas leaves his bride Ellen in the care of friend Friedrich Harding and his wife Anna. The young man barely survives the exhausting trip to Europe and stumbles home to find Ellen driven to delirium by a telepathic bond to the Count. Director Robert Eggers' version of the Dracula-inspired horror, starring Bill Skarsgard, Lily-Rose Depp, Nicholas Hoult and Aaron Taylor-Johnson

programme.title: Heretic
programme.desc: Psychological horror starring Hugh Grant, Sophie Thatcher and Chloe East. When young Mormon missionaries Sister Barnes and Sister Paxton visit the house of potential convert Mr Reed, he engages them in religious debate. However, his interest in doctrine takes a menacing turn when he traps them in his house and begins to reveal far darker intentions.

programme.title: Sinners
programme.desc: Period horror thriller starring Michael B Jordan. In 1932 Mississippi, enterprising twin brothers Elijah and Elias, aka "Smoke" and "Stack", prepare to set up a juke joint to serve their town's black community. But there's a nasty presence hanging around town on opening night, just waiting for the sun to go down.

programme.title: Final Destination: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Fifty-five years after her grandparents are involved in a disaster involving a restaurant tower, college student Stefani Reyes is plagued by recurring nightmares of the incident, and returns home seeking answers. The sixth entry in the supernatural horror saga, starring Kaitlyn Santa Juana, Teo Briones and Richard Harmon

programme.title: Zombieland
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Woody Harrelson and Jesse Eisenberg. Four mismatched people form a reluctant alliance in a world overrun by zombies and drive west, where they hope a Californian amusement park will be the ideal place to ride out the undead storm.

programme.title: Scream 7
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott-Evans, one of the survivors of the original Ghostface killers, has built a new life in the quiet town of Pine Grove, far from Woodsboro, with her 17-year-old daughter Tatum. A lethal new stalker emerges with a diabolical plan that involves targeting Tatum and everyone that Sidney loves. Horror sequel, starring Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox and Isabel May

programme.title: The Evil Dead
programme.desc: Sam Raimi's notorious cult horror starring Bruce Campbell. Five friends take shelter in a remote woodland cabin where they discover the Sumerian Book of the Dead and a tape containing mysterious incantations. But when they play the recording, they unwittingly unleash demons that have the power to possess the living.

programme.title: The Green Mile
programme.desc: Fantasy prison drama based on the novel by Stephen King, starring Tom Hanks and featuring Michael Clarke Duncan. Retired warder Paul Edgecomb remembers his time in charge of death-row inmates in a Louisiana penitentiary, and the strange powers of convicted child killer John Coffey.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview - Oct 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: Empire of the Sun
programme.desc: Second World War drama based on the novel by JG Ballard, starring Christian Bale and John Malkovich. When the Imperial Japanese army marches into Shanghai in December 1941, the privileged life 11-year-old Jim Graham enjoys with his family in the city's International Settlement comes to an end. In the ensuing turmoil, Jim is separated from his parents.

programme.title: You've Got Mail
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Meg Ryan and Tom Hanks as the owners of rival New York bookshops. When Joe Fox threatens to put Kathleen Kelly out of business, he shares his misgivings about the impending closure of her store and other personal secrets with an anonymous chat-room partner - and makes a startling discovery that only adds to his dilemma.

programme.title: Jerry Maguire
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Tom Cruise, Cuba Gooding Jr and Renee Zellweger. As a top agent at Sports Management International, Jerry Maguire knows his way around and is his own man... until one day he gets an attack of decency and finds himself out of a job. Now he must start from scratch. His only allies are a single mother, her cheeky young son and a second-rate player for the Arizona Cardinals.

programme.title: The Towering Inferno
programme.desc: Disaster movie starring Steve McQueen and Paul Newman. On the grand opening night of the world's tallest skyscraper, an electrical fault starts a fire in a storeroom. Panic takes a hold as the blaze begins to engulf the new tower and the fire department is called in for its toughest job yet.

programme.title: Escape to Victory
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Sylvester Stallone, Michael Caine and Pelé. As a propaganda stunt, the Nazis arrange a football match between the national German team and a squad made up of prisoners of war. However, the PoW team see the game as a chance to attempt an audacious escape.

programme.title: The Bodyguard
programme.desc: Romantic thriller starring Kevin Costner and Whitney Houston. Bodyguard and former secret serviceman Frank Farmer, still haunted by the assassination attempt on President Reagan, is asked to safeguard superstar singer and actress Rachel Marron who has been receiving death threats. But when Farmer visits Marron's luxurious home he is met with resentment from the singer and those around her.

programme.title: Terms of Endearment
programme.desc: Oscar-winning melodrama starring Shirley MacLaine, Debra Winger and Jack Nicholson. Aurora Greenway is an attractive widow whose main problems in life are fending off an alarming number of suitors and keeping her headstrong daughter Emma in check. But as the years pass by, Aurora's attitude to life and love, and her relationship with her daughter, begin to change.

programme.title: My Girl
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Dan Aykroyd, Jamie Lee Curtis and Macaulay Culkin. Tomboy Vada Sultenfuss is not only a hypochondriac, but also preoccupied with death - a condition not helped by the fact that she lives above a funeral parlour where her father Harry works as a mortician. When Harry employs Shelly to help in the mortuary, Vada is concerned that her father and Shelly will become involved. So, along with her best friend Thomas J, she sets out to spy on the couple.

programme.title: Stand By Me
programme.desc: Coming-of-age drama, based on a story by Stephen King, starring Wil Wheaton and River Phoenix. A writer looks back on his childhood in late-1950s Oregon, in particular the time when he and his friends set out to find the corpse of a boy believed to have been hit by a train.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Musical based on the hit stage show, starring John Travolta and Olivia Newton-John. Unexpectedly reunited with summer love Danny at her new high school, Sandy Olsson can't believe how different he is. Can the new Danny Zuko, the leather-clad, tough-talking leader of the T-birds, really be the boy she met down at the beach? Perhaps Frenchy and Rizzo, both members of the super-cool Pink Ladies gang, can help her develop some street cred to win back his heart.

programme.title: Little Fockers
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Ben Stiller and Robert De Niro. Greg Focker and his wife Pam are now the proud parents of twins, but their respective families are still interfering in their lives.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 2
programme.desc: Musical comedy starring Anna Kendrick and Rebel Wilson. Having been forcibly disbanded for disgracing themselves, a cappella group the Barden Bellas discover a get-out clause - all they have to do is win an international singing competition in Copenhagen.

programme.title: Spinal Tap II: The End Continues
programme.desc: Nigel Tufnel, David St Hubbins and Derek Smalls reunite after a 15-year break for one final concert. Their progress is charted once more by documentary maker Marti DiBergi, who offers perhaps too much perspective on their new direction. Comedy sequel, written by and starring Michael McKean, Harry Shearer, Christopher Guest and director Rob Reiner, in his final film. Kerry Godliman and Chris Addison also star with cameos by Paul McCartney, Elton John and Garth Brooks

programme.title: The Cinema List: Remakes (2026)
programme.desc: It's time to kick off your Sunday shoes with remakes in this edition of the Cinema List. From Footloose to The Italian Job, revisit familiar favourites with a fresh twist

programme.title: Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again
programme.desc: Musical romantic comedy sequel starring Lily James, Amanda Seyfried and Jeremy Irvine and featuring the songs of Abba. A now happily married Sophie prepares to reopen her late mother Donna's hotel. Meanwhile flashbacks show a young Donna discovering Greece and falling in love - several times.

programme.title: Singin' in the Rain
programme.desc: Classic musical comedy starring Gene Kelly, Debbie Reynolds and Donald O'Connor. Silent film stars Don Lockwood and Lina Lamont are the golden couple of 1920s Hollywood. However, when "talkies" become all the rage, prima donna Lina is shown up by the new technology and aspiring actress Kathy Selden is called in to dub her voice.

programme.title: Police Academy 2: Their First Assignment
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Steve Guttenberg. Given 30 days to halt the crime wave in his precinct, Captain Pete Lassard recruits six rookie cops from his brother's police academy. But the rookies' ineptitude and an ambitious lieutenant soon put Lassard's job in jeopardy.

programme.title: Bride Wars
programme.desc: Comedy with Anne Hathaway and Kate Hudson. Best friends Emma and Liv have vowed to marry one day in New York's Plaza Hotel - but when the time comes to plan their respective weddings, a clerical error means they are both booked at the venue on the same day. With neither willing to budge, the pair engage in attempts to sabotage each other's big day.

programme.title: The Phoenician Scheme
programme.desc: Wealthy businessman Zsa-Zsa Korda appoints his only daughter, a nun, as sole heir to his estate. As Korda embarks on a new enterprise, they become the target of scheming tycoons, foreign terrorists and determined assassins. Writer/director Wes Anderson's comedy, starring Benicio del Toro, Mia Threapleton and Michael Cera

programme.title: Shaun of the Dead
programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. On the day north London slacker Shaun decides to sort his life out, the dead rise and the city becomes overrun with zombies. Can Shaun and best mate Ed fight off the marauding hordes of the undead and win back Shaun's girlfriend? Or will they just go down the pub?

programme.title: We're the Millers
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jennifer Aniston and Jason Sudeikis. In order to repay a debt to his drug supplier, small-time pot dealer David Clark agrees to smuggle a shipment of marijuana across the Mexican border. However, to carry out the deception, David recruits a stripper and two teenagers to pose as his family.

programme.title: Instant Family
programme.desc: Comedy drama starring Mark Wahlberg, Rose Byrne and Isabela Moner. Childless couple Pete and Ellie Wagner decide to adopt, and are drawn to talented but troubled teenager Lizzy. When it turns out that Lizzy comes with two younger siblings, the prospective parents take in the whole brood - an act of kindness that soon proves overwhelming.

programme.title: Hot Fuzz
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. London policeman Nicholas Angel is reassigned to a sleepy rural village, but soon finds that the big city doesn't have a monopoly on crime.

programme.title: Paul
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. On their much anticipated road trip to America's notorious Area 51, two sci-fi geeks find themselves in the company of a real-life extraterrestrial who needs their help.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey. Ace Ventura is traced to a Tibetan monastery by British diplomats, who want him to recover a stolen sacred Great White Bat in order to prevent a tribal war breaking out in Africa.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: Comedy crime drama starring Brad Pitt, Jason Statham and Benicio Del Toro. In Antwerp, jewel thief Franky Four Fingers steals a huge diamond, but before he can deliver it to his New York boss he is ambushed in London by a Russian mobster's henchmen. Elsewhere in the capital, crimelord Brick Top demands that Irish boxer Mickey One Punch take a dive in an unlicensed fight. When Brick Top joins the hunt for the missing gem, mayhem ensues.

programme.title: A Clockwork Orange
programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's controversial futuristic vision, dramatised from the novella by Anthony Burgess and starring Malcolm McDowell. Imprisoned after the brutal murder of a woman, Alex, leader of a gang of sadistic thugs, agrees to undergo behaviour therapy designed to turn him against violence. However, when he is released back into the community, the results of the treatment prove to be costly for the reformed Alex.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Black History Month
programme.desc: Celebrate Black history through the power of cinema with unforgettable performances and stories, from Dreamgirls to Sinners and the stars who brought them to life

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Cold War action thriller starring Sean Connery, Alec Baldwin and Scott Glenn. The trial voyage of new Soviet submarine Red October does not go as expected. Equipped with an experimental new propulsion system that makes it virtually impossible to track and captained by the enigmatic Marko Ramius, the heavily armed vessel heads for America. Is Ramius about to launch an undetectable, pre-emptive nuclear strike?

programme.title: The Illusionist
programme.desc: Period romantic fantasy starring Edward Norton, Paul Giamatti and Jessica Biel. Vienna in the early 20th century: master magician Eisenheim is at the top of his game and the darling of the Austrian court. But despite his popularity, a local police inspector suspects that Eisenheim may be up to no good...

programme.title: The Bank Job
programme.desc: Heist thriller based on a true story, starring Jason Statham and Saffron Burrows. In 1970s London, Terry Leather, a car dealer with a dubious past, is approached by his glamorous former girlfriend Martine. She has a plan to steal safe deposit boxes from a top bank, and needs his help to organise the robbery. But the boxes contain more than just valuables, and Terry discovers that several dangerous individuals also want to get hold of them.

programme.title: How to Make a Killing
programme.desc: A man disowned by his wealthy family murders his relatives to ensure he is the only claimant for an inheritance. Writer/director John Patton Ford's black comedy inspired by Kind Hearts and Coronets, starring Glen Powell and Margaret Qualley

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: Comedy crime drama starring Brad Pitt, Jason Statham and Benicio Del Toro. In Antwerp, jewel thief Franky Four Fingers steals a huge diamond, but before he can deliver it to his New York boss he is ambushed in London by a Russian mobster's henchmen. Elsewhere in the capital, crimelord Brick Top demands that Irish boxer Mickey One Punch take a dive in an unlicensed fight. When Brick Top joins the hunt for the missing gem, mayhem ensues.

programme.title: The Perfect Storm
programme.desc: Action drama based on real-life events, starring George Clooney and Mark Wahlberg. When down-on-his-luck skipper Billy Tyne sets out in the Andrea Gail to fish the Grand Banks of the North Atlantic, he has little idea that he and his crew will soon encounter a storm of unprecedented ferocity.

programme.title: Red Dragon
programme.desc: Thriller based on the Thomas Harris novel that introduced Hannibal Lecter, starring Anthony Hopkins, Edward Norton and Ralph Fiennes.Called out of retirement to help track a serial killer known as "The Tooth Fairy", detective Will Graham is forced to turn to his old enemy, the imprisoned Lecter, to help him build a psychological profile of the killer. But as the case develops, the line between who is controlling whom becomes blurred.

programme.title: How to Make a Killing
programme.desc: A man disowned by his wealthy family murders his relatives to ensure he is the only claimant for an inheritance. Writer/director John Patton Ford's black comedy inspired by Kind Hearts and Coronets, starring Glen Powell and Margaret Qualley

programme.title: The Equalizer
programme.desc: Crime thriller based on the hit US TV series, starring Denzel Washington. On the face of it, Robert McCall is just an ordinary guy who works at a DIY store and leads a quiet life. But when McCall befriends a young girl controlled by ruthless Russian gangsters, he's unable to stand idly by and resorts to using skills from his shady former career.

programme.title: The Equalizer 2
programme.desc: Crime thriller starring Denzel Washington and Pedro Pascal. Now living a peaceful life, former Marine and government agent Robert McCall offers his singular skills pro bono to those in need. However, when his friend is killed under suspicious circumstances, McCall investigates, and uses any means necessary to see justice served.

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Oscar-winning western starring John Wayne as one-eyed US marshal "Rooster" Cogburn. When a young girl discovers that her father has been robbed and murdered, she persuades the hard-drinking Cogburn to track down the killer.

programme.title: Chalet Girl
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Felicity Jones and Ed Westwick. Attractive but under-achieving former skateboard champion Kim takes a job working in the chalets at an exclusive Alpine resort. She feels out of her depth among the affluent, but then Kim discovers snowboarding and with it the chance to win big money in a prestigious competition.

programme.title: Finding You
programme.desc: Violinist Finley Sinclair travels to an Irish coastal village to begin her semester studying abroad. At the B&B run by her host family, she encounters the gregarious and persistent heartthrob movie star Beckett Rush. Romantic drama, starring Rose Reid, Katherine McNamara, Vanessa Redgrave, Jedidiah Goodacre and Judith Hoag

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview - Oct 2026

programme.title: Arthur's Whisky
programme.desc: When Joan's husband dies, she discovers he'd invented an anti-aging elixir that literally takes the years off. Sharing it with her friends Linda and Susan, the rejuvenated women waste little time in painting the town red, but they soon realise it's a very different world to the one they remember. Co-writer/director Stephen Cookson's comedy, starring Diane Keaton, Hayley Mills, Patricia Hodge, Lulu and David Harewood

programme.title: The Colour Room
programme.desc: Period drama telling the story of Clarice Cliff, who broke the glass ceiling and helped revolutionise the workplace in the 20th century. Clarice is a vivacious young factory worker in the industrial British midlands of the 1920s. Bursting with ideas for colours and shapes, she takes more and more dangerous risks, but manages to stay one step ahead of the workhouse and impress eccentric factory owner Colley Shorter with her talent and innovation. Starring Phoebe Dynevor, Matthew Goode and David Morrissey

programme.title: The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Asa Butterfield, Jack Scanlon and David Thewlis. After his Nazi officer father is given a promotion, young Bruno and his family are moved from Berlin to a remote house in the countryside. With nothing to do and no friends of his own age, Bruno becomes curious about a nearby building known as "the farm" and its oddly clothed inhabitants.

programme.title: Lee
programme.desc: Biographical drama starring Kate Winslet. As the Second World War rages, American fashion model-turned-photographer Elizabeth "Lee" Miller defies the expectations of the era and travels to mainland Europe as a war correspondent for Vogue. Reporting from the frontline, Miller captures indelible images of the conflict, including the horrors found in the Nazi concentration camps at Buchenwald and Dachau.

programme.title: Don't Let's Go to the Dogs Tonight
programme.desc: An eight-year-old girl experiences life on her family's Rhodesian farm during the final stages of the Bush War. Drama, written, directed by and starring Embeth Davidtz, with Lexi Ventner and Zikhona Bali

programme.title: Erin Brockovich
programme.desc: Oscar-winning biographical drama starring Julia Roberts. When she loses a lawsuit following a car accident, unemployed single mother Erin Brockovich browbeats her lawyer, Ed Masry, into giving her a job. Soon she discovers that a power company has been dumping toxic waste and poisoning the residents of a small town. Masry's firm takes up the case - making Brockovich the unlikely linchpin in one of corporate America's biggest ever lawsuits.

programme.title: The Post
programme.desc: Political thriller based on a true story, starring Meryl Streep and Tom Hanks. Kay Graham, publisher of The Washington Post, and editor Ben Bradlee must overcome their differences to bring the leaked Pentagon Papers - which reveal the extent of the US government's involvement in the Vietnam War - into the public eye.

programme.title: Better Man
programme.desc: Biographical drama charting the meteoric rise, dramatic fall and remarkable resurgence of British pop icon, Robbie Williams

programme.title: The Brutalist
programme.desc: Epic period drama starring Adrien Brody, Felicity Jones and Guy Pearce. In 1947, Hungarian architect and Holocaust survivor László Tóth arrives in America. After a rocky start in this new land, he finds his luck changing when he meets a wealthy industrialist who wants László to build an ambitious community project. However, for the tormented László and his wife, Erzsébet, this commission proves both blessing and curse.

programme.title: Star Trek: Insurrection
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Patrick Stewart and Jonathan Frakes. The planet Ba'ku holds magical properties that keep the population young and living in harmony. So when an alien race attempts to take over this paradise, it falls to Captain Jean-Luc Picard and the crew of the Enterprise to defend the planet and its people.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
programme.desc: The first sci-fi adventure movie based on the cult TV series, starring William Shatner and Leonard Nimoy. An unknown and awesome force is heading towards Federation space, on a direct course for Earth. The USS Enterprise is ordered back into immediate service and, with Captain James T Kirk once again in command, sets out to confront the mysterious alien menace.

programme.title: Innerspace
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Dennis Quaid, Martin Short and Meg Ryan. In a top secret miniaturisation experiment, "micronaut" Tuck Pendelton is about to begin a fantastic voyage through a laboratory animal. But when the lab is raided by industrial spies, he ends up being injected into the body of hypochondriac supermarket clerk Jack Putter.

programme.title: After Yang
programme.desc: Sci-fi drama starring Colin Farrell and Jodie Turner-Smith. Jake and Kyra own a second-hand robot son, Yang, a companion for their adopted daughter, Mika. But one day, Yang becomes unresponsive and an affordable repair is hard to come by.

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure sequel starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and Ricardo Montalban. In the 23rd century, Admiral James T Kirk is a guest aboard the Enterprise, which is taking part in a training exercise. But the routine voyage becomes a serious mission when his old ship is lured into a deadly trap, placing Kirk and his companions at the mercy of a crazed adversary, the formidable Khan.

programme.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring William Shatner and DeForest Kelley. Barely surviving the wrath of Khan, the battle-scarred starship Enterprise limps back to Earth, saved only by the sacrifice of the late Captain Spock. However, the Vulcan's spirit is still with the crew, and back on the artificial Eden of the new Genesis planet his corpse is missing. Against orders, Admiral Kirk decides to lead the search for Spock and bring him home.

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and DeForest Kelley. In the 23rd century, Captain Kirk and his intrepid band of space travellers discover a probe in the vicinity of Earth that is trying to contact a humpback whale, a species that is extinct. In order to prevent the probe destroying the planet, Kirk and his crew visit 1986 San Francisco in order to locate two whales to take back to the future.

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure based on the popular TV series, starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and DeForest Kelley. The captain and crew of the untested new starship Enterprise travel to the desolate world of Nimbus III after a Vulcan mystic kidnaps a group of Federation diplomats. There, they find themselves caught up in a dangerous quest.

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy and DeForest Kelley. The original crew of the Enterprise is given one final mission, to oversee the integration of the Klingons, who claim they want peace, into the intergalactic Federation. Initial hostility between the old adversaries is worsened by attacks against the Klingons from an unknown enemy within the Enterprise, and Kirk finds himself on the Klingons' home world, standing trial for murder.

programme.title: Star Trek: Generations
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Patrick Stewart and featuring William Shatner. When an evil alien threatens to destroy a star system along with millions of lives, Captain Jean-Luc Picard travels into a time vortex to enlist the help of his famous predecessor, James T Kirk.

programme.title: Star Trek: First Contact
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Patrick Stewart. During a Federation encounter with the Borg, a sphere escapes into the Earth's past via a temporal vortex. Captain Jean-Luc Picard and the crew of the Enterprise take up the challenge to pursue the Federation's most fearsome enemy and stop them from changing the future.

programme.title: Star Trek: Insurrection

programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Chris Pine and Zachary Quinto. Rebellious youth James Kirk is persuaded to join the Starfleet Academy, where he befriends Dr Leonard "Bones" McCoy and clashes with officer Spock. When an evil Romulan arrives from the future, the young crew of the USS Enterprise find themselves in the thick of the action.

programme.desc: Psychological horror thriller starring Thomasin McKenzie, Anya Taylor-Joy and Matt Smith. Obsessed by all things 1960s, Eloise moves from Cornwall to London to study fashion design. She rents a room where at night she finds herself mysteriously transported back to Soho in the 60s. There, Eloise becomes intrigued by glamorous wannabe singer Sandie. But this dazzling new world is not all that it seems...

John's mother, Sarah, is once again thrust into the battle for Earth's future as a new artificial intelligence gains sentience.

In an effort to protect him, Grandma takes Charlie to stay at a seaside hotel, unaware that a witch's convention is also booked in, and the Grand High Witch herself is in attendance.

From rapid-response units using chilli bombs to combat emergencies, to rangers searching out lethal snares and guns, these are the stories of the unsung heroes and their never-ending fight to protect Zambia's wildlife

A separate family project in Lowestoft, Suffolk, sees an auntie and nephew tackle a tired terrace, and in another Suffolk property, Jacqui Joseph meets a novice renovator more used to dealing with cuts of meat than knocking down walls

programme.title: The Reluctant Vampire
programme.desc: Val's friendship with Gertie is tested when vampire hunters arrive in the village, and he is torn between protecting his friendship or his family. programme.desc: Fiona Bruce presents from Bangor Castle in Northern Ireland, where finds include a grasshopper vase, chairs that may have been destined for the Titanic, and rare Japanese prints. Fiona also learns about the wartime achievements of one of the members of the family who once lived in the house, while expert Marc Allum challenges her to correctly identify the function of three mystery objects from his own personal collection

programme.title: This City Is Ours

programme.desc: The death of Robert McCartney, whose Sunday night at a city pub ended in a gang attack and murder. As evidence vanished, Robert's family weren't getting any answers. In the race to find out what happened to the survivor of the stabbing, the police were not the only organisation attempting to talk to witnesses

programme.title: Match of the Day
programme.desc: Highlights of the latest Premier League matches, including Liverpool v Brighton & Hove Albion at Anfield and Manchester United v Bournemouth at Old Trafford. Plus, Crystal Palace v Newcastle Untied, Hull City v Brentford and Sunderland v Leeds United

programme.title: Cidsin Granaidh Chalanais
programme.desc: Gregor MacLeod inherited his grandmother's old cookery book, withing which she had written down over 50 recipes by hand. He therefore sets himself the challenge of cooking his way through them. In this first programme he takes on her recipe for rhubarb and orange jam, using his own home-grown rhubarb. Her trifle recipe also catches Gregor's eye, but he can't resist putting his own spin on it with amaretti biscuits. Liver is perhaps not quite as fashionable these days, but Gregor also attempts grannie's recipe for liver casserole

programme.desc: Erica Macpherson returns with the series in which she transforms home, homes and businesses, following her process from architectural plans to placing the finishing touches

programme.title: Alba fon Talamh
programme.desc: Documentary following Calum Maclean into Scotland's underground world. He begins in north-west Scotland, where he explores the cave networks of Applecross

programme.title: Rurachd (Foraging)
programme.desc:
Màiri Anna NicUalraig agus Liusaidh Cooke - An Còcaire Fiadhain - a' rùrachd airson tairbheartas nàdair. Tha Liusaidh a' toirt Màiri Anna dhachaigh gu dùthaich a h-òige, Shropshire, far an do thòisich a beatha an co-bhuinn ri nàdar. Tha iad a' trusadh bhalgan-buachair nach gabh a lorg an Gàidhealtachd na h-Alba, agus a' dèanamh picil leotha. Tha iad a' beachdachadh air àrainneachd gu math eadar-dhealaichte bho an dachaigh an Alba le taic bho athair Liusaidh, a' tadhal air darach a tha co-dhiù 800 bliadhn' a dh'aois, agus a' trusadh eidheann-thalmhainn, lus cùbhraidh a tha càirdeach do phionnd is sèids. Agus tha an còmhnaidh ùine ann airson basgaid ùir.
Mary Ann Kennedy and Lucy Cooke - The Wild Cooke -forage for nature's bounty. Lucy takes Mary Ann to Shropshire where she grew up and began her life in harmony with nature. They collect fungi that can't be found in Highland Scotland and pickle them. With some help from Lucy's dad, they visit an 800-year-old oak tree and forage for ground ivy, a fragrant herb related to mint and sage. And there's always time for a new basket.
In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Caileag nan Eun
programme.desc: Caitlin is an avid birdwatcher, but as a young female she is going against the stereotype. Keen to connect with people who share her passion, she sets off on a road trip around Scotland to meet other birders who are defying the stereotypes and to uncover some of the personal stories behind the hobby

programme.title: Ath-thogail Notre-Dame (Rebuilding Notre-Dame)
programme.desc: In April 2019, a huge fire consumed Notre-Dame's roof, taking down its arrow, piercing its vaults and weakening its walls. A year after the fire, archaeologists and scientists examined the battered stones, unveiling the construction secrets laying behind the highest vaults of Christendom. This programme reveals how they worked with hundreds of craftsmen to restore the French monument to its former glory

programme.title: Skipinnish aig a' Chaisteal (Shorts)
programme.desc: A performance of December in front of thousands of fans at a concert celebrating 25 years of the band, from Edinburgh Castle

This is an opportunity to switch off from the stresses of our busy lives and immerse ourselves in pure nature. programme.title: The Beasts
programme.desc: Thriller starring Marina Foïs and Denis Ménochet. Olga and Antoine move from their native France to a small village in the Galician countryside. But their new neighbours do not take kindly to foreigners, and when the couple take a stance against a local land sale the low-level hostility takes a turn toward violence.

programme.title: Saving Lives at Sea
programme.desc: On the Northumberland coast, a 999 call comes in from a distressed woman whose husband is drifting out to sea on a paddleboard - the Seahouses crew race out to locate him. In Moelfre, north Wales, when a crew member at the station spots a kayak capsizing, the lifeboat launches to pluck the fishermen from the water. Out on the English Channel, a French vessel makes a distress call

programme.title: DIY SOS
programme.desc: The team are in Southampton where they come to the aid of deaf couple Ahmed and Rifat, whose dream home became a nightmare after a rogue builder abandoned the project. With three young children, no savings left and living on a building site, they need their home to work for their family's needs - so Nick Knowles and the team call on the local community to transform both the house and the family's future

programme.title: Glorious Gardens from Above
programme.desc: Horticulturist Christine Walkden visits Essex, where she experiments with triangular planting and has tea and cake at Beth Chatto Gardens. Plus, at RHS Hyde Hall she moves rocks with a former student, and then sails across the Thames to the Blackwater Estuary

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Charlotte Smith and Joe Crowley visit Yr Wyddfa, Wales' highest mountain, to meet the people caring for its landscape and keeping more than 600,000 visitors a year on the move. Joe joins volunteers tackling litter and discovers efforts to protect rare alpine plants and the elusive Snowdon beetle, while Charlotte goes behind the scenes at Wales' highest cafe. Plus, Tom Heap investigates how organised crime gangs are targeting the countryside

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: Dougie Vipond heads west to the Morvern peninsula in Lochaber to find out how the Ardtornish Estate is balancing farming and stalking with nature restoration. Anne Lundon is on a shoot in Glenshee with a portrait photographer using Scotland's landscape as her backdrop, while Leanna Fernandez is near Kingussie to encounter misunderstood bloodsucking creatures that are being saved from extinction. Plus, Rosie Morton visits a dairy farm near Peterhead that diversified and created new markets for its milk

programme.title: The Best of Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: Derek Brockway remembers his favourite three walks around north Wales, including climbing three peaks in the Cadair Idris mountain range and taking an icy dip in a glacial lake. Derek recalls a visit to the Italianate village of Portmeirion, where he also discovered 'Y Gwyllt' - 'the wild' headland beyond, and his walk along the Dee Valley Way, a stunning 13-mile route which took him from the pretty town of Corwen to its larger and more bustling neighbour, Llangollen

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
programme.desc: Matt Tebbutt presents more highlights, with recipes by Bryn Williams, Julie Lin and Poppy O'Toole, while actors Bryan Cranston and Marianne Jean-Baptiste battle it out for their food heaven

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: The actress explores the history, food and culture of Brittany with her Breton guide Tanguy Thomassin , heading to the vast oyster beds of Cancale, with the region still supplying half of France with the seafood. Brittany also boasts plentiful sardines, kelp forests, spiny crabs and the rare cobalt blue lobster

programme.title: Moose in the Glen: Natural World
programme.desc: Multi-millionaire landowner Paul Lister's plan to turn his 23,000-acre estate north of Inverness into Europe's first wilderness reserve, reinstating Caledonian pine forests and releasing animals including moose, wild boar and brown bears. However, foot and mouth, red tape and local opposition threaten his dream

programme.title: Gymnastics: World Championships 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage of the concluding apparatus finals on the final day of the annual event, held this year at Rotterdam Ahoy, the Netherlands. The women's floor discipline is among those taking place today and Great Britain's Ruby Evans and Abigail Martin took silver and bronze respectively in Jakarta last year, with Japan's Aiko Sugihara winning the title. Also being held this afternoon are the men's vault, parallel bars and horizontal bar, and the women's balance beam

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin presents from Gloucester as experts Philip Serrell and Michael Baggott discover some rare gems among the antiques and collectibles brought to the city's cathedral.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Compilation episode following chart stars Peter Andre, Martin Kemp and Sinitta as they swap the studio for the saleroom to take part in the antiques buying challenge. They are guided by Paul Laidlaw, Margie Cooper and Tim Medhurst - but who will get to be top of the profit-making pops?

programme.title: Wilderness with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: Simon travels across Mongolia, the most sparsely populated country on Earth and home to some of the most brutal and beautiful landscapes on the planet. Six times the size of the UK but with fewer than 3.5 million people, Simon wants to find out how wild nature and nomadic traditions like hunting with golden eagles still shape everyday life, all while searching for the elusive snow leopard

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: The actress explores the history, food and culture of Alsace, a region that sits between Germany and France and has a cuisine to match, In Strasbourg, Eva stops off at Brasserie Le Tigre for a beer and a creamy tarte flambée, before heading to her guide Coralie Andt's restaurant Au Pont Corbeau, where French wines can be enjoyed with cheese, sausage and sauerkraut cooked in Riesling wine

programme.title: The Balkans: Europe's Forgotten Frontier
programme.desc: In the second of two documentaries, BBC Europe editor Katya Adler travels to Romania, Kosovo and Serbia. In Romania, she visits what will soon be Nato's largest European base thanks to its strategic significance. Her next stop is Europe's youngest country, Kosovo, where she meets ethnic Serbs who insist the country is still Serbian. In Serbia itself, she visits discovers a battle for power taking place with the West, Russia and China all wanting Serbia to be in their sphere of influence

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Bob and Paul return for more angling adventures, beginning by travelling to the Ribble in Lancashire for one last trip with their canine pal Ted, who died shortly after this programme was filmed. With the river in good health, Paul and Bob hope to catch a good chub or a mighty barbel on this stretch of the water

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: Hollywood star Bill Murray travels around the Republic of Ireland and Northern Ireland, combining golf with a search for his Irish roots. In Kinsale, Co Cork, chance encounters turn a simple walk into an adventure, while Bill's golf writer friend Tom Coyne tries to keep things on track

programme.title: Later... with Jools Holland
programme.desc: Taking to the stage at Alexandra Palace Theatre in north London are Royal Blood, Moses Boyd, Shygirl, Kingfishr and Ayanna Witter-Johnson. Black Sabbath guitarist Tony Iommi chats to Jools at the piano about his musical beginnings, his memories of bandmate Ozzy Osbourne and new album From the Dark, his first solo LP in 21 years. Jools also marks the 20th anniversary of Amy Winehouse's album Back to Black with a dip into the archives to remember her performance on the show in 2006

programme.title: Misery
programme.desc: Psychological thriller based on the novel by Stephen King, starring James Caan and Kathy Bates. In a remote area of the Colorado Mountains, successful novelist Paul Sheldon is injured in a car accident and taken in by ex-nurse Annie Wilkes, a devoted fan of Sheldon and his fictional heroine Misery Chastain. But events take a sinister turn when the novelist allows Wilkes to read a proof of his latest book.

Moley must do whatever it takes to replace the page and rescue Manny.

programme.desc: While he was falling, Grizzy performed a series of acrobatics that amazed the Lemmings. / After loosing their jar of YUMMY in a labyrinthian Temple, Grizzy and the Lemmings end up getting lost. / Things start disappearing from the cabin. Grizzy decides to take part. / A block containing Grizzy and the Lemmings' ancestors cracks during their fight and frees the ancestors.

programme.desc: Scooby-Doo and Shaggy Rogers stumble across a lone suit of black armor and embark on a quest to find the artifact's missing owner.

programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo love a good game of 'Grannies', hobbling about on canes and causing mischief. Bluey revels in her victory a little too much, and a sad Bingo quits their game. When Mum tells Bluey, she has to choose between being right or keeping Bingo happy, Bluey finds a third option - teaching Nana how to floss! programme.title: Bluey

By the time they reach the picturesque watering hole, Bluey is enraptured with the simple natural beauty that surrounds her. programme.title: Bluey

programme.title: Bluey

But this dazzling new world is not all that it seems...

John's mother, Sarah, is once again thrust into the battle for Earth's future as a new artificial intelligence gains sentience.

programme.desc: Action comedy adventure starring Sandra Bullock, Channing Tatum and Daniel Radcliffe. Alan steps up to rescue her, but he's just a book-cover model, nothing like the heroic Dash.

programme.desc: Action thriller starring Liam Neeson. Hired killer Alex Lewis refuses to complete his latest job - killing a young girl - and is forced to go on the run, evading the associates of his vengeful ex-employer, as well as the FBI. To make matters worse, Lewis is suffering from early-onset dementia and his power of recall is steadily declining.

programme.title: Last Night in Soho
programme.desc: Psychological horror thriller starring Thomasin McKenzie, Anya Taylor-Joy and Matt Smith. Obsessed by all things 1960s, Eloise moves from Cornwall to London to study fashion design. She rents a room where at night she finds herself mysteriously transported back to Soho in the 60s. There, Eloise becomes intrigued by glamorous wannabe singer Sandie. But this dazzling new world is not all that it seems...

programme.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
programme.desc: Science-fiction action thriller starring Linda Hamilton and Arnold Schwarzenegger. In 1998, with the apocalypse apparently averted following the events of Terminator 2: Judgment Day, humanity's saviour John Connor is targeted for assassination by a time-travelling T-800 cyborg. John's mother, Sarah, is once again thrust into the battle for Earth's future as a new artificial intelligence gains sentience.

programme.title: The War Wagon
programme.desc: Western starring John Wayne and Kirk Douglas. Taw Jackson and Lomax are two rivals who decide to bury the hatchet when Jackson is released from jail on parole. They plan to rob the greedy mine owner who put Jackson behind bars but they have to contend with the "war wagon", the mine owner's ingenious way of protecting his gold.

programme.title: The Mark of Zorro
programme.desc: Swashbuckling adventure starring Frank Langella and Ricardo Montalban. Suffering under an oppressive regime, the people of California are aided by the chameleon-like Zorro, who transforms himself from an aristocratic dandy by day into a masked crusader at night.

programme.title: Old Boys
programme.desc: During the school production of Cyrano de Bergerac, an awkward pupil helps the handsome-but-dim school hero chase the daughter of a visiting French teacher. Director Toby MacDonald's comedy, starring Alex Lawther, Jonah Hauer-King and Pauline Etienne

programme.title: Mr Hobbs Takes a Vacation
programme.desc: Comedy starring James Stewart and Maureen O'Hara. St Louis banker Roger Hobbs books a seaside vacation hoping for a quiet relaxing break. But one disaster follows another as the family arrives at the dilapidated accommodation and Hobbs's patience is severely tested.

programme.title: The Lost City
programme.desc: Action comedy adventure starring Sandra Bullock, Channing Tatum and Daniel Radcliffe. Bestselling author Loretta Sage is promoting the latest in her series of Dash McMahon adventure novels with handsome cover model Alan Caprisan when she is kidnapped by a billionaire who believes she knows the location of a lost treasure. Alan steps up to rescue her, but he's just a book-cover model, nothing like the heroic Dash.

programme.title: Memory
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Liam Neeson. Hired killer Alex Lewis refuses to complete his latest job - killing a young girl - and is forced to go on the run, evading the associates of his vengeful ex-employer, as well as the FBI. To make matters worse, Lewis is suffering from early-onset dementia and his power of recall is steadily declining.

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: Horror sequel starring Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox and David Arquette. After 25 peaceful years in in Woodsboro, another masked killer begins to terrorise the town's high-schoolers. Efforts are made to reunite the survivors of the original massacre - but could this be playing into the hands of the new Ghostface?

programme.desc: In Sacramento, Adam visits the California State Fair for fried food on a stick. Later, he tucks into five pounds of chili-smothered hot dogs in the Knucklehead Challenge!

programme.title: Man v Food
programme.desc: Adam Richman is in Des Moines, Iowa, for some Midwestern comfort food, unique sandwich-inspired pizza and the five-pound Adam Emmenecker sandwich challenge.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: The chef arrives in the riverside town of L'Isle-sur-la-Sorgue in south-eastern France, where his culinary hero Keith Floyd once owned a restaurant. Buying produce from its floating market, and a Floyd-style hat, James sets up his mobile kitchen on a bridge overlooking the river, and cooks peaches pain perdu in the sunshine. Heading back in the direction of the town, James samples some truffle-laden dishes at renowned restaurant La Beaugraviere

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: The chef heads to Normandy and sets up his mobile kitchen in one of the many calvados orchards in the area, making a dish of artichokes with hollandaise. He also visits restaurant Le Pavé d'Auge in Beuvron-en-Auge to meets a chef who likes to cook with as much butter as he does

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: The remaining contestants test their bread-making skills as they embark on a series of challenges. After cooking a flavoured loaf, they face the task of baking focaccia. A display basket featuring 24 rolls forms the final leg of the challenge, before judges Mary Berry and Paul Hollywood reveal who will leave the competition. Presented by Mel Giedroyc and Sue Perkins

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: The remaining bakers test their biscuit-making skills as they embark on a series of challenges. After cooking their own interpretation of a classic, the contestants face the task of baking brandy snaps. Preparing a display of macaroons forms the final leg of the challenge, before the judges reveal who will leave the competition. Presented by Mel Giedroyc and Sue Perkins

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: The remaining bakers test their pie-making skills as they embark on a series of challenges. After serving up their signature dish for judges Mary Berry and Paul Hollywood, they are faced with cooking six individual pork pies - a task that proves problematic for vegetarian Jason - and preparing a meringue. Presented by Mel Giedroyc and Sue Perkins

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: In week six there's a savoury signature, where contestants must impress judges Paul Hollywood and Prue Leith with style and substance. There's also a multi-layered technical, and an ambitious final challenge, in which the bakers make a traditional pie. Sandi Toksvig and Noel Fielding are with the contestants every step of the way, ready with a pertinent pep talk or just a sympathetic shoulder to cry on. Also, Sandi heads abroad to discover how some unusual habits have inspired a classic pastry treat

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: The amateur cooks take part in Italian week, which culminates in a fiddly showstopper in the hottest temperatures ever recorded in the tent. Before that, under the ever watchful gaze of judges Paul Hollywood and Prue Leith, the contestants dish up a Sicilian signature that gets them all hot under the collar and a deceptively tricky technical. Noel Fielding and Sandi Toksvig are on hand to keep the bakers in line as the pressure of reaching the final stages of the competition intensifies

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: The remaining five bakers step back in time for forgotten bakes week, facing the test of baking with unfamiliar recipes, with places in the semi-final at stake. They start with a sweet and savoury signature challenge, before Prue Leith sets a boozy technical and, for their final challenge, the bakers must produce an elaborate sponge showstopper that once graced the dining tables of high society. Sandi Toksvig and Noel Fielding are on hand to help the bakers calm their nerves

programme.title: Murder Maps
programme.desc: Dr Ruxton was an Indian born physician. He lived a quiet, respectable life in Lancaster but had a violent jealous streak. He had accused his wife of infidelity for years but in September 1935 his jealousy got the better of him. He beat, strangled and stabbed her to death then did the same to the housemaid. He dismembered the bodies to remove identification marks and dumped them in Scotland.

programme.title: Murder Maps
programme.desc: Three police officers were murdered in Shepherds Bush on Friday 12th August 1966 by Harry Roberts and two others. After the killing they went on the run and a manhunt ensued. The notion that someone had killed several policemen shocked the public and attracted a lot of press attention. As the act of murder happened six months after the death penalty was suspended, people called for it's return.

Western, starring Audie Murphy and Broderick Crawford

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
