programme.desc: Michael Portillo's journey has brought him to Lee on the Solent in Hampshire and the training centre for the coastguard. He also visits the great maritime city of Portsmouth, and then travels eastwards to Chichester's vast, natural harbour

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo heads to Northern Ireland's spectacular Causeway coast to begin a new journey, which takes him along the north and east coasts through Ulster and Leinster. He begins in Co Derry on the windswept shores of Loch Foyle, where the largest accumulation of coastal sands in Ireland has formed a system of dunes visible from space. He also learns how scientists are monitoring the site and hears how their work has been picked up by fellow scientists in the United States to help research the surface of Mars

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: A chance to buy goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: James May's Toy Stories: Flight Club
programme.desc: The Top Gear presenter investigates the enduring appeal of the model aeroplane and sets out with the intention of achieving the first flight across the English Channel by an engineless, home-made supersized toy - breaking the British distance record in the process. During his quest, James turns Indiana Jones to unearth surprising new evidence identifying children as the true pioneers of flight and wrestles with an underperforming craft that threatens to barely leave the ground

programme.title: James May's Toy Stories: The Great Train Race
programme.desc: The presenter tries to construct a functioning 10-mile-long model railway between the Devon towns of Barnstaple and Bideford. His previous attempt to complete the challenge ended in failure in 2009 after series of equipment problems, but James refuses to accept defeat - and even challenges the German owners of the world's largest toy railway museum to a race along the route

programme.title: James May's Toy Stories: The Motorcycle Diaries
programme.desc: The Top Gear presenter sets out to build a motorbike and sidecar entirely out of Meccano and complete a lap of the Isle of Man's TT circuit. A total of 15,000 pieces must be assembled to create a full-size, road-legal motorcycle that James hopes will be more than a match for one of the world's most demanding courses - as well as bearing the weight of himself and passenger Oz Clarke

programme.title: James May's Toy Stories: Action Man
programme.desc: For decades, Action Man has promised much with its eagle eyes, gripping hands and array of outfits, but what has he ever achieved? James May has decided he is going to try to redeem its reputation by propelling one of the figures through the sound barrier and return it safely to Earth. James and his team have to deal with high-speed physics, unforeseen explosions and catastrophic design setbacks, before settling on an experimental supersonic vehicle made entirely from scratch. Finally, Action Man must go faster and higher than another attempt led by arch-rival Sindy

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys

programme.desc: Victoria Coren Mitchell hosts another first-round match as the Sinistrals take on the Merseyside Eyes. On the River Blackwater, he takes a trip to the Ross Revenge ship, home to Radio Caroline since the 1980's

On Lewis, police face a stand-off with a camper van driver who insists the law doesn't apply to her, while an upturned canoe triggers a search for a missing man in the Cairngorms

programme.title: Surgeons: At the Edge of Life

Its surgeons carry out operations that require such expertise, they're only carried out here and a handful of other centres in the UK. One such procedure is a pelvic exenteration, so complicated it requires two surgeons to perform and two days to complete. Cameras follow colorectal consultant Nicola Fearnhead and consultant urologist Alex Colquhoun, who only do around 10 of these operations each year

programme.desc: Veteran pilot Rod Snider reflects on the day he and 19 other elite smokejumper firefighters parachuted into the Idaho wilderness to tackle what seemed to be a routine wildfire burning on a mountain ridge that turned into a deadly inferno thanks to fierce winds

programme.title: Weathered: Earth's Extremes
programme.desc: Maiya May visits the Isle de Jean Charles, Louisiana, one of the first communities in the United States to undergo a federally funded relocation due to climate change. She also learns about hurricanes from the Hurricane Hunters

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: A chance for viewers to purchase goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: A chance for viewers to purchase goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: Weathered: Earth's Extremes
programme.desc: Maiya May explores heat in Portland, Oregon, and Medellín, Colombia, a city that is leading the revolution against sweltering city temperatures before visiting the hottest city in the US, Phoenix, Arizona

programme.title: Treasures Decoded
programme.desc: Investigators pick apart the mystery surrounding an ancient manuscript found in a cave above the Dead Sea in 1952. It apparently listed treasures worth billions

programme.title: Digging Up Britain's Past
programme.desc: In 1592, Elizabeth I visited Sudeley Castle in the Cotswolds for a three-day party commemorating the nation's victory over the Spanish Armada. Here, Raksha Dave, Alex Langlands and assorted volunteers and archaeologists hunt for a lost garden planted as part of the celebrations, while there is also a visit to Kenilworth Castle to investigate an Elizabethan garden still in full bloom today. Plus, a look at how the garden's Tudor owner, Robert Dudley transformed his estate to win favour with his Queen

programme.title: Calmeyer's Dilemma: Deciding Life and Death Under Nazi Rule
programme.desc: Hans Calmeyer, a German lawyer and Nazi official, saved thousands of Dutch Jews from deportation to concentration camps. This documentary sheds light on the moral conflict between systemic power and individual humanity during the Nazi era in the occupied Netherlands

programme.title: Weathered: Earth's Extremes
programme.desc: Maiya May explores heat in Portland, Oregon, and Medellín, Colombia, a city that is leading the revolution against sweltering city temperatures before visiting the hottest city in the US, Phoenix, Arizona

programme.title: Prisoner Number A26188
programme.desc: The story of a Jewish girl who lost her father, brother and sister during the Nazi occupation of Poland in the Second World War. Now in her eighties, Henia's testimony begins with her family's removal from their home in Radom, to the ghetto, then on to Plaszow concentration camp, Majdanek, Auschwitz and finally Bergen-Belsen. She describes the horrors she experienced and how, through a combination of her own resourcefulness and luck, she survived, witnessed the birth of Israel and eventually started a new life in Africa

programme.title: Reporting Scotland: News at Seven
programme.desc: Reports from BBC newsrooms across the country with analysis and discussion on the big stories of the day

programme.title: Life on the Bay
programme.desc: A new caravan is installed on the site with the help of a huge crane, but the steep hillside and gusting winds prove a challenge, while member of staff Blythe prepares to say farewell after 18 years at the park

programme.title: This Farming Life
programme.desc: The Barclay boys are at the Royal Highland Show, where they show their pedigree Beltex and finest Suffolks before going head to head in the Young Handlers competition. It's also a major event for budding young farmers Rachel and Camy, who are pinning their hopes on their Cheviot lamb Patch. Back in Moray, Nikki and Ollie prepare a show of their own as they open their gates to the public

programme.title: Murder Case: Who Killed Kiesha?
programme.desc: Detectives head to the market town of Elgin in November 2023 to investigate the murder of 32-year-old mother-of-two Kiesha Donaghy, whose body was discovered in her home and who had been the victim of a frenzied attack. As the officers search for key evidence and piece together information to uncover the truth, the case quickly unfolds into a complex investigation that demands relentless focus and all of the team's expertise

programme.title: Paramedics on Scene
programme.desc: The Special Operations Response Team is called to Arthur's Seat after a tourist has a fall and is injured near its summit, with paramedics having to navigate rocks and scores of hillwalkers to reach their patient. In Aberdeen, student paramedic Amy faces some difficult patients on her final training shift

programme.title: Scotcast
programme.desc: Martin Geissler presents a discussion on Scotland's biggest news stories, with analysis from journalists, commentators and guests

programme.title: Scotland's Greatest Escape
programme.desc: Grado and Judith Ralston enjoy a voyage of discovery amidst the wild beauty of the Highlands. They take a scenic flight over the Black Isle, get close to nature on an eco-break and try their hand at camping with a twist. They also paddle their own canoes, hunt for the elusive salmon and encounter some surprising sea life on the beautiful beaches of the Moray coast

programme.title: Scream 7
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott-Evans, one of the survivors of the original Ghostface killers, has built a new life in the quiet town of Pine Grove, far from Woodsboro, with her 17-year-old daughter Tatum. A lethal new stalker emerges with a diabolical plan that involves targeting Tatum and everyone that Sidney loves. Horror sequel, starring Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox and Isabel May

programme.title: Mexicali
programme.desc: Former fighter Joe helps run a Mexican farm with his partner, Estrella. After entering underground bouts to support the workers, he is ambushed by a gang and forced to fight for his life. Action thriller, starring Bren Foster and Tania Raymonde

programme.title: Kiss of the Spider Woman
programme.desc: Political prisoner Valentín shares a cell with Molina, convicted for public indecency, where an unlikely bond forms between the pair as the latter recounts a glamorous Hollywood movie. Adaptation of the stage musical, based on the novel by Manuel Puig, starring Diego Luna, Jennifer Lopez and Tonatiuh

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview - Oct 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: Midwinter Break
programme.desc: A long-time couple take a life-changing trip to Amsterdam. Director Polly Findlay's romantic drama, starring Lesley Manville, Ciarán Hinds and Julie Lamberton

programme.title: Couples Weekend
programme.desc: Four adults navigate deception and desire when a fallen tree on New Year's Eve triggers a chain of events that challenges their relationships and the lies they tell themselves and each other. Writer/director Nora Kirkpatrick's comedy drama, starring Alexandra Daddario and Daveed Diggs

programme.title: Finnegan's Foursome
programme.desc: Two rival brothers and their adult children travel to Ireland to scatter their father's ashes, turning clashing egos and comic mishaps into an unexpected week of family bonding. Comedy drama written, directed by and starring Edward Burns, with Brian d'Arcy James and Erica Hernandez

programme.title: How to Make a Killing
programme.desc: A man disowned by his wealthy family murders his relatives to ensure he is the only claimant for an inheritance. Writer/director John Patton Ford's black comedy inspired by Kind Hearts and Coronets, starring Glen Powell and Margaret Qualley

programme.title: Cold Storage
programme.desc: When a lethal contagious fungus escapes a secret lab, two young employees, joined by a grizzled bioterror operative, must survive the wildest night shift ever. Director Jonny Campbell's comedy thriller, starring Joe Keery, Georgina Campbell, Liam Neeson and Lesley Manville

programme.title: Mother's Pride
programme.desc: A grieving family who own a failing pub have their lives changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards. Comedy, starring Martin Clunes, James Buckley and Miles Jupp

programme.title: Finnegan's Foursome
programme.desc: Two rival brothers and their adult children travel to Ireland to scatter their father's ashes, turning clashing egos and comic mishaps into an unexpected week of family bonding. Comedy drama written, directed by and starring Edward Burns, with Brian d'Arcy James and Erica Hernandez

A lethal new stalker emerges with a diabolical plan that involves targeting Tatum and everyone that Sidney loves. Horror sequel, starring Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox and Isabel May

programme.title: Super Charlie
programme.desc: Willie's dream of fighting crime with his cop dad is shattered when his baby brother Charlie arrives. And the new family member turns out to have superpowers. Family animation, with the voices of Karen Ardiff and Alex Kelly

programme.title: Puss in Boots
programme.desc: Animated comedy spin-off from the Shrek series, featuring the voices of Antonio Banderas and Salma Hayek. The dashing Puss in Boots goes on a quest for magic beans and a goose that lays golden eggs. It's an adventure that will bring him into conflict with Jack and Jill, his childhood friend Humpty Dumpty and masked feline Kitty Softpaws.

programme.title: Open Season
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure, featuring the voices of Martin Lawrence and Ashton Kutcher. In a tranquil mountain town, domesticated grizzly bear Boog enjoys an idyllic life as the star of a wildlife show. But when he meets hyperactive deer Elliot, he gets into so much trouble that his keeper decides it's time to release him back into the wild. Problem is, hunting season is fast approaching and there's a tenacious hunter who's determined to bag both Boog and Elliot.

programme.title: Open Season: Scared Silly
programme.desc: Boog, Elliot and their pals team up to track down an elusive werewolf and prevent their forest from being intruded upon by hunter Shaw. Animation, with the voice of Will Townsend and Donny Lucas

programme.title: The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure. SpongeBob the friendly sea sponge sets out from his home town of Bikini Bottom with his starfish friend, Patrick, to reclaim King Neptune's stolen crown.

programme.title: Looney Tunes: The Day the Earth Blew Up
programme.desc: Porky Pig and Daffy Duck are Earth's only hope when facing the threat of alien invasion. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Eric Bauza, Candi Milo and Peter MacNicol

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voices of Adam Sandler, Andy Samberg and Selena Gomez. Count Dracula is the gracious host at his daughter's 118th birthday party, which he's throwing at his own "five stake" resort for monsters. But he's less welcoming of a mortal backpacker who takes a shine to his precious girl.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
programme.desc: Animated horror comedy featuring the voices of Adam Sandler, Selena Gomez and Andy Samberg. Things have settled down at Dracula's hotel now that humans are allowed to stay. However, the Count can't help but worry that his half-human, half-vampire grandson Dennis isn't proving to be a chip off the old vampire block. So while Johnny and Mavis are away, Drac and his monster buddies decide to put Dennis through his paces.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 3: A Monster Vacation
programme.desc: Animated comedy horror featuring the voices of Adam Sandler, Selena Gomez and Andy Samberg. Exhausted from running the hotel, Count Dracula heads off on a sea cruise with the family. Romance beckons in the form of the ship's mysterious captain - but she is hiding a deadly secret that could spell disaster for the monsters.

programme.title: Pets on a Train
programme.desc: When a gang of animal crooks set out on what should be a simple con, they're swept into a train robbery. It falls to Falcon, a small-time raccoon thief, and Rex, a by-the-book police dog, to put their differences aside and protect the passengers aboard a runaway high-speed train. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Wyatt Bowen and Daniel Brochu

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: A half-human canine is sworn to protect and serve as he faces feline supervillain Petey the Cat. Animated comedy, with the voices of Pete Davidson, Poppy Liu, Lil Rel Howery and Isla Fisher

programme.title: How to Train Your Dragon
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Jay Baruchel and Gerard Butler. A teenage Viking boy forms a special bond with a dragon - much to the consternation of the members of his clan who regard the beasts as mortal enemies.

programme.title: How to Train Your Dragon 2
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voices of Jay Baruchel, Gerard Butler and Cate Blanchett. After five years during which time the Vikings and dragons have learned to live together, Hiccup discovers there's a threat to that peaceful status quo that needs to be faced.

programme.title: Corpse Bride
programme.desc: Animated fantasy directed by Tim Burton and featuring the voices of Helena Bonham Carter, Johnny Depp and Albert Finney. As he prepares for his arranged marriage to Victoria Everglot, Victor Van Dort goes into the woods to practise his vows and unwittingly slips the ring onto the finger of a corpse. How will he explain to his fiancée that he has married another - and that she happens to be dead?

programme.title: Wallace & Gromit in The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Peter Sallis, Ralph Fiennes and Helena Bonham Carter. As the annual Giant Vegetable Competition approaches, enterprising Wallace and Gromit cash in with their humane pest-control outfit, "Anti-Pesto". But business turns sour when a huge, mysterious beast begins destroying every garden in the area.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voices of Jack Black, Dustin Hoffman and Angelina Jolie. Ancient China: Po the Panda lives in the Valley of Peace and dreams of becoming a kung fu master despite the fact he is clumsy, overweight and a complete beginner at martial arts. So when he's accidentally chosen to be the legendary Dragon Warrior, he is overjoyed. However, his joy is short-lived as the evil snow leopard Tai Lung has escaped from captivity and is on his way to the Valley to take his revenge on Po's mentor.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda 2
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure sequel with Jack Black as the voice of martial arts master Po. In order to stop the plot of evil peacock Lord Shen, Po must embark on a journey to discover the truth about his childhood.

programme.title: Evil Dead
programme.desc: Horror remake starring Jane Levy, Shiloh Fernandez and Lou Taylor Pucci. Four friends decamp to an isolated cabin in the woods to help drug addict Mia kick her habit. However, when one of them quotes from an ancient book of the dead, the forces of hell are unleashed and no one is safe.

programme.title: Evil Dead Rise
programme.desc: Guitar technician Beth abandons life on tour to visit her estranged sister Ellie and three children, Bridget, Danny and Kassie. A 5.5 magnitude earthquake rocks the city, causing structural failures in the basement that expose an old bank vault and a copy of the Naturom Demonto. Horror, starring Alyssa Sutherland

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: In 1838 Germany, Thomas Hutter is sent to the Carpathian mountains to secure the signature of enigmatic nobleman Count Orlok on a property sale in the German city of Wisborg. Thomas leaves his bride Ellen in the care of friend Friedrich Harding and his wife Anna. The young man barely survives the exhausting trip to Europe and stumbles home to find Ellen driven to delirium by a telepathic bond to the Count. Director Robert Eggers' version of the Dracula-inspired horror, starring Bill Skarsgard, Lily-Rose Depp, Nicholas Hoult and Aaron Taylor-Johnson

programme.title: Man Finds Tape
programme.desc: After finding mysterious video clips, siblings investigate the strange recordings and uncover a disturbing secret. Horror thriller, starring Kelsey Pribilski and William Magnuson

programme.title: It Feeds
programme.desc: After a young girl bursts into their home psychiatry practice claiming an entity is feeding on her, Jordan and her clairvoyant mother must find a way to stop the evil. Horror, starring Shawn Ashmore and Ashley Greene

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Supernatural horror based on Stephen King's novel, starring Jason Clarke, Amy Seimetz and John Lithgow. Shortly after the Creed family move to a new town, their cat is killed in a traffic accident. Neighbour Jud suggests they lay the animal to rest in an ancient woodland burial ground. When the family is rocked by tragedy, though, events take a macabre turn.

programme.title: Rabbit Trap
programme.desc: Married musicians Daphne and Darcy Davenport moved from London to a cottage in Wales to complete their new album. By accident they record a mystical sound never heard before, and gradually disconnect from reality. Writer/director Bryn Chainey's horror, starring Dev Patel and Rosy McEwen

programme.title: Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid
programme.desc: Sequel to 1997's Anaconda, starring Johnny Messner and KaDee Strickland. In the heart of the Borneo jungle, giant anacondas prey on a group of foolhardy scientists who are hunting for a rare orchid with youth-preserving qualities.

programme.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
programme.desc: Horror thriller starring Jennifer Love Hewitt and Sarah Michelle Gellar. When four teenagers are involved in a hit-and-run accident, they panic and dump the body. But several months later, when one of the group receives an anonymous letter from someone who knows details of the crime, it sets off a terrifying chain of events.

programme.title: Zombieland: Double Tap
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Woody Harrelson, Jesse Eisenberg, Emma Stone and Abigail Breslin. Five years after they met, makeshift family Tallahassee, Columbus, Wichita and Little Rock are living a comfortable apocalyptic life in the abandoned White House. When friction arises within the group, Wichita and Little Rock fly the coop, prompting Tallahassee and Columbus to head back into the zombie wasteland to look for them.

programme.title: Shaun of the Dead
programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. On the day north London slacker Shaun decides to sort his life out, the dead rise and the city becomes overrun with zombies. Can Shaun and best mate Ed fight off the marauding hordes of the undead and win back Shaun's girlfriend? Or will they just go down the pub?

programme.title: Five Nights At Freddy's 2
programme.desc: One year after the supernatural nightmare at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, Mike and Vanessa are pulled back into a terrifying series of events. Horror sequel, starring Josh Hutcherson and Elizabeth Lail

programme.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
programme.desc: Dr Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship with consequences that could change the world as he knows it. Horror sequel, starring Ralph Fiennes, Jack O'Connell and Alfie Williams

programme.title: Black Phone 2
programme.desc: Four years after a serial killer prowled the streets of North Denver, posing as a magician to lure unsuspecting children into the back of his van, teenager Finney tries to adjust to a normal life. However, the lethal Grabber returns, and is bent on revenge. Horror thriller, starring Ethan Hawke and Mason Thames

programme.title: The Karate Kid Part II
programme.desc: Martial arts adventure sequel starring Ralph Macchio. Following his success in an American karate championship, Daniel LaRusso travels with his teacher to his home island of Okinawa. There he finds himself facing his severest challenge.

programme.title: The Karate Kid Part III
programme.desc: The teenage martial arts expert becomes obsessed with defending his championship title, but wise mentor Mr Miyagi is not prepared to help him fight for such a shallow goal. Seeking someone else to help guide his career, he falls under the influence of a crooked trainer - who is secretly plotting his downfall with the help of an old adversary. Adventure sequel, starring Ralph Macchio and Pat Morita

programme.title: The Karate Kid
programme.desc: Martial arts adventure, a remake of the popular 1984 film, starring Jackie Chan and Jaden Smith. Moving from his home town of Detroit to China is quite a culture shock for young Dre Parker, a situation made worse when he falls foul of the class bully. But under the guidance of maintenance man Mr Han, Dre learns to defend himself.

programme.title: Yogi Bear
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Dan Aykroyd and Justin Timberlake. Jellystone Park's famous talking bear Yogi and his sidekick Boo Boo find their home under threat from a spendthrift mayor who has plans to sell it off.

programme.title: The Next Karate Kid
programme.desc: Martial arts adventure starring Noriyuki "Pat" Morita and Hilary Swank. Karate trainer Mr Miyagi takes on a new female pupil, a rebellious teenager troubled by school bullies.

programme.title: Karate Kid: Legends
programme.desc: Kung fu prodigy Li Fong moves to New York City with his mother and befriends his classmate, Mia. But Connor Day, a local karate champion, provokes Li and publicly humiliates him. Li seeks guidance from his mentor, the kung fu master Mr Han, who reaches out to Daniel LaRusso, convincing the original Karate Kid to teach Li the principles of Miyagi Karate. Drama sequel, starring Jackie Chan, Ben Wang and Ralph Macchio

programme.title: Jack the Giant Slayer
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Nicholas Hoult and Ewan McGregor. Humanity is put on the menu when a farm boy opens the gateway between our world and a fearsome giant race.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Part-animated adventure starring Jason Lee as a struggling Los Angeles songwriter whose fortunes change when he accidentally brings home a trio of singing chipmunks called Alvin, Simon and Theodore. Together they achieve worldwide success, but it's not long before they discover that the music industry has a shady side.

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Anjelica Huston and Raul Julia. The arrival of baby Pubert leads to some "deadly" games in the Addams household as the jealous Wednesday and Pugsley try to dispose of their new sibling. Morticia and Gomez hire Debbie as a nanny for the new arrival, and Debbie soon attracts the amorous attentions of Uncle Fester. But the nanny's motives prove to be even more sinister than the Addams clan itself.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Comedy horror based on the classic TV series, starring Anjelica Huston, Raul Julia and Christopher Lloyd. The ghoulish but happy Addams family are tricked out of their fortune when an impostor claims he's their long-lost Uncle Fester.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
programme.desc: Part-animated adventure starring Justin Long and Jason Lee. Singing sensations Alvin, Simon and Theodore have to put aside their glittering career to face up to the reality of studying. But they and their new musical rivals, The Chipettes, must put their pop prowess to use in order to save the school's music programme by winning a battle of the bands competition.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Too
programme.desc: Comedy sequel to the blockbuster Look Who's Talking, starring John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. Mikey is still trying to cope with the trials of potty training when he is presented with another bombshell: he is to get a sister. And, as if that wasn't enough, relations between his parents James and Mollie aren't going so well, either.

programme.title: Liar Liar
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey. Lawyer Fletcher Reede is a compulsive liar. When his deceits lead to him missing his son's birthday party, the boy makes a wish that his dad would find it impossible not to tell the truth. The wish comes magically true - with hilarious consequences.

programme.title: Matilda
programme.desc: Comic fantasy based on the book by Roald Dahl, starring Mara Wilson and Danny DeVito. Matilda, the daughter of Harry and Zinnia Wormwood, has adored reading from a precociously early age, but her parents refuse to let her go to school. Until, that is, her father sends her to the unforgiving Miss Trunchbull's Crunchem Hall, where she discovers that she has other more useful gifts.

programme.title: A Dog's Purpose
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Britt Robertson and Dennis Quaid, and featuring the voice of Josh Gad. Young Ethan is devastated when his dog and best friend Bailey dies. But Bailey knows that it's not only cats that have nine lives.

programme.title: The Long Kiss Goodnight
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Geena Davis and Samuel L Jackson. A housewife with amnesia who hires a private detective to find out about her past life discovers that she was once a hitwoman for the CIA, and that someone wants her dead.

programme.title: First Blood
programme.desc: Action drama starring Sylvester Stallone as drifter and ex-Green Beret John Rambo, who falls foul of the redneck sheriff of Hope, Oregon. Arrested and beaten, Rambo escapes and takes refuge in the local woods, ready to defend himself with deadly skills learnt during the Vietnam War.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
programme.desc: Action drama starring Sylvester Stallone as ex-Green Beret John Rambo, who embarks on a covert mission to find proof that US soldiers are being held in Vietnamese prison camps. When he finds the PoWs, Rambo decides to try to rescue them single-handedly.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview - Oct 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: 300: Rise of an Empire
programme.desc: Ruler of the Persian empire and self-proclaimed god Xerxes continues his campaign to crush the emerging Greek nation, forcing a general from the democratic city state of Athens to lead his navy into battle against Xerxes' vast armada. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Sullivan Stapleton, Eva Green and Lena Headey

programme.title: The Italian Job
programme.desc: Crime thriller based on the 1969 British caper movie, starring Mark Wahlberg and Edward Norton. A criminal gang run by Charlie Croker (Wahlberg) and veteran thief John Bridger (Donald Sutherland) pulls off an audacious gold bullion robbery in Venice, only for colleague Steve (Edward Norton) to run off with the loot, leaving Bridger dead. Finally tracking Steve down to LA, Croker enlists the help of Bridger's safecracking daughter Stella (Charlize Theron) to get even in spectacular fashion.

programme.title: London Has Fallen
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Gerard Butler, Aaron Eckhart and Morgan Freeman. Three years after the attack on the White House, Mike Banning is back in the Secret Service and travels to London with President Benjamin Asher for the Prime Minister's funeral. The world's leaders are also in attendance but little do they know that a plot to assassinate them and capture Asher is about to come to fruition... with catastrophic results.

programme.title: Clash of the Titans
programme.desc: Remake of the 1981 fantasy adventure, starring Sam Worthington, Liam Neeson and Ralph Fiennes. Perseus, the demigod son of Zeus, is stirred into vengeful action when Hades kills his adoptive family. But Hades retaliates, not least with a threat to unleash the monstrous Kraken unless Perseus delivers the beautiful princess Andromeda to him.

programme.title: Green Lantern
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure based on the comic book series, starring Ryan Reynolds. Cocky test pilot Hal Jordan is inducted into an intergalactic peacekeeping force when he inherits a ring from an alien race that endows him with superpowers.

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard. Years after the disaster at Jurassic Park, a new attraction is opened on the same site. But over time, the novelty has started to wear off so the park's scientists go back to the lab in the hope of creating an exciting new dinosaur: an apex predator, no less, called the "indoraptor". What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Period horror adventure sequel starring Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz. When the young son of Rick O'Connell and his Egyptologist wife find an ancient bracelet that holds power over the armies of the fearsome Scorpion King, it attracts the attention of Meela, reincarnated lover of the resurrected high priest Imhotep, who needs the artefact to help him defeat the Scorpion King and become the ultimate ruler.

programme.title: xXx
programme.desc: Spy action thriller starring Vin Diesel as extreme-sports fanatic Xander Cage, who is coerced by the US government into infiltrating a Prague-based terrorist organisation when he falls foul of the law.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 5
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Dwayne Johnson, Vin Diesel and Paul Walker. Fugitive Dominic Toretto assembles his old team to steal $100 million from Brazil's most corrupt businessman so that they can disappear for ever. But with tenacious FBI agent Luke Hobbs on their trail, their plan just got a lot more complicated.

programme.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard. Three years after the catastrophic collapse of the dino theme park, Jurassic World remains abandoned. But when an active volcano threatens the island's surviving dinosaurs, Owen and Claire return to fight an impending second extinction.

programme.title: Chaplin
programme.desc: Biographical drama about the early years of Charlie Chaplin's life, starring Robert Downey Jr. Despite a poverty-stricken childhood in London, the young Chaplin learns his craft on the music-hall stage, beginning an acting career that will lead him to international fame and a place among movie legends.

programme.title: The End of the Affair
programme.desc: Second World War romantic drama adapted from the novel by Graham Greene, starring Ralph Fiennes, Julianne Moore and Stephen Rea. Against the backdrop of wartime London, Maurice Bendrix embarks on an affair with his best friend's wife, Sarah Miles. When the lovers narrowly escape death in an air raid, Sarah makes a vow to God to end the liaison for ever. But two years later Sarah discovers that time and separation have not been enough to dampen the passion.

programme.title: Peggy Sue Got Married
programme.desc: Comedy fantasy directed by Francis Coppola and starring Kathleen Turner and Nicolas Cage. While attending the 25th anniversary reunion of her old high-school class, Peggy Sue Bodell faints and wakes up in 1960. Faced with living her time over again, will she still marry the man she's about to divorce in the present day?

programme.title: Tommy

Later, the boy is rendered deaf, dumb and blind and all efforts to cure Tommy fail. However, his life is transformed when he discovers pinball.

But when his new son-in-law joins the Confederate army and his youngest son is captured by Federal troops, Charlie finds he can no longer ignore the conflict.

When Phoenix escapes several decades later, Spartan is woken and sent to apprehend his old enemy in the futuristic city of San Angeles.

There he meets Dr Claire Lewicki, who gives the young driver more than racing to think about.

When a Japanese vessel is sunk in the South Pacific and enormous footprints are discovered in Panama, a team of scientists is brought in to investigate. But radiation expert Niko Tatopoulos has his own theory - nuclear bomb tests have mutated a lizard to gigantic proportions and Manhattan is now under threat.

programme.title: Bad Boys
programme.desc: Action comedy thriller starring Martin Lawrence and Will Smith. Two chalk-and-cheese Miami drugs squad detectives - one a wise-cracking, Porsche-driving ladies' man, the other married with a family - are assigned to track down a missing $100-million shipment of heroin.

programme.title: Army of Darkness
programme.desc: Fantasy horror comedy starring Bruce Campbell and Embeth Davidtz. The second sequel to the original Evil Dead finds Ash back in medieval times and desperate to return to the present. But to do so, it means having to take up arms against an army of familiar old foes.

When the pair finally get invited to a party they embark on a quest to procure alcohol in the hope that it will not only lay to rest their geeky reputation but also improve their chances with the opposite sex.

programme.title: The Intern

However, for the tormented László and his wife, Erzsébet, this commission proves both blessing and curse.

Can his former partner Jay persuade him to rejoin the sharp-suited Men in Black and save the world?

After 12 alien spacecraft land in locations around the world, linguistics professor Louise Banks is called in to try to decipher the visitors' language and open a line of communication. programme.title: Traffic Cops

Farmer Meinir Howells gets a workout harvesting cockles with fifth-generation pickers in Carmarthenshire and Onkar Singh Purewal, a father of toddler triplets, is on the hunt for healthy food the whole family will eat

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo's exploration of Essex continues in Romford. He arrives on the London Overground's Liberty Line to visit a state-of-the-art rail operating centre and discovers how signallers and operators control the movements of over 4,000 trains a day. On the River Blackwater, he takes a trip to the Ross Revenge ship, home to Radio Caroline since the 1980's

programme.title: Borneo: Earth's Tropical Islands
programme.desc: Exploring the flora and fauna of the largest island in Asia, taking in its rich coral reefs, lush jungles and mountainous heart, revealing why its is home to a greater variety of life than almost any other. David Harewood narrates

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: The experts value objects brought into Blackburn Cathedral, where Charles Hanson assessing a wooden Fijian club, while two vintage enamel signs catch Philip Serrell's eye. programme.title: Highland Cops
programme.desc: Return of the documentary about Police Scotland's Highlands and Islands division. A brutal murder in an Inverness home sparks a manhunt for two violent suspects, but the case takes a strange turn when detectives begin to doubt their main eyewitness. On Lewis, police face a stand-off with a camper van driver who insists the law doesn't apply to her, while an upturned canoe triggers a search for a missing man in the Cairngorms

programme.title: Surgeons: At the Edge of Life
programme.desc: Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge takes on some of the most challenging medical cases in the country. Its surgeons carry out operations that require such expertise, they're only carried out here and a handful of other centres in the UK. One such procedure is a pelvic exenteration, so complicated it requires two surgeons to perform and two days to complete. Cameras follow colorectal consultant Nicola Fearnhead and consultant urologist Alex Colquhoun, who only do around 10 of these operations each year

programme.desc: Niles and Frasier go gift-shopping with a vengeance as Martin's 65th birthday approaches, vying with each other to be the apple of their father's eye on his big day. Starring John Mahoney, Kelsey Grammer and David Hyde Pierce

programme.title: Countdown
programme.desc: Colin Murray, Rachel Riley and Susie Dent host, with Ellie Simmonds in Dictionary Corner, as contestants race against the clock to pit their wits against words and numbers

programme.title: Come Dine with Me

programme.desc: Crime comedy starring Adam Deacon and Jazzie Zonzolo. Best friends Riko and Kane share an east London flat and are desperate to be taken seriously by the criminal underworld. programme.desc: Laura's marriage soon degenerates when she becomes obsessed by a mole on her new husband's chest. Meanwhile, best friend Amelia juggles her time with an old boyfriend and phone sex-chat lines. Romantic comedy, with Catherine Keener, Anne Heche, Todd Field and Liev Schreiber

Sharing his flight are three convicts being sent to work at a children's leper hospital. The five men must work together to protect the young patients when a volcano erupts, leaving them stranded with no easy way out. Adventure, starring Spencer Tracy, Frank Sinatra and Kerwin Mathews

programme.title: The Yorkshire Auction House

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Dealer Danny Sebastian and queen gavel-wielder Irita Marriott are in Suffolk in their all-electric classic Beetle. Danny grabs a great big cider flagon, a delicate 19th-century trinket box and a natty hat stand. Irita is slow to part with her cash, but finally buys items including a pewter plate

programme.title: Sam Lovegrove: Race Mechanic
programme.desc: Sam Lovegrove prepares cars and bikes for Britain's iconic motorsport events. Can he beat mechanical setbacks to get owners from start line to finish?

programme.title: Richard Hammond's Workshop
programme.desc: A car show in Paris with his new business manager inspires Richard to restore his own E-type Jag. The Cogs take on a rare ceremonial Land Rover.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Metalworker Dominic Chinea is challenged to revive a rare and curious children's toy. This Flexiwhirl seesaw gave owner Joanna Butterwick immense joy as a child, and she's hoping the Repair Shop can help her replicate that for future generations. The seesaw was produced back in the 1930s and was ahead of its time. Not only does it go up and down, it also goes round and round.
Embroidery expert Sara Dennis is given the task of reviving a century-old embroidered bedspread. It's an item that holds great sentimental value for owner Valerie Wilson, who is hoping to breathe new life into this beautifully crafted heirloom, which was a labour of love for her talented mother.
Finally, it's a family affair as siblings Steve and Suzie Fletcher work together on a gentlemen's shooting stick - an ingenious seat-on-the-go for walkers and lovers of country pursuits. The stick has special significance for owner Brian Greaves, whose father was a writer and Dickens enthusiast. It's a memento of a special literary tour that they completed together.

programme.title: Deadliest Families
programme.desc: When 36-year-old Angie White is found dead by police at her home in Wales in October 2022, Alexa recordings from the night of her murder help catch her killer. Family and friends talk for the first time about the night that changed their lives forever.

programme.desc: Conclusions that can be drawn from the methods killers choose to dispose of their victims' bodies, and the techniques used by forensic investigators to discover them

programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build
programme.desc: Nick Knowles comes to the aid of Liz and Jason Liversidge, a Hull couple in desperate need of help in future-proofing their family home. Not long after getting married and starting a family, Jason was diagnosed with both Fabrys disease, which causes a build-up of poisonous toxins in the body, and Motor Neurone Disease, which drastically reduced his life expectancy. The pair also discovered that Jason would have passed Fabrys disease on to his two daughters, which means that once her husband is gone, Liz will need all the help she can get in managing her children's condition. Nick joins forces with designer Oliver Heath and an army of volunteers to put together a home in which Jason can build meaningful memories with his girls, but one which also gives Liz the best chance of providing for their future needs

programme.desc: Nick Knowles comes to the aid of Liz and Jason Liversidge, a Hull couple in desperate need of help in future-proofing their family home. Not long after getting married and starting a family, Jason was diagnosed with both Fabrys disease, which causes a build-up of poisonous toxins in the body, and Motor Neurone Disease, which drastically reduced his life expectancy. The pair also discovered that Jason would have passed Fabrys disease on to his two daughters, which means that once her husband is gone, Liz will need all the help she can get in managing her children's condition. Nick joins forces with designer Oliver Heath and an army of volunteers to put together a home in which Jason can build meaningful memories with his girls, but one which also gives Liz the best chance of providing for their future needs

programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build
